The platform has been built with a focus on responsible innovation that promotes a sustainable, fair, and legal creative ecosystem through ethical and responsible AI practices. It uses a 100% licensed, certified dataset to ensure protection against copyright, trademark, and privacy issues. It also features a patented attribution engine that compensates creators, fostering a safe, commercial environment.BRIA.ai offers AI foundation models for building unique visual Gen AI capabilities and service tools for model inference, evaluation, optimization, and fine-tuning. Users can generate and modify visuals using a comprehensive API suite and personalize on-brand content through fine-tuning data capabilities. It features an IFRAME / SDK for quick integration of Gen AI to enhance user experiences and expedite market entry without development effort. BRIA.ai also provides a web application to experiment with its Visual Generative AI capabilities.BRIA.ai ensures its models are trained exclusively on licensed and safe-to-use data, ensuring no copyright infringement or harmful content, and ensuring diversity, fairness, and unbiasedness. The platform is designed for commercial use and is built to address diverse business challenges with unmatched flexibility. It allows teams to independently utilize its Foundation Models and APIs in a versatile manner suited to their specific needs.

name: Colourlab
description: Colourlab.ai is an AI-powered tool designed to revolutionize the art of color grading in film and content production. It ensures seamless color grading through its progressive color matching engine and an array of professional toolsets. Notable tools in the suite include Colourlab Ai Creator 3C - a leading AI color grading application, ColourPro - built specifically for professional colorists, Look Designer - a standard for innovative look design, and Freelab - dedicated to grading. The platform also provides built-in support for over 40 camera brands, widening its applicability across various production setups. With the platform's advanced capabilities, color grading which traditionally required extensive time and expertise can now be accomplished more effectively, allowing users to focus more on creativity. The tool's promise of 'Just Click Match' obliterates barriers to creative expression making color grading more accessible. The application can be initiated without credit card requirement, making it easily accessible for trial. Ideal users range from colorists, editors, filmmakers to content creators. Its offerings improve efficiency, creativity, and overall output quality in film and content production.

name: Medical Brain
description: Medical Brain by HealthPrecision is an AI-powered clinical assistant facilitating actionable health insights with a patient-centric approach. The platform operates by aggregating and analyzing patient data and patient-generated information, including free text from health records, to detect potential health risks and care gaps. This system operates continuously, interpreting data to offer realtime responsive solutions, allowing for immediate patient action to pre-empt evolving health issues.The AI is interactive, engaging with both patients and healthcare providers as necessary to optimize clinical outcomes, divert care away from high-cost settings, and coordinate care efforts. It acts as a decision support platform that helps identify emerging health risks, care gaps, and guides real-time actions that can deter high-cost ER visits. An important feature of Medical Brain is its inclusion of evidence-based best practices in its expansive library of clinical modules. This included guidance from leading medical authorities and the expertise of an in-house team of physicians. The AI system is designed to learn from real-world experiences improving efficiency and intelligence in real-time. The platform offers modules addressing various healthcare domains like orthopedics, lifestyle modifications, radiology, infectious diseases, and renal failure conditions. These modules are targeted at aiding the treatment process, from pre-op medical optimization to post-op recovery phase, providing personalized care that's grounded within evidence-based practices. This results in effective chronic disease management, disease prevention, and quality of life enhancement.

name: Autoblogging
description: Autoblogging.ai is an AI-powered article writer that allows users to generate unique and readable articles on any topic effortlessly. It offers two main features that cater to different content creation needs. First, its "Any Keyword to Article Writer" generates custom articles by simply entering the desired keyword. Second, its "Amazon Single Product Reviews Writer" creates optimized product reviews for Amazon products by entering the product URL. Autoblogging.ai guarantees that its articles are 100% unique, although there might be some plagiarism when it comes to facts and common phrases. The tool offers affordable pricing plans with varying numbers of monthly articles and access to all features. It also allows bulk article generation with up to 10 articles per batch. Autoblogging.ai supports multi-language outputs and regularly releases new features through continuous feedback implementation. Moreover, it provides reliable services and economical pricing powered by scalable infrastructure to help grow its users' businesses. Finally, Autoblogging.ai offers easy set-up and quick article generation, making it a helpful tool for content agencies, businesses, and freelancers to scale up faster.

name: TTSAI by ENTD
description: TTSAI (Text to Speech AI) is an AI tool developed by ENTD that converts textual content to voice. It features multiple languages and voices, supporting over 80 languages with various voice types. Both standard voice and AI voice, also referred to as Neural Voice, are available. The standard voice tends towards a lower cost conversion while the AI voice is designed to produce more fluent voices. The TTSAI platform caters to individual and enterprise needs through a flexible pricing model, offering pay-as-you-go, package, and subscription options. Users can utilize this tool for diverse purposes including e-learning, telephony and call center applications, content creation, support for disabled individuals, voiceovers and video creation, as well as internationalization of text content. This could be especially useful in fields such as online course creation or customer service. Continuing updates for the tool are mentioned, indicating an emphasis on consistent growth and improvement. It aims to facilitate more immersive and accessible content across various mediums, supporting individuals who have difficulty speaking and hearing, and it offers opportunities to bring unique voiceovers to video content.

name: Pixcleaner
description: PixCleaner is an automated background removal tool that utilizes AI and computer vision technology. It offers both automated and supervised background removal options, allowing for a smooth and fast editing process. With PixCleaner, you can easily remove backgrounds from your images, saving time and effort in your editing tasks. The tool is equipped with AI-powered image editing capabilities, providing static shots with white or transparent backgrounds. It also features a built-in editor and refiner for achieving professional design and results. PixCleaner offers a variety of useful features, including Smart Touch, which allows you to fine-tune and guide the AI towards your desired result. You can also utilize the Photo Editor to crop, resize, change the background, manage layers, and more. The tool supports bulk operations, allowing you to automate your workflow and save time when editing multiple pictures simultaneously.PixCleaner guarantees accurate and efficient results, even with complex images and intricate details like edges or hair. Additionally, the tool offers an integration-ready Background Remover API, enabling developers to enhance their applications with PixCleaner's background removing technology. Overall, PixCleaner is a cost-effective and professional solution for image editing, suitable for various use cases such as e-commerce, personal use, advertising, and more.
features: ✅ Static shots with white or transparent backgrounds

name: AIclearing
description: AI Clearing is a digital field construction progress tracking tool that aims to decrease re-work costs and mitigate litigation risk in construction projects. It offers a fully databased solution that leverages machine learning technology, including drone-captured data and advanced 4D geospatial analytics, to generate comprehensive 3D site reports. These reports cover 100% of the construction area, facilitating accurate and efficient progress monitoring. The tool also provides automated and interactive online dashboards and PDF reports, streamlining reporting cycles and offering actionable insights. It can easily integrate with existing systems within organizations, ensuring seamless and efficient data flow. AI Clearing has partnered with renowned companies in the construction industry, indicating its credibility and reliability. It has been recognized as one of the top construction startups, and its solution is significantly faster than traditional quality surveying methods, with AI-based analytics results available overnight.By digitizing the entire construction site and visualizing data, AI Clearing enhances site awareness and reduces supervision costs. It also helps in early discrepancy detection, enabling prompt actions and minimizing issue escalation risks. The tool facilitates communication by providing transparent and real-time progress tracking monitoring reports, streamlining project documentation processes and engagement with stakeholders. Moreover, it assists in operations planning by estimating project deadlines based on the work progress.AI Clearing has proven success in supporting construction projects in various regions, including the US, Canada, Europe, and the Middle East. Its tool combines AI and GIS/CAD technologies to provide accurate and real-time insights into construction progress, elevating trust and productivity in the construction progress monitoring sector.

name: Valuer
description: Valuer is an AI-driven innovation search and discovery platform designed to help users navigate the global innovation ecosystem. The platform offers a range of solutions backed by expert analysts, providing a comprehensive approach to innovation discovery and management. Valuer offers features like the enterprise app that allows team collaboration, bespoke analyst reports for in-depth analysis on relevant business opportunities and integration with API to connect with existing third-party tools. In addition to these, Valuer also extends educational resources including a blog and downloadable eBooks on a wide array of start-up and innovation topics, enabling users to gain insights and stay updated in various industries. While innovative and dynamic, it also places emphasis on user choice and preferences with regards to usage of information, as reflected in their cookie policy. It is a valuable solution for businesses of various scale looking to interact, understand and harness the potential of the rapidly expanding world of innovation.

name: SEOCopy
description: SEOCopy.ai is an AI-powered time-saving tool that allows website owners and marketers to quickly generate new SEO copy or rewrite existing copy. It is designed to reduce the workload of website owners, marketers, and agencies by providing them with automated resources and features to quickly generate or rewrite SEO-friendly copy.The software is highly advanced and easy to use, with features such as auto-suggested keywords and subheadings, bulk copy generation via CSV import, and the ability to connect to Shopify and WordPress stores. Additionally, SEOCopy.ai also provides a keyword research tool, allowing users to quickly find related keywords for their content.SEOCopy.ai is designed to help website owners and marketers generate SEO-optimised copy quickly and easily, without the hassle of manually writing and rewriting copy. With SEOCopy.ai, users can create optimised copy in minutes, not hours, and trust that the content generated is not plagiarised. It also offers a free plan and multi-language support, giving users the flexibility to use the software in their preferred language.

name: Cyanite
description: Cyanite.ai is a tool designed to leverage artificial intelligence in order to enhance the way we search and discover music. It provides music recommendation services with the ability to generate comprehensive metadata for songs or music catalogs in a matter of seconds. The system can automatically tag various aspects of a song, such as its genre, mood, instruments, and tempo, freeing users from manual tagging. Metadata generated by Cyanite not only enriches the information about the music but also significantly simplifies management and search activities. With one of its features, users can input a reference song and discover similar music, thus providing valuable insights for music supervision, content creation, curation and more. The tool also offers a flexible keyword search, allowing the combination and weighting of different keyword to fine-tune the search process. A holistic Free Text Search enables the users to search for music using their own choice of words and descriptions. It also includes powerful visualization tools to identify patterns and show music data graphically, supporting various strategic applications like pitching and marketing. The AI framework and search technology can be integrated into current systems via an API, and is already compatible with various Catalog Management Systems.

name: SteosVoice
description: SteosVoice (formerly CyberVoice) is an AI tool for creating ultra-realistic speech synthesis with high quality sound. It is designed for content, mod and game creators to create unique, engaging content and monetize their voice. It offers over 50 voices in 15 languages and has over 15,000 users and 25,000 hours of audio generated everyday. SteosVoice provides 44.1K WAV files, making it a great tool for dubbing videos, donations, indie games, mods, podcasts, voice messages for patrons, and audio books. It also offers a Telegram Bot, API, and BrandVoice to help creators create and monetize their content. SteosVoice is a great tool for creating new stories with different voices, congratulating patrons on special occasions, creating voiceovers for websites and news, and creating voice donations on streams. It is also perfect for dubbing games in multiple languages and creating more dubbed content.

name: Infografix
description: Infografix is an online artificial intelligence-powered tool designed for the automatic creation of various types of infographics. The tool does not require any design skills from the user. It can create infographics using simple text prompts including lists, hierarchies, timelines, cycles, and process maps. The tool's AI component, ChatGPT, generates content based on user input. For instance, users can type a phrase such as 'leading quarterbacks from 2011 to 2020', and Infografix creates an appropriate infographic. Furthermore, the tool allows easy sharing and embedding of the created infographics on social media platforms directly from its interface. Infografix is designed for a range of users and purposes, including business presentations, academic assignments, and digital marketing campaigns. Users have the option to visualize data in different ways thanks to pre-loaded template options, thus adding variety to how data is presented. The tool supports multiple file formats including PNG, JPG, SVG, and PDF, offering a range of color themes to enhance the visuals. Infografix is designed to work across various devices including mobiles, desktops, and tablets.

name: Leawo PhotoIns
description: Leawo PhotoIns is a powerful and user-friendly photo editor powered by artificial intelligence. The tool can be used to automatically enhance the quality of a batch of photos, making it a great solution for users looking to improve numerous images at once. With its AI Photo Enhancer, the software is capable of intelligently analyzing and improving different aspects of a photo, from the exposure to color balance. Additionally, the Smart Photo BG Remover feature allows users to easily remove or change the background of their photos with just a few clicks. This versatile tool also includes a photo enlargement function, which can increase photos by up to 40X with no perceivable loss in quality. It is capable of processing photos in both batch and individual modes, providing users with a great deal of flexibility. Users have the choice of utilizing automated enhancing and editing functions for quick fixes or manually adjusting photos for more tailored results.

name: Posturenet
description: The Realtime Posture Monitoring App on  Mac, known as PostureNet, is an AI-powered tool that monitors and improves posture while working. It is compatible with  Mac devices running Monterey (12.0) with a front camera. The app uses advanced AI technologies such as deep neural networks, on-device training, computer vision, personalized machine learning, depth analysis, and real-time feedback to detect and remind users when they slouch in real-time. It aims to promote better posture, reduce back pain, and improve productivity.The app offers a personalized experience by accurately detecting and analyzing the user's unique posture. It prioritizes privacy as all posture data is stored locally on the device and never leaves it. Setup is quick and easy, taking less than a minute to start using the app. It can be used offline without an internet connection since the AI model is trained on-device.Customers have praised the effectiveness of PostureNet in improving posture and reducing pain. The app offers a full-featured free trial for 72 hours, after which users can choose to subscribe to a monthly or annual plan for continued usage.PostureNet can also be used on iPhones by selecting the Contiunity Camera mode. Additionally, users can choose to monitor their posture using an external camera if available. In case of changes in camera or environment, the user may need to recalibrate the posture data to ensure accurate detection.Currently available only for  Mac devices, PostureNet utilizes the advanced ML features of the platform. The app does not collect or share posture data with any external parties. Users teach the app to recognize their individual postures to receive customized reminders. The app also allows users to adjust the frequency of alert messages.In summary, the Realtime Posture Monitoring App on  Mac, PostureNet, is an AI-powered tool that leverages advanced AI technologies to monitor and improve posture while working, aiming to promote better posture, reduce back pain, and enhance productivity.

name: Snowpixel
description: Snowpixel is a Generative Media Toolkit which allows for the creation, customization, and captivating generation of images, videos, music, and more, all from textual input. The platform empowers users to turn text descriptions into different forms of content. It enables the generation of videos from text, thereby animating words and portraying them in a visual manner. Besides videos, Snowpixel also possesses the capacity to transform text into images through various models such as creative, structured, anime, and photorealistic. This versatility allows for a broad spectrum of visual styles that can cater to diverse artistic preferences. In the realm of available music tools, Snowpixel offers a feature to generate melodies from text inputs, thereby creating a sonic representation of the input data. From a personalization standpoint, Snowpixel offers the capability to train custom models with user-provided images, fostering a more personalized creation process based on individual data sets. Furthermore, it exhibits a unique feature where it can transform texts and images into 3D objects, adding a deeper level of interaction and realism to generated content. With the pixel art model, highly sophisticated pixel art can be formulated. This wide variety of features is available for users through a simple pay-as-you-go pricing system.

name: GetResponse AI Website Builder
description: GetResponse AI Website Builder is an artificial-intelligence-backed tool designed to make the process of creating a professional website user-friendly and seamless, even without prior experience in the field. Users are able to construct an online platform by either responding to a series of simple questions about their business which then generates a personalized website, or creating their own design from scratch. This 'no-code' building solution includes a drag-and-drop editor for easy customization, as well as the opportunity to use pre-designed, modifiable templates tailored to specific industry requirements. Part of its package includes SEO optimization tools for increasing organic traffic and visibility of the website online. Users can also monitor the performance of the website through the tracking of visits and clicks to understand what engages visitors best. Additionally, this website builder is integrated within the GetResponse's full online marketing suite, allowing users to promote their website through various channels all within the platform. A notable feature of the GetResponse AI Website Builder is its Global Design tool that allows users to make design adjustments with a single click, applying it instantly across the entire website.

name: Klue
description: Klue is a competitive intelligence platform designed to aid product marketers in gathering, organizing, and disseminating competitive intelligence throughout various departments in a business. The platform uses AI driven analytics to aggregate and interpret data offering deep insights into market trends. Its main features include the ability to centralize competitive intel, analyze data efficiently, create competitive content, and distribute it across the organization. Furthermore, it allows users to measure their impact within the competitive business environment. It also offers additional AI capabilities intended to save time and enhance insights. The platform is designed to assist the entire organization's go-to-market strategy by providing access to a range of resources including guides, reports, templates, and webinars that are aimed at giving users a competitive edge. In addition to centralizing intelligence and enhancing insights, Klue also focuses on data security and tool integration. Key aspects of the Klue user experience include the ability to connect existing tools to the platform, ensuring data protection, and saving time through AI assisted analysis. The platform also offers an opportunity for users to bring their customer's voice into their competitive intelligence, thereby providing a more comprehensive understanding of the market environment.

name: Dubverse.ai
description: Dubverse.ai is an online video dubbing platform utilizing artificial intelligence for translating and dubbing videos across a range of languages. Apart from video dubbing, the platform offers services such as subtitles generation and text to speech conversion. This powerful tool empowers its users to generate multilingual content efficiently, making it accessible and comprehensible to a broader global audience. As well as being user-friendly and easy to use, it provides a seamless editing experience via its advanced script editor, which includes a real-time translation feature. Furthermore, Dubverse.ai offers an extensive range of human-like AI voices for voice-overs, enhancing the quality of the dubbed content. The application of generative AI technology in Dubverse.ai enables users to create high-quality multilingual content faster than manual methods. The platform accommodates a variety of content types, including informational videos, how-to videos, documentaries, tech tutorials, and news segments. This makes Dubverse.ai a powerful tool for content creators who need a quick and effective way to make their content multilingual and globally accessible.

name: Chai AI
description: Chai AI is a platform specializing in conversational generative artificial intelligence. The platform gathers language model developers and chat AI enthusiasts with the goal to make advances towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). In addition to functioning as a hub for generative AI, Chai AI also presents a unique opportunity for developers to create language-based models, likened to YouTube's platform serving content creators. Leveraging their proprietary dataset of user-bot messages and machine learning, the models trained are optimized for entertainment, providing an immersive and engaging user experience. The team is composed of individuals from diverse professional backgrounds, including ex-Quant Traders and Researchers, each bringing a unique perspective and skill-set to the platform. Chai AI demonstrates a dedication to innovation and a commitment to creating a digital environment conducive for the growth and development of AI technology, mapping their progress through research publications on methods such as reward models, rejection sampling, blending and reinforcement learning with human feedback.

name: Neuralblender
description: NeuralBlender.com is a platform that uses cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence technology to create artwork from text input. It allows users to create their own AI art, view featured community art, and queue up artwork. It also includes a credits system, which can be used to purchase items from the store. It provides links to its Discord server and Twitter page, as well as FAQs, credits page and create page. NeuralBlender provides an easy-to-use platform for those interested in exploring the creative possibilities of AI technology. It is a great tool for artists, hobbyists, and creative professionals who want to explore the potential of AI-generated artwork.

name: Imagen AI
description: Imagen is a post-production tool for photographers, built around artificial intelligence. Oriented towards saving time and effort, Imagen takes over repetitive tasks, allowing photographers to focus more on their craft. The tool covers key areas of a professional photographer's workflow such as editing and culling. For editing, Imagen incorporates an AI engine that adjusts itself to the user's personal style, aids in delivering consistent and personalized output for every photo. It includes features like Crop, Straighten, Subject Mask & Smooth Skin, along with Personal AI Profiles which learn and adapt over time. In terms of culling, Imagen aims to replicate human selection to help identify the best images. There are customizable preferences and it lets the user keep their catalog intact while making selections. With Imagen, users can also back up their projects during the culling and editing process through its built-in cloud storage solution. The tool ensures data security and is accessible from anywhere on multiple devices. For inspiration, users can choose from various existing profile styles from Talent AI profiles. The tool prioritizes privacy and security, using photos only for editing and creating Personal AI profile.

name: Keploy
description: Keploy is an open source API test case and data mock generation tool specifically designed for developers to facilitate end-to-end testing. It enables developers to achieve 90% test coverage within minutes by leveraging artificial intelligence. By converting user-traffic into test cases and data stubs, Keploy simplifies the testing process and ensures that the generated tests are effective. The tool addresses common challenges in software development such as manual test writing, inefficient code paths, dependency chaos, and difficulty in reproducing production issues for testing and debugging purposes. With Keploy, developers can capture network interactions, automate scenarios, and seamlessly integrate the tool into their workflows, resulting in accelerated development processes. It offers features like test and stub generation, test deduplication, and native integration, enhancing collaboration and providing security and administrative features suitable for team environments. Keploy has gained trust and recognition from notable companies such as Pixis, Instaastro, Amazon, Reliance, Whatfix, Lambdatest, Leadsquare, and Edureka. It also boasts a supportive community, with active presence on platforms like Twitter, GitHub, Slack, YouTube, and LinkedIn. Technical support is offered by the Keploy team. Developers have the opportunity to challenge Keploy's test coverage capabilities by sharing the dependencies of their applications, and if Keploy can generate API tests for them, they can keep the tests or receive a $100 reward if the tool cannot deliver. Overall, Keploy empowers developers by streamlining testing processes and improving test coverage.

name: Smartwriter
description: SmartWriter is an AI-driven cold email outreach tool that helps businesses generate personalized emails to convert potential customers. It enables users to find leads, create tailored personalised copy and make sales. SmartWriter’s AI-driven tool is designed to automate the entire outreach process, creating hyper-personalised emails in a single click. It allows users to personalise emails with LinkedIn recommendations, achievements, bio/job descriptions, recent activity, and other contextual information. It also provides automated SEO backlink outreach, AI social media content generation, and AI content generation. SmartWriter is rated 4.8/5 on Trustpilot and offers a 7-day free trial, with no credit card required. It is designed to be 40x faster and 6x cheaper than humans and offers features such as personalised cold email outreach, LinkedIn Chrome Extension, deep lead enrichment, and personalised LinkedIn outreach.

name: Bunch
description: Bunch is an AI-powered tool designed to cultivate leadership skills in its users. This AI coach tailors advice according to each user's unique leadership style and personal goals, enabling a highly personalized experience. Bunch utilizes the world's knowledge on leadership, breaking down this information into digestible pieces, so users have the opportunity to learn and improve on a daily basis. The tips provided by Bunch are inspired by successful leaders, vetted by leadership coaches, and carefully curated by the tool's specialist team. Bunch also offers a unique feature in the form of an AI assistant named Bunchee, powered by GPT-4. Bunchee is available round-the-clock to address any queries users may have, contributing to the personal touch that Bunch strives for. The tool appeals to a wide set of learners, ranging from those at the early stages of their leadership journey to established individuals looking to hone their skills further. Numerous users have found Bunch to be an effective and convenient platform for their daily learning, utilising it to focus on specific leadership topics that are relevant and important to their roles.

name: Testsigma
description: Testsigma is an AI-driven test automation tool which offers a low-code approach, enabling the creation of tests in plain English. This test automation platform is described as stable and reliable, and is claimed to significantly reduce test flakiness. Platform features include web application, mobile app, and API testing. Various use cases are supported, ranging from regression to visual testing. The platform is designed for test development and execution, reporting and analytics, test data management, and AI-driven test automation. It provides integrations, add-ons, and extensive feature coverage. Tests can be authored using Natural Language Processing (NLP), making scripting more intuitive. Testsigma also offers 'auto-healing' tests, automatically adjusting the mapping of application elements as they change. Its AI-based Suggestions Engine helps debug test failures by identifying possible root causes, and its predictive defect identification capability anticipates areas of application that may be affected by failed tests. The platform offers the option to run tests on the cloud or locally across a range of device environments. It supports continuous testing, working closely with CI/CD platforms. Testsigma delivers a unified platform that is capable of test management, authoring, execution, reporting, and advanced features such as AI suggestion engine and visual testing.

name: Retentionscience
description: The Email Marketing Automation for Ecommerce AI tool by Retention Science is an award-winning platform designed to streamline and optimize email and SMS marketing campaigns for ecommerce businesses. The tool leverages artificial intelligence (A.I.) to personalize messages for each stage of the customer's lifecycle, boosting sales and retention rates.With Retention Science, users can expect to uncover more sales opportunities and achieve faster growth. The A.I.-driven automation eliminates guesswork, saves time, and enhances the effectiveness of email marketing efforts. The platform's predictive ecommerce automation has helped clients increase email engagement rates and purchase rates significantly.Key features of Retention Science's tool include intelligent lifecycle automation, optimized campaigns, flexible workflow customization, and SMS integration to complement email marketing efforts. By leveraging customer data gathered from leading ecommerce platforms, the tool's customer data platform (CDP) provides a unified view of prospects and customers. The A.I. capabilities enrich customer data with predictions for customer lifetime value, churn likelihood, and more. This allows for precise segmentation of email campaigns and better results.Retention Science also offers rich data reporting, combining detailed analytics, revenue reporting, visualizations, and data mining tools. This provides users with visibility from top-level reporting down to individual prospect behaviors.The tool has been trusted by hundreds of brands to reach millions of customers daily, and it aims to help ecommerce businesses grow their online sales and scale effectively.

name: Reverso
description: Reverso is a free online translation service that specializes in translating texts between English and multiple languages including French, Spanish, Italian, German, Russian, Portuguese, Hebrew, Japanese, Arabic, Dutch, Polish, Romanian, and Turkish. The tool offers various features to enhance translation accuracy and efficiency. One of the key features is document translation, which allows users to instantly translate documents while preserving the original layout. Reverso supports translation for various file formats such as Word, PDF, PowerPoint, and Excel in over 25 languages.In addition to translation, Reverso provides integrated dictionaries to help fine-tune translations, offering synonyms and contextual examples. The tool also includes a spell-checker powered by artificial intelligence (AI) to revise original texts, resulting in higher-quality translations.Reverso incorporates the latest in neural machine translation (NMT) technology, allowing for accurate and natural-sounding translations. The NMT technology has been adopted by major companies and translation agencies.Furthermore, Reverso assists with language learning and communication by providing verb conjugation in multiple languages, including French, Spanish, German, Arabic, and Japanese.Reverso is available as a free app for various platforms such as Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, enabling users to translate text from any application with one click. The tool offers millions of real-life examples and allows users to bookmark their favorite translations. Reverso Premium, a paid option, offers additional features such as translating longer texts and ad-free user experience. Overall, Reverso is a comprehensive translation tool that aims to help individuals and organizations communicate more effectively and accurately in multiple languages.

name: Perci
description: Perci is an AI tool designed specifically for Amazon sellers to optimize their product listings. By generating SEO-optimized Amazon listings, Perci helps sellers improve their ranking and sales performance. Unlike general AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perci is trained specifically for Amazon listings, allowing it to avoid common mistakes made in this context.One key feature of Perci is its ability to automatically integrate keywords into listings, which helps with ranking and driving traffic. Sellers can also use Perci's AI-powered keyword strategy to identify the most relevant and effective keywords for their products. Furthermore, Perci's AI technology can detect over 300 restricted phrases, preventing investigations or listing takedowns by Amazon.The tool offers easy-to-use features for creating, optimizing, and updating Amazon listings. It provides advanced AI software specifically built to generate optimized listings. Additionally, sellers can optimize their existing listings to improve SEO coverage, increase traffic, and boost sales.Perci has gained the trust of brands, agencies, and sellers in the Amazon marketplace. Users have praised its efficiency in creating professional listings quickly, eliminating the need for manual copywriting. By utilizing Perci's AI capabilities, sellers can save time and achieve 10x less cost compared to hiring a copywriter.Perci offers different pricing plans with varying listing limits per month, as well as a money-back guarantee and unused credit rolling forward to the next month. The tool is recommended by users who have found it instrumental in streamlining their content process and making their Amazon listing optimization efforts easier.

name: CrawlQ
description: CrawlQ AI Audience Research is an AI Content Intelligence & Strategy Platform that simplifies audience research and helps brands craft effective marketing strategies. It offers AI-powered audience research in a single click, eliminating the need for manual data collection and analysis. The tool uncovers hidden insights about the audience's demographics, preferences, and behaviors, enabling brands to create personalized marketing strategies. CrawlQ empowers sales and marketing teams by providing them with the data they need to excel. It delivers precise insights, aids in risk reduction, and supports informed decision-making. By automating the research process, CrawlQ saves time and money, allowing brands to focus on crafting impactful marketing strategies. The platform is user-friendly, providing a smooth and efficient brand marketing process. Trusted by over 8000 businesses, CrawlQ offers a 7-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee. The AI tool has been praised by customers for its ability to uncover insights, simplify market research, and provide value for money. With a decade of experience in business intelligence and 5 years in Generative AI, CrawlQ is dedicated to the future of AI in marketing and branding. Overall, CrawlQ AI Audience Research is designed to help brands understand their target audience better and create compelling brand strategies.

name: Copyleaks - Plagiarism detector
description: The Copyleaks Plagiarism Detector is a tool designed to identify potential plagiarism, detect AI-generated content and confirm authenticity and ownership. The platform uses advanced AI to detect slight variations including hidden characters, paraphrasing and AI-generated content, providing a more thorough approach to content protection. The Plagiarism Detector can detect multiple forms of paraphrasing, image-based text plagiarism, attempts to deceive detection software, plagiarism in source code, and supports over 30 cross-language scans.The tool has an enterprise solution designed to verify whether the content was produced by a person or AI. It offers full-spectrum detection that includes AI-generated content detection with 99.12% accuracy and can detect AI-generated content including ChatGPT4. The Plagiarism Detector supports multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Russian, Polish, and many others. Additionally, the platform offers a scheduled recurring scan feature that automatically keeps content safe from potential plagiarism, which adds a new layer of protection for the content. The Copyleaks Plagiarism Detector is trusted by leading organizations and institutions around the world.

name: DeepZen
description: DeepZen is an artificial intelligence tool that transforms written text into audio content marked with the natural intonation and emotional depth of human speech. The tool eliminates the need for traditional narration and expensive recording studios, thereby saving on creation time and cost. It's utilized to produce digital voice solutions for a range of sectors including audiobooks, advertising, marketing, brand voices, podcasting, gaming, and virtual assistants. The tool uses licensed voice replicas of skilled narrators and actors to add rhythm and intonation to text. It also enables experienced audio editors to control the full range of emotion in the voice output, rendering a finished product virtually indistinguishable from conventional narration. This service is convenient for industries like marketing, education, healthcare, publishing, services, accessibility, and gaming for text-to-speech transformation. DeepZen offers an added advantage of cloned voices from professional narrators and voice-over artists providing life-like and emotionally varied articulation. Its time-efficient production process is independent of physical location and saves on cost by eliminating production limitations.

name: Huddles.app
description: Huddles.app is an AI-powered meeting note tool made for collaborative teams. It aids in generating, consolidating, and managing professionally structured agendas and conclusions from meetings. A key feature of Huddles.app is its ability to auto-generate an efficient meeting agenda with a single click, reducing preparation times. The platform furthermore provides tools supporting collaborative decision-making, action tracking, and categorization of outcomes. Focus is also given on active participation of all team members by encouraging open discussions and interaction. With real-time reminders from participants, the tool helps stay on track and it discourages deviating from the topic. Huddles.app also provides teams with 200+ customizable meeting templates and engages AI to suggest meeting outcomes. Post-meeting, it fosters follow-up on conclusions, turning them into actionable tasks, and streamlines recurring meetings for better productivity. As a result, meetings become more efficient, inclusive, focused and outcome-oriented.

name: Clipdrop
description: ClipDrop is an Artificial Intelligence powered ecosystem of apps, plugins, and resources for creators. It provides a revolutionary workflow to create stunning visuals in seconds. ClipDrop's tools can be used to remove objects, people, text, and defects from pictures, extract main subjects with incredible accuracy, relight images, upscale images, generate realistic images with AI, and remove text from images. It is integrated with popular tools such as Adobe Photoshop and Figma, and also has an API so that developers can integrate it into their own apps. ClipDrop is also available as an iOS and Android app, and provides tools to remove backgrounds, remove watermarks, remove people, and remove text from images. It is free to try and easy to use, making it a great option for creators of all levels.

name: VERBATIK
description: Verbatik is an AI powered text-to-speech (TTS) generator with over 600 natural sounding voices in 142 languages and accents. It allows users to convert text into realistic audio that can be downloaded in MP3 or WAV format. It features an easy-to-use text editor with powerful one-click controls, a sound studio to merge and enhance audio results, and a full set of SSML features. Verbatik also provides commercial and broadcast rights and unlimited revisions. It is trusted by over 5,000 users and can be used for marketing, gaming, virtual assistants, conversational IVR, voice commerce applications, voice guidance and navigation. Its pricing is designed for everyone, with simple and upfront pricing and the ability to upgrade, downgrade, buy more characters or cancel anytime.

name: BetterWriter
description: InputAI is an advanced AI tool focused on enhancing chat applications with improved automation and natural language-processing capabilities. The tool uses machine learning to better understand and interpret the subtleties and contexts of human language, leading to more responsive and accurate interactions in chat-based applications and platforms. InputAI is implemented in business-to-customer communication to offer real-time customer support, guide users through various website functionalities, and automate routine tasks. It's also beneficial in creating personalized experiences for users, offering insights through data analysis, and contributing to the overall performance of AI-enhanced chat systems. It can efficiently handle various languages and colloquialisms, enabling a global reach for businesses. Although primarily targeted at improving chat applications, InputAI may be used in other contexts where automated, intelligent management and interpretation of human inputs are required. The tool's adaptive and flexible nature, combined with a strong focus on natural language processing, makes it a valuable resource in various areas of AI application.

name: Kodezi
description: Kodezi is an AI developer tool assistant that uses machine learning and natural language processing to auto-correct code. It provides detailed explanations for bug fixes, optimizes code for efficiency, and can translate code to another language. The Kodezi Visual Studio Code Extension is available for download. It is suitable for students, developers, and teams. Integrations are available for web and VS Code. It is also backed by and loved by users. Kodezi is on a mission to 10x productivity in programming and is committed to helping developers write better code with improved efficiency.

name: MeyaGPT
description: Meya is a chatbot platform that allows users to build and launch customer support services using BFML and Python programming languages. The platform comes with an advanced mobile and web chat user interface and allows users to create custom flows and components. One of Meya's notable features is the in-browser developer console that provides CLI access, allowing users to build exactly what they need with their own code and integrations. The platform also supports integrations with various messaging platforms, customer support providers, natural language understanding tools, and user analytics. Meya's platform is scalable and customizable, allowing users to connect any system, script any flow and code any component. The platform uses BFML which is a human-friendly YAML syntax, and Python 3 with async I/O which allows users to install any Python packages and extend SDK element classes. The platform also features complete system reference documentation, intro to flows and components, and chat UI customizations. Meya offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required and provides 24/7 support, with collaborative solutioning, pair-programming sessions, and proactive monitoring and incident escalation. Meya's platform is event-oriented, allowing users to react to any event with custom code, through its third-generation architecture. The platform provides a customizable DevOps workflow, enables GitHub actions of deploys, and supports continuous improvement.

name: Online AI Image Enhancer
description: The Online AI Image Enhancer is a tool designed to improve the quality of photos using various techniques. The principal purpose of the tool is upscaling, a process used to increase the resolution of images without diminishing their quality. It's an effective solution for working with low-resolution images that require enhancement to be used in higher-resolution scenarios. Another integral part of its functionality is denoising, which focuses on reducing any noise present in the image, enabling cleaner, more aesthetically pleasing results. Restoration is another capability of the tool, which works to repair potential structural or color issues within an image, often left by the ravages of time or damage. The tool also includes a feature for Face Refinement, a process that improves the aspects of an image related to faces, honing features for more visually arresting portraits. It needs to be noted that all these processes are fueled by AI protocols, which automates the enhancement process, hence providing a swift, user-friendly experience. The tool's high versatility enables it to be utilized for a broad spectrum of applications, from personal photo improvements to professional photo editing needs. Due to its AI capabilities, results from this tool are often superior and achieved faster compared to traditional manual photo enhancement methods.

name: Typly
description: Typly is an AI-powered writing assistant designed to enhance conversation and correspondence. It utilizes Large Language Models such as GPT, ChatGPT, LLaMA, among others, to auto-generate contextual suggestions suitable for your conversation. Typly also works as an intelligent correspondence analyzer and distribution system tailored for public and business sectors, with software based on advanced AI solutions including neural networks. It features integration with email platforms, the EPUAP system, and the EDZ RP system, thus making the entire correspondence more efficient and manageable. Further, it boasts features such as AI response suggestions, decoding of complex text, summarizing articles, and perfecting emails making communication easy and effective. Added functionalities in the platform include a dating function for compatible match suggestions, Typly Translate for language flexibility in your suggestions, and a user profile creation for personalized sentence recommendations. To address the issue of overwhelming notifications and time-consuming response drafting, Typly generates contextually relevant sentences for seamless conversation flow. Other notable features include a state-of-the-art software keyboard and Typly's Reply function, an AI-powered chat assistant that offers a plethora of response suggestions.
features: ✅ EPUAP and EDZ RP systems integration

name: Caricaturer
description: Caricaturer.io is an online caricature photo maker that uses AI and deep learning technology to produce 60+ caricature photos based on your portraits. It is a simple and secure process that begins by preparing the photo which should include a face and then dragging and dropping it onto the Caricaturer.io platform. The AI technology is then able to recognize the face and convert the photo to a caricature with dramatic and exaggerated effects. The whole process is automatic and no fancy skills are required. In addition to creating caricatures, Caricaturer.io also offers 24/5 support, secure conversion processes, and notification emails for when the task is complete. Their blog also provides helpful information and tutorials on how to make caricatures, how to become a caricature artist, and other related topics. They have also built a community on Reddit where users can share ideas, report bugs, and follow up on the latest news and updates.

name: SolidGrids
description: SolidGrids is an AI-powered image processing platform designed to fully automate the post-production of images for e-commerce businesses. The platform allows users to configure their settings once and automate the entire process of image post-production, eliminating the need for manual intervention. With SolidGrids, users can adjust backgrounds, lighting, banners, and more to match their company branding, while also speeding up the process and reducing costs. The platform also offers several integration options to suit specific needs, and images can be generated in seconds at a fraction of the cost of traditional methods. SolidGrids offers different pricing plans to suit different needs, and users can even sign up for a free trial to get started.

name: Lingostar
description: Lingostar is an AI-based language learning tool that provides an immersive conversational experience to users striving to achieve fluency in English, Spanish, or French. It does not limit users to a set syllabus but allows them the freedom to indulge in real spoken interactions on any topic of their preference. Lingostar leverages modern Natural Language Processing technology to facilitate these discussions and provide feedback in real-time. An appealing feature of Lingostar is its ability to analyze every interaction and adapt to provide a personalized study plan. This plan may include tracking mistakes, vocabulary building, flashcards, and other visual aids tailored to the learner's progression and needs. Every chat is saved, allowing users to revisit and measure their conversational growth over time. It focuses on improving pronunciation and comprehension skills while also enhancing the learner's vocabulary. The tool is designed to be always accessible without any restrictions on the frequency of usage. The ultimate goal of Lingostar is to provide easy access to conversational immersion for students and educators alike, in a bid to break the language barrier that stands in the way of many people's ambitions. Lingostar offers a free version along with premium options.

name: ACDSee
description: ACDSee Photo Studio Ultimate is an all-in-one software solution designed for people who take a lot of photos and want to edit and organise them efficiently. With a focus on layered and RAW photo editing, this software provides a platform for users to manage their digital assets without any hassle. ACDSee Photo Studio Ultimate supports various modes for diverse photography styles and needs. Furthermore, the tool is also designed to provide convenience in managing and accessing digital assets, making it an integral part of the digital photography process. Availability across multiple platforms extends its usability, catering to users who have to work on both PC and Mac. An array of additional products like Photo Studio Professional, Photo Studio Home, and Gemstone Photo Editor expands the software suite, letting users choose the right tools according to their needs. Video editing and conversion tools are also part of the ACDSee Photo Studio offerings, providing wider scope for creative possibilities.

name: Blogcast
description: BlogcastTM is an AI-powered text-to-speech software that enables users to generate audio content from their written articles, posts, videos, and more. The tool provides an audio version of content without the need for a microphone or expensive talent. Users can enhance their website content, WordPress posts, Medium articles, podcasts, YouTube videos, e-learning courses, demos, support materials or audio-books with natural-sounding AI voices in over 25 different languages and dialects. BlogcastTM includes a powerful speech synthesis editor that enables full control of the voices, pronunciation, tone, and pauses within the content. The tool provides over 110 various neural AI voices to choose from to ensure professional and realistic voice overs. BlogcastTM allows users to store and stream their audio files on their servers and embed audio into their blogs or websites using the customizable BlogcastTM media player. The tool also creates and hosts podcast feeds from the generated audio content, which can be submitted to iTunes, Spotify, and Google Podcasts. BlogcastTM provides different subscription plans and one-time article credit conversions to choose from depending on the user’s needs. Overall, BlogcastTM is a powerful AI tool that enables users to expand their reach by voice-enabling their content in a simple, automated, and cost-efficient way.

name: Evant
description: Evant is an AI-driven, interactive SMS platform designed to improve engagement and efficiency in communication. It leverages the high accessibility of SMS, allowing businesses to communicate efficiently with their customer base, handle tasks such as confirming appointments and automating payments, and creating effective marketing campaigns. With Evant, messages can be sent to precise segments of a community, with automation options for routine responses. It also facilitates automating RSVPs for events and enables users to set up donations. Furthermore, Evant assists in building customer loyalty by sending customized promotions and reminders. It also ensures customer satisfaction by conducting post-appointment satisfaction surveys and scheduling follow-ups. This tool can be beneficial for organizations seeking a comprehensive SMS-based communication and task automation solution without the necessity of app installation. In addition, the platform is capable of hosting a community platform where members can view available events, sign up, and even make optional donations.

name: Cartoonize
description: ImagetoCartoon is an online AI cartoonizer that converts your face to cartoon or anime style. It is powered by the latest AI cartoon technology and can convert an image to cartoon in seconds. It is free to use and does not require any account or payment. The AI cartoonizer has a range of over 50 effects to choose from and can create avatars, characters and cartoon emojis. It also provides 24/7 support and none of the images are stored in the system. Users can download the Cartoonize App for Mobile and Mac to edit and turn selfies into cartoon. ImagetoCartoon is also compatible with Image to Sketch, Image to Caricature and other cartoon tools. It is safe and secure to use with no payments or images stored. All images will be cleared within 3 hours.

name: Typeright
description: Typeright is an AI-powered writing assistant designed to enhance writing skills by checking for grammar, spelling, and punctuation mistakes. It also provides style and synonym suggestions to help refine and polish your text. Previously known as Grammatica, Typeright not only helps with correcting errors but also aids in remembering them to avoid repetitions in the future. It handles multiple languages including English, German, and Spanish, making it useful for a diverse group of users. Typeright includes a suite of features such as simple spelling or punctuation corrections, finding missing words, providing style suggestions, and predictive typing. It is a versatile tool, available for use on iOS, Android, and desktop via browser extensions, allowing users to improve their writing on a range of devices. There is also an additional Typeright Plus feature which, when unlocked, grants access to all features across all supported platforms. This platform-independent approach makes Typeright a comprehensive AI-powered writing assistant, accessible wherever one needs it.

name: AdCreative.ai
description: AdCreative.ai is an AI-powered advertising platform designed to provide services ranging from the generation of conversion-focused ad creatives to comprehensive competitor insights. Relevant for all businesses, from startups to large enterprises, this tool is a hub for data-driven advertising strategies. Its suite includes tools for generating impactful ad texts and visuals, aimed to make advertising campaigns stand out in a highly competitive market. Users can generate hundreds of ads, test and find the best-performing ones and automate these processes for more efficient strategies and enhanced conversion rates. The platform is also capable of generating product photoshoots through AI, minimizing the practical constraints of traditional photoshoots. One of the significant aspects of AdCreative.ai is its ability to score ad creatives. Users can score their ad creatives, giving them insights into their potential performance before launch. This capability makes the iterative process of developing high-performing advertisements faster and more targeted. Furthermore, the platform provides an analysis of competitors' top-performing ads which enables users to refine their own advertising strategies effectively. In summary, AdCreative.ai is a comprehensive, AI-powered tool for creating, testing, and refining ad campaigns based on data and competitor performance for improved business outcomes.

name: Leena AI
description: Leena AI serves as an enterprise-level conversational AI platform designed to enhance the employee experience through automation and engagement. Its primary focus lies in the automation of HR helpdesk tasks and fostering improved employee engagement. The AI work assistant component within Leena AI streamlines knowledge management across systems, in addition to providing intelligent analytics, with the goal of increasing overall productivity and efficiency. The assistant integrates with an organisation's tech stack to perform complex tasks, and has abilities such as creating, accessing, and updating enterprise knowledge bases. It is equipped with a feature for managing information scattered across different systems and platforms, aimed at equipping teams in the fast-paced, information-driven environment. Furthermore, Leena AI can uncover patterns and trends providing data-driven insights to assist in informed decision-making and strategic initiatives, which potentially optimise operations and lead to better business outcomes. Leena AI also facilitates the automation of routine tasks, simplifying approvals, and taking action through seamless, enterprise-wide integrations. It offers potential applications across different business functions including HR initiatives, IT efficiency, and sales success among others.

name: Latch
description: Latch is an AI-powered tool that aims to assist legal teams in negotiating and finalizing contracts with greater speed and efficiency. It uses Open AI's GPT-4 language model to analyze and understand agreements, offering suggestions on how to revise and update counterparty language based on a user's standard position. The tool's interface enables users to toggle between suggestions, accept them, and generate redlines automatically that can be inserted directly into the document. Latch also provides a question-and-answer feature to help users navigate through an agreement with granular questions and open-ended queries. Additionally, Latch can assemble simple, plain-language checklists for various situations, allowing users to analyze agreements to ensure compliance with their checklists. Data privacy is a central focus for Latch, and the tool's privacy policy and terms of use are publicly available. Latch is suitable for dynamic companies, as it aims to help them minimize the time, effort, and overall cost of the contracting process. The tool is cloud-based, and users can schedule a demo to explore its features further. In summary, Latch offers an innovative approach to contract drafting and negotiation, providing a comprehensive set of features that can streamline and expedite the legal team's workflow.

name: Eggheads
description: Eggheads is an AI-powered microlearning platform designed to enable easy and engaging learning experiences through chat-based interactions. It offers a range of use cases for various training needs, including sales training, compliance training, refresher training, frontline training, customer service training, employee sensitivity training, product training, customer enablement, security awareness training, employee onboarding training, and knowledge checks.With Eggheads, businesses can ensure that sales teams are equipped to effectively sell products and communicate with customers, employees retain knowledge of rules and regulations, and training events are followed up with engaging chat-based interactions to improve learning retention. The platform also caters to the non-desktop workforce by providing native chat functionality on mobile devices.Furthermore, Eggheads empowers customer service agents to deliver exceptional customer experiences and promotes workplace communication and inclusivity. It helps customer-facing employees effectively communicate the value proposition of products and enables customers to learn how to use products, ultimately generating revenues.Additionally, Eggheads raises awareness for cybersecurity risks and strengthens cyber resilience through security awareness training. It also provides virtual "buddies" for new hires during employee onboarding, helping them reach peak performance. The platform further allows businesses to gain insights into employees' knowledge through knowledge checks, enabling companies to tailor and shape their training initiatives accordingly.Overall, Eggheads offers businesses a chat-based microlearning platform powered by AI, enabling continuous learning and fostering meaningful change without the need for additional applications.

name: Interflexion
description: Interflexion is an AI-powered role-play platform designed to help professionals become better versions of themselves. With Interflexion, users can develop their leadership and interpersonal skills through guided practice and personalized feedback. Interflexion’s AI-powered coach offers unique insight, tailored microlearning scenarios and personalized content creation. The platform also provides interactive role-play scenarios, audio-visual replay and behavioral insights to help users gain self-awareness. In addition, users can track their progress and receive actionable feedback for continuous improvement. Interflexion is available on both Apple and Android, and can be accessed on-demand anytime and anywhere.

name: HyperWrite | AI Writing Assistant
description: HyperWrite is an AI-enhanced writing tool suited for content generation, research, creating speeches, rewriting, and many other writing tasks. The tool leverages artificial intelligence technology to streamline written communication and research, and to help users work more efficiently and effectively. It offers a wide array of AI tools designed to enhance and transform writing tasks. Some of the popular tools it includes are 'Flexible Autowrite', 'Summarizer', 'Explain Like I'm 5', 'Rewrite Content', 'Email Responder', 'Magic Editor', 'AI Speech Writer', 'AI Writer', and 'Scholar AI'. The tool also integrates with the user's workflow via its Chrome extension, allowing for broader usage across different websites. HyperWrite also provides a suite of custom AI tools including Autowrite and Typeahead, designed to inspire creativity and facilitate sentence completions. Additionally, the tool assists with immediate content suggestions based on the user's needs, context-aware sentence completions and email responses. For research work, it offers an AI assistant that provides real-time links and citations. Academically oriented, HyperWrite searches through millions of scholarly articles and papers to empower the AI assistant with accurate, relevant and citation-backed information.

name: Bertha AI
description: Bertha AI is an advanced Artificial Intelligence tool that significantly assists with content creation and enhancement of accessibility in websites, particularly in the WordPress and Chrome environments. It features a powerful content generation AI that crafts engaging content, playing a pivotal role in reducing content creation time. Its practical functionality extends to auto-generating WooCommerce and EDD product descriptions from the product title, and crafting persuasive copy for websites and social media platforms. This tool's key strength lies in its ability to readily integrate within WordPress or as a Chrome extension, granting users the convenience to write content directly where they work.Bertha AI also contributes to improving website SEO and accessibility by automatically generating alternative image text directly within WordPress. Supplementing the traditional use of AI for text generation, Bertha AI incorporates built-in Image generation and AI image search capabilities, providing a versatile tool for wide-ranging content creation needs. The tool offers subscription-based use, with unlimited installations under one license for multiple websites managed by the user. Bertha AI also provides options for 'Pay As You Go', allowing users to purchase services without a subscription. In summary, Bertha AI is a comprehensive AI-based solution for content development and optimization, offering a blend of versatility, convenience, and powerful AI-driven functionality to significantly simplify and enhance the content creation process.

name: Collab.com
description: OneContact Suite is an omnichannel collab contact center software that aims to empower contact centers with intuitive AI tools to enhance customer engagement. The software is designed to streamline customer interactions by integrating CRM, speech analytics, and other advanced features such as gamification, workforce optimization, and agent scripting. OneContact Suite also offers cloud PBX and call center as a service (CCaaS) solutions with intelligent routing and self-service capabilities through IVR and bots. With advanced reporting and quality monitoring features in real-time, OneContact Suite enables efficient management of voice, video, e-mail, instant messaging, and social media channels through a single interface. The software is web-based, available in any browser, and comes with intelligent routing that connects customers to the most appropriate agents. Additionally, OneContact Suite allows voice and screen recording and provides tools for speech analytics to improve overall performance. The software also offers comprehensive integration options and provides CRM connectors, making it easy to integrate other business apps. Overall, OneContact Suite is a comprehensive collab contact center software that enables businesses of all sizes to enhance customer interactions and optimize their operations.

name: Botowski
description: Botowski is an AI-powered tool designed to streamline content creation process. It aids a vast range of users, from copywriters to business owners, to generate quality content in various forms. The tool can autonomously produce articles, blog posts, marketing content and more, based on the user-specified topic. Relying on artificial intelligence, Botowski formulates creative ideas for content and transforms them into polished pieces of writing. The distinct advantage of Botowski is the rapid and automated content generation, saving substantial time and manual efforts for the users. The content generated is both original and free from plagiarism concerns. Additionally, Botowski offers features like AI chatbots for website, product description generator, business name generator, slogan maker, email writer, blog ideas generator, video hook generator, paraphraser, social media post generator, image generator and blog outline writer. Each feature is designed to cater to specific needs of content creation and marketing. Despite its high-quality outputs, Botowski maintains a user-friendly interface where simply inputting a prompt would generate required content, making it a useful tool in content creation scenarios.

name: WriterZen
description: WriterZen is an SEO content workflow software that simplifies the entire process from keyword research to content writing. It is designed for users of all SEO levels. The tool includes a variety of features, such as a Topic Discovery tool to find engaging content ideas and new topics, a Keyword Explorer to find the right keywords for a content strategy, a Content Creator to research, build and construct articles, an A.I. Assistant powered by OpenAI's GPT3 technology, and a Plagiarism Checker to ensure content's originality and uniqueness. Additionally, WriterZen offers resources such as an Academy to learn SEO best practices from industry experts, a blog with news, interviews and tips on how to use the tool, case studies, a knowledge base, and webinars on how to best utilize the tool. With these features and resources, WriterZen enables users to simplify their content lifecycle from creation to conversion and establish domain expertise, driving organic traffic to their website. It is also featured on a variety of websites, such as Mashable, Entrepreneur, VentureBeat, PC, PCWorld, Flipboard and Engadget.

name: Stenography
description: Stenography is an AI-powered codebase documenter that allows developers to automatically document their codebases in real-time. It uses a powerful API that can pass in code and respond with an explanation in plain English, as well as Stack Overflow Suggestions and linked documentation. It also has various extensions, such as the VSC Extension, that can be used to integrate Stenography wherever code can be found. Privacy is also a top priority with Stenography, as it uses a passthrough API and does not store code. It also offers 250 free monthly invocations and a live running list of examples and extensions on Notion. Stenography was built by Bram Adams and is a great tool for developers.

name: Findem
description: Findem is an AI-powered Talent Acquisition and Management Platform designed to make the hiring process more efficient and effective. The tool offers a range of capabilities to support talent sourcing, recruitment management, and providing deep insights based on talent analytics. Leveraging extensive data and artificial intelligence, Findem targets to optimize the recruitment process and help hire the right people faster. The platform encompasses functions like Talent Sourcing, Market Intelligence, Talent Analytics, Candidate Rediscovery, Talent CRM, and more. Beyond recruitment, Findem also offers solutions for multi-channel talent acquisition, diversity recruiting, talent insights, and proactive talent nurture. And with the use of 3D data, the platform provides dynamic, comprehensive talent data, enabling organizations to plan better, decide faster, and increase diversity. The platform empowers organizations with data-driven insights and intelligence that go beyond ward resume analysis and focus on intricate attributes for a more strategic and holistic approach towards talent strategy.

name: MyAnima AI Companion
description: Anima is a virtual AI friend designed to help people build and improve their communication and relationship skills. It is an AI companion that is intended to provide a friendly chat and roleplay experience to its users. Anima is available as an app for Android and iOS devices. It is developed by 2023 Apperry Ltd., and users must agree to the company's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use before using the service. Anima is intended to provide an engaging and enjoyable experience for users to help them develop their communication and relationship skills. It is designed to be an AI companion that provides companionship and care, while also providing an opportunity to practice social interaction.

name: bigmp4
description: bigmp4's AI Video Enhancement is a cutting-edge tool for lossless video enlargement, enhancement, and colorization. It uses a 2022 AI model to increase the resolution of videos up to 2K, 4K, and 8K with enhanced quality and reduced noise. It also supports black and white video colorization, smooth slow motion, and batch mode. The tool supports a variety of file types, including mp4, mov, mkv, m4v, mpg, mpeg, avi, jpg, png, bmp, webp, and gif. It can also process a large number of images in a zip file. AI interpolation increases video frames per second (FPS) to 60, 120, and 240 FPS, making the video vivid and life-like. The tool also keeps the video FPS unchanged after AI interpolation for silky smooth slow motion. Users can purchase the service to prioritize their tasks and upload larger files. The uploaded files and results files are automatically deleted within a week. If a processing failure occurs, the GPU points deducted are refunded after deleting the failed task. The tool provides a FAQ section to explain how it works and answer any other questions. It also offers contact information for further support.

name: Arria
description: Arria NLG is an advanced AI tool focused on Natural Language Generation. It helps turn complex data into insightful narratives, thereby improving operational efficiencies. The tool offers versatile applications including Arria Finance Analyst, Arria Investment Analyst, Arria for Excel, and Arria for RPA, showing its expansive use across different functions and industries. Arria NLG Studio and Arria Connect form part of the wider platform, providing a comprehensive suite for NLG solutions. The tool is developed with diverse user needs in mind, catering to various industries such as finance, pharma, energy, quick service restaurants, consumer research, consumer goods, government and military, real estate, news and media. These capabilities make Arria NLG a powerful solution for businesses to leverage their data for more effective communication. Arria also extends a variety of community resources including a resource library, document library, video library, demos and case studies. These resources help educate users and showcase the tool's capabilities. The business also offers an Arria Academy as a platform for further learning. Integration possibilities extend its usage, while the platform's leadership continues to innovate based on core patented technology.

name: Pixelhunter
description: Pixelhunter is an artificial intelligence (AI) powered tool functionally designed to manipulate image sizes for an optimized and enhanced social media experience. The core objective of Pixelhunter is to simplify the process of refining and resizing images intended for posting or advertising on various social media platforms. The tool operates through an intelligent engine, which programmatically identifies important sections of the image ensuring they are not omitted in the final scaled version. Utilizing this AI tool, users are able to enhance the visual aesthetics of their images, ensuring they are appropriately sized and designed for diverse social media usage. Pixelhunter supports the diverse sizing requirements across different social media platforms, which includes but is not limited to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter. In addition to resizing images, Pixelhunter aims to improve the overall quality of the images. It's streamlined and user-friendly interface makes it simple and efficient for both novice and experienced users alike. As significant part of modern social media management, AI-based solutions like Pixelhunter provide utility in terms of largely automating the process of image editing and resizing, thereby saving time and increasing productivity. Pixelhunter requires JavaScript to run.

name: GrowthBar
description: GrowthBar is an AI-powered tool designed to assist bloggers and content teams in creating SEO-optimized long-form content with more efficiency. It provides AI utilities for tasks ranging from blog post creation to SEO analysis. The tool scans search results and generates a pre-optimized blog structure, suggesting headings, keywords, word count, internal links, and more. Users can subsequently use this AI system to write their blog posts. Also available is the ability to audit existing blog posts.
