During the flight, users can track the progress and view images appearing live on the cloud.The results of the analysis are conveniently displayed on the user's PicStork Dashboard, where they can view and interact with the statistics. The tool also provides the option to download and share the results in various formats via email.Overall, PicStork simplifies the process of aerial image analytics, allowing drone users to achieve their aerial intelligence goals efficiently.

name: Ellie - Your AI Email Assistant
description: Ellie is an AI email assistant designed to replicate a user's writing style for email responses. By analysing past sent emails provided by the user, Ellie learns to formulate replies that mimic the user's language, tone, and style. This adaptive AI tool offers a unique feature where it understands the context of an email thread and crafts responses accordingly, providing personalized and intelligent responses. Ellie is not only adept at context switching but is also multilingual, capable of responding in any language to match the incoming email. Furthermore, Ellie can be taught specific information, making the tool adaptable to your unique needs.Ellie integrates directly into your inbox by functioning as a browser extension, facilitating an easy workflow. The extension is compatible with both Chrome and Firefox. Currently, it fully supports Gmail and Fastmail, and partial support is provided for other web-based email clients through its toolbar popup feature. Furthermore, Ellie respects the privacy of your data. While your email data is used to create responses, it is not stored, shared, or misused in any way.Notably, Ellie is powered by OpenAI, highlighting its technological robustness. The creators of Ellie aim to help users reclaim time lost to managing emails by automating responses and combat imbalances inherent in contemporary email practices.

name: Post Parrot
description: Post Parrot is a free digital marketing tool that uses AI to generate post titles that drive engagement on Reddit. It allows users to input a minimum of 10 characters and a subreddit subject to generate engaging post titles. Users can also purchase additional credits to get more post titles. Post Parrot is made by Tone Row and has a privacy policy, terms of service, and a Product Hunt page.

name: Jokelub
description: Jokelub is an AI-based tool geared towards enhancing humor in writing. The primary function of the tool is to transform regular content into humorous or joke-intended text, promoting engagement and smiles. It features a one-click operation, implying simplicity and ease of use. A standout feature is its Chrome extension, which the users can install for easy access and use while writing. Despite its fun-oriented functionality, Jokelub respects user privacy as stated on its webpage, important in the current digital era where user data privacy is pivotal. Users can access Jokelub services by signing up on their website, furthermore, users who desire more exclusive features can opt for the premium package. The tool integrates a 'TRY OUR JOKE' feature, likely providing the user with a peek into its capabilities. The platform features a login and sign-off system, keeping every user's joke creation process personalised.

name: EvolveAI
description: EvolveAI is an AI-based training tool that aims to provide affordable expertise to those pursuing their training objectives. It integrates sophisticated Artificial Intelligence with industry-leading coaches, world-class athletes, and the latest research to produce custom workout plans. One primary facet of its functionality is the classic block periodization which utilizes low intensity / high volume training. EvolveAI provides athletes with the flexibility to select a variety of top set styles and combinations for different routines such as squat, bench, or deadlift. These selections then determine the workout's volume. The AI system in EvolveAI adapts the training based on workout analysis, featuring a training algorithm designed to optimize each lift through a macro-cycle. It not only ensures the correct sequence of exercises, but it also comes equipped with specific videos and coaching cues for proper form and technique. This tool is designed to offer a cost-effective and customized solution, eliminating the need for a one-on-one coach encounter. Users can expect optimized workouts for their goals, and through consistent use and regular check-ins, they can efficiently work towards achieving their fitness objectives.

name: Pebblely
description: Pebblely is an AI-based tool used for automating and improving business procedures or tasks. Its functionality encompasses various sectors from administrative management to financial data analysis, providing an opportunity to enhance efficiency while decreasing manual workload. The platform uses artificial intelligence to learn and adapt to the unique needs of its users, thereby improving its performance over time. It features an accessible and user-friendly dashboard interface that allows users with non-technical backgrounds to easily manage, monitor and analyze the automated processes. With advanced predictive modelling tools, Pebblely can anticipate potential outcomes of different situations, based on market trends, historical data and current data sets. It offers customizable automation features that are built to fit the specific requirements of various business models. Leveraging machine learning, the tool is capable of improved decision making and increased precision in its tasks. This AI platform is designed for businesses of various sizes and across different sectors, facilitating streamlined workflows and increased productivity.

name: promptoMANIA
description: PromptoMANIA is an AI-powered art community with an online prompt generator. It aids in generating detailed prompts for various text-to-image diffusion models, effectively being used to create digital art. It is compatible with multiple diffusion models such as DALL-E 2, Disco Diffusion, WOMBO Dream, among others. Besides prompt generation, it features additional tools, like the 'grid splitter', that separates an image containing four smaller ones into individual pictures. It offers a user-friendly platform that allows users to create AI art effortlessly. The steps involve choosing a diffusion model, providing prompt or image subject, selecting base image along with other references, and finally, selecting one or more art styles. On completion, the results can be run promptly, generating an AI image that can be published and saved on the users device. The PromptoMANIA tool also accommodates learning where users are guided on how to generate useful prompts that help achieve high-quality AI images. Lastly, it is a freely accessible online tool, requiring no sign-up or subscription.

name: Doppel.com
description: Doppel is a modern tool for digital risk protection. It focuses on detecting and addressing phishing and brand cyber attacks that target numerous prominent companies. The tool is utilized by many leading cybersecurity teams to provide protection against threats both on traditional and emerging digital platforms. Doppel offers different types of products including Anti-Phishing, VIP Protection, Threat Intel, Anti-Piracy, and Anti-Counterfeiting. It is applicable across various industries such as finance, tech, crypto, retail, media and government sectors. With the power of advanced AI models, the system scans millions of websites, social media accounts, mobile apps, paid ads and other online platforms, categorizes the identified threats such as brand infringement and phishing scams, and automatically removes such threats once detected. Additionally, Doppel provides integration with domain registrars, social media, app stores, digital marketplaces, the dark web, and numerous platforms on the Internet. This offers users comprehensive visibility and automated protection against external threats.

name: Instabot
description: Instabot is a powerful AI-powered platform that enables businesses to create and deploy chatbots quickly and easily. It provides a wide range of customizable features, allowing businesses to engage customers and convert more leads. Instabot's easy-to-use bot builder and templates allow users to launch their bots in minutes, and its powerful APIs enable developers to integrate chatbot applications into their products. Instabot's platform is platform-agnostic and can be used across web, mobile, text, and social media. It also provides analytics to measure bot performance, allowing businesses to make tweaks and understand performance at every level. Instabot's flexible subscription pricing and contracts, including 14-day free trial and month-to-month options, make it ideal for businesses of all sizes. It also offers white label solutions for marketing agencies and technical and client support that has been cited by industry reviewers as best in class.

name: Bohita
description: The AI-Based Apparel Design Tool is a unique application that integrates artificial intelligence (AI) for creating designs on various clothing articles, such as t-shirts and hoodies. It leverages Stable Diffusion prompts, a particular methodology that implements AI, to generate creative and distinctive designs. Stable Diffusion promotes the gradual development of designs, facilitating the substantial enhancement of design quality. It empowers users to create designs that are not only innovative but also perfectly suit their preferences and requirements. By enabling the creation of customized clothing designs, the tool provides unique, personalized attire options. It's a convenient, efficient solution for anyone looking to create individualized apparel, from fashion enthusiasts to clothing brands. As AI continues to advance, future updates may expand its capabilities, further improving the design process and outcomes. The tool's integration of AI not only propels design creation into the future but also allows for the maximization of design accuracy and efficiency.

name: Aspen
description: Aspen is an AI tool, based on JavaScript, designed to facilitate and improve various tasks on web applications. Its distinctive capability lays in its ease of integration and diverse utility whether in streamlining user interface interactions, creating dynamic content or enhancing data manipulation. Implemented in your application, it helps in simplifying complex tasks, augmenting user experience and productivity. Aspen uses the power of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning algorithms to gather insightful data and make intelligent predictions, facilitating informed decision-making. As it is JavaScript based, the tool is extremely versatile, compatible with various platforms and capable of supporting both client-side and server-side web development. name: Twig AI
description: Twig is an AI-powered tool designed to help users quickly and easily find the answers they need from technical documentation without having to spend hours sifting through endless pages of documents. The tool works by semantically analyzing documentation, knowledge bases, past support tickets, and other data sources to provide accurate responses to customers' complex questions. This significantly reduces the costs of customer support by up to 30%. Twig's AI models are trained on publicly available data, allowing it to find and recommend relevant responses to user questions with confidence. The recommended responses include citations that increase the trustworthiness of the response by showing users where to find additional information. Twig also helps support agents become more productive by automating tedious tasks and providing powerful tools that replace busy work with human empathy. It enables agents to improve the quality of customer engagement by bringing higher minimum standards on response quality and helping them notice potential risks in responses. Twig can integrate with most popular documentation and knowledge base products, and it sanitizes data, removing any personally identifiable information (PII) to ensure privacy protection. Twig is an AI tool designed to significantly enhance the customer experience by providing accurate, relevant, and speedy responses to technical questions.

name: Kiri.Art
description: Kiri.Art is an AI tool designed to operate as a Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontend for Stable Diffusion Json. Using advanced AI techniques, it parses and stabilizes Diffusion Json data, effectively processing and presenting it in an intuitive, user-friendly format. This PWA frontend allows users to access the tool seamlessly across multiple devices with varying screen sizes by delivering app-style interactions. It aims to provide a consistent and engaging user experience without the need to download any software or application. Kiri.Art supports offline functionality, implying that users can continue to work even when they lose internet connection. Note that being a frontend, Kiri.Art does not handle backend operations but focuses on the user interface and user experience, translating Diffusion Json data into an immersive digital experience. This tool is suitable for those working closely with Diffusion Json data and seeking a reliable, accessible, and efficient way to interact and work with such data.

name: Gift Ideas by Genie
description: Gift Ideas by Genie is an AI tool developed by BuildAI.space designed to facilitate the process of selecting gifts for loved ones. This tool is particularly handy during festive periods such as Christmas, but it can also be used all year round for other gift-giving occasions like birthdays, anniversaries, and more. The goal of Genie is to streamline the gift selection process, potentially saving users hours spent on shopping and research. To achieve this, it uses machine learning algorithms to understand users' preferences based on specific inputs or queries. These could be related to the age, interests, and gender of the recipient, among other factors. The tool then offers a curated list of gift ideas that align with these preferences. As this tool relies on advanced AI, the recommendations are continually updated and improved upon, ensuring the suggested gift ideas remain relevant and cater to a wide array of tastes and preferences. While this tool does not directly sell the products, it guides users to where they can purchase the recommended gift items. Insightfully designed, Gift Ideas by Genie offers a convenient and time-saving solution for gift shopping.

name: Daydrm.ai
description: Daydrm.ai is designed to be an AI-powered creative tool for strategists, creatives, and directors. It offers on-demand conceptualization solutions for agencies, brands and studios. It uses a custom-built training data based on various campaigns and a uniquely-compiled structured dataset exclusive to Daydrm. This AI model has a feature of generating multiple outputs at once from a single brief thereby encouraging creative ideation. Daydrm also prides itself on its data privacy measures which ensures that inputs and outputs from users are kept private. It offers a variety of generators each acting upon its own bespoke training data for strategic briefs and creative ideas. Daydrm has introduced a chat-feature with Ari, an AI creative partner to facilitate a collaborative and interactive ideation process. The platform provides users the ownership of the generated ideas and outputs ensuring privacy and intellectual property rights. In addition, it rules out learning from user-inputs, thereby not using any user data for service improvements or model training.

name: AYAYA - AI Collage Generator
description: AYAYA - AI Collage Generator is an application that enables both professional artists and individuals to manipulate and enhance their photos using AI-based technology. Individual creations can be shared on social media or used for other personal purposes.

name: CoverDoc.ai

name: AskCodi
description: AskCodi is an AI coding assistant that serves as a pair programmer for developers. It offers various features and applications to enhance productivity and efficiency in coding tasks. With AskCodi, programmers can benefit from AI-powered features such as Codi Chat, a seamless chat interface for crafting code conversations, and Codi Workbooks, Jupyter Style Notebooks that unlock endless possibilities for developers. With user-led growth, AskCodi aims to continuously improve and evolve based on user feedback and needs.The tool offers an AI-powered efficiency that increases productivity by reducing repetitive processes and freeing up time for high-value activities. It aims to unlock the future of coding and innovation, providing a platform to boost productivity and optimize developer workflows.AskCodi's unique workbook style coding approach is designed to facilitate learning quickly and efficiently. It offers a familiar interface, step-by-step progress, and the ability to generate, explain, document, and test code. Additionally, Codi Apps, a suite of applications, caters to supercharging coding experiences, enhancing workflow, and increasing efficiency.AskCodi is available as a web application and as extensions/plugins for popular IDEs such as Visual Studio Code, Sublime Text, and JetBrains' IDEs. It offers flexible and transparent pricing options, allowing users to choose the features they want at a price that suits their needs.

name: Prospero.ai
description: Prospero.ai is an AI-powered tool designed to simplify and enhance the investing process for both amateur and seasoned investors. Utilising advanced AI techniques, the platform translates complex trading patterns into easily understandable stock insights. It provides long and short-term signals that have been shown to deliver market-beating stock picks consistently. Prospero.ai maintains its effectiveness by offering clear, proven signals using advanced algorithms. It partners with NYU to take advantage of a proprietary AI system that distils stock analysis into ten key signals, aiding users in leveraging predictions for better investing. The Prospero.ai application also offers a learning center to educate users on how to leverage the platform most efficiently and is available to download on Apple's App Store and the Google Play Store. It also provides regular newsletters with finer details and insights to assist users in their investment decisions. Prospero.ai is appreciated and recommended by its users for its accuracy, ease of navigation, and valuable insights into market sentiment and direction.

name: Parthean
description: Parthean is an AI-enabled tool designed to automate various aspects of your financial management. The platform features an array of modules that enable users to automate money movements across different accounts, ensuring efficient transactions whether you're paying off debt, saving, or investing. Its Worry-Free Finances and Easy Transfers modules facilitate automatic savings, investments, debt payments, and account transfers without the risks of overdrafts. Parthean's Fun Saving module introduces an interactive way of tying savings to everyday activities. On the other hand, its Smarter Money module provides real-time insights on your finances, monitoring spending, highlighting shopping deals, and supplying investment data. Its AI agent answers financial queries, offers personalized financial plans, and explains its recommendations with citations and graphics. The platform is secured with bank-level encryption standards and does not allow the processing of personally identifiable information by the AI algorithms. Through partnerships with Plaid and Dwolla, Parthean offers secure access to financial accounts and smooth electronic payment processes. Their privacy policies prioritize user data protection and never involve selling data to third parties.

name: GitHub - BenderV/generate
description: BenderV/generate is an experimental project available on GitHub focused on generating data from LLM (Language Models). This project is known for generating datasets in CSV format. It was built to experiment with the potential data generation capabilities using language models. Whilst BenderV/generate is now deprecated, it served as a precursor to the new project 'Ada'. Ada is another GitHub project from the same developer continuing the ideas and efforts of the generate project. Note that during installation and usage of BenderV/generate, environment variables such as DATABASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY needed to be set up. It's also important to mention that certain installation steps requiring command-line scripting (like yarn dev and pip install) were necessary for both frontend and backend operations.

name: Notedly
description: Notedly is an AI-powered tool that helps students save time by automatically generating notes from assigned readings. It is designed to help students quickly and efficiently understand complex content, allowing them to spend their nights socializing instead of note taking. The tool works by uploading a scientific publication, such as a textbook chapter, news article, or research paper, and then allowing Notedly to scan the material and take notes on it for the user. The notes are generated in seconds and are written in a simple-to-read language that helps students comprehend the material. Notedly also offers an example summary of a news article, academic paper, or textbook chapter, as well as the ability to paste homework to auto generate notes. With Notedly, users can save hours per week of reading time without sacrificing their grades.
features: ✅ No account required for first use

name: Dream by WOMBO
description: Dream by WOMBO is an AI-based tool designed to generate artwork based on user inputs. Its basic operation involves the user providing a prompt and choosing a desired artistic style. Once these options are selected, the tool uses AI algorithms to interpret the provided prompt and translate it into a creation that matches the chosen style. The output of this process is a unique, AI-generated painting. Key features include a wide range of art styles to select from, attesting to the tool's adaptability in handling diverse user preferences. Furthermore, the generation process is designed to be swift, offering rapid turnarounds on the creation of AI-powered artwork. This can be beneficial for users who require quick results or are working under time constraints. As a sign of its premium nature, the tool also features a premium icon. It is also important to note that while the tool harnesses the power of AI for its operations, user input plays a significant role in guiding the AI's creative process. This makes it more of a collaborative tool between the AI and the user, with the AI playing an auxiliary role in translating user ideas into visual form. Overall, Dream by WOMBO is a user-friendly tool for those seeking to explore AI-assisted artwork creation, and it has the potential to serve both casual and more dedicated, creative users.

name: Retomagic AI
description: Retomagic is an AI-based app that enables users to generate original artworks and enhance photo quality. The app utilizes cutting-edge technology to turn text descriptions into visually stunning images. It also provides users with a range of creative styles and options, from photorealism to Kodak film. Additionally, Retomagic is able to revive old, blurry photos into sharp and clear HD images with just one tap. It even comes with a face reconstruction system that can improve the quality of faces. Furthermore, users can share their creations on social media platforms, such as Instagram and TikTok. Retomagic is currently free to use, however there may be subscription options in the future.

name: Lexica Aperture
description: Lexica Aperture is an advanced AI tool that specializes in the creation of photorealistic images. It provides an intuitive interface that facilitates the easy generation, organization, and customization of high-quality digital images. With Lexica Aperture, users can describe an image in natural language and the tool would respond by creating a picture that matches the description. This feature sets Lexica Aperture apart as it leverages AI's capacity for understanding language and delivering outputs in a completely different medium. It also includes a 'Negative Prompt' functionality that aids users in refining image details by specifying aspects they want to avoid in the output. Lexica Aperture offers different generation speeds which allow the user to have control over the creation process. The 'Home', 'Generate', 'History', 'Likes', and 'Account' functions avail a seamless user experience, enabling users to navigate through their image creation journey efficiently. The 'History' and 'Likes' features enhance the usability by allowing users to revisit previously generated images and save their favourite outputs respectively. Despite its advanced features, Lexica Aperture maintains an easy-to-use approach, accommodating both beginners and professional artists alike.

name: Promptmakr
description: Promptmakr is a specialized marketplace that caters to the needs of 'prompt artists'. This tool takes a unique approach by providing an open platform where users can both buy and sell AI prompts, creating a dynamic and flexible resource for AI users and developers. By accentuating collaboration and sharing, it fosters a more innovative environment for working with AI prompts. Promptmakr is accessible on diverse platforms as it can be found in app stores, which includes Apple's App Store and Google Play Store. It also values security and privacy of its users, offering clear terms and conditions, as well as a detailed privacy policy. The prompt artists have a built-in support mechanism, with the opportunity to contact the support team for any queries or help that might be needed. With a focus on being a flexible and user-friendly platform, the tool aims to simplify AI prompt transactions. It can be leveraged by AI-related professionals to explore, purchase, and even sell creative and interesting AI prompts in a single, secure environment.

name: Splitmysong
description: SplitMySong.com is an AI-based tool that allows users to split songs into vocals and instruments. With this tool, users can easily isolate individual tracks such as drums, vocals, bass, guitar, piano, and "other" from their songs. Additionally, users can adjust the volume and panning of each track using the mixer feature. The tool also offers the ability to change the tempo and pitch of the song. Once the desired mix is achieved, users can download their customized mix.The AI-powered audio separation process employed by SplitMySong.com is computationally intensive and may vary in processing time depending on the duration of the audio file. On average, the process takes approximately 1 to 3 minutes to complete. The tool supports various common audio formats such as mp3, ogg, flac, wav, and aiff. However, there are some limitations regarding file uploads. Each uploaded file must be between 0.1 and 200 MB in size, and the maximum audio duration allowed is 20 minutes. Users of the free version can only upload a maximum of two songs per day, with their songs being cropped to a random 15-second snippet before processing by the AI.The tool ensures user privacy by restricting access to songs, allowing each user to only access their own songs. Uploaded songs and processed tracks are automatically deleted after approximately one day, so it is recommended to use the download function to save results beforehand to prevent any data loss.While there is no native mobile app available, users can install the SplitMySong Web App on their mobile devices or desktops to achieve a similar experience. Overall, SplitMySong.com offers a convenient and user-friendly solution for audio separation and customized mixing using AI technology.

name: GPTAnywhere
description: GPTAnywhere is a practical Chrome-extension that offers easy and convenient access to ChatGPT via a simplistic popup interface. The extension is designed to optimize the user experience for frequent users of ChatGPT by integrating the chat function directly into the browser. From the workflow and planning category, this tool aligns with productivity enhancements and has a widespread user base. GPTAnywhere, specifically designed to not collect or use your data, promises a commitment to privacy, stating that user data will not be sold to third parties, used for unrelevant purposes, or used to determine creditworthiness or for lending practices. Users have widely appreciated the convenience and functional simplicity GPTAnywhere offers. However, it is also crucial for users to know that Google does not verify the extension reviews. Though the current version is 1.0.2, it would be pertinent to check for updates to ensure the best user experience.

name: RepAI
description: Rep AI is an AI-powered chatbot designed to enhance the shopping experience for customers in an eCommerce store. It was specifically built for Shopify and uses two AIs to provide shoppers with a personalised guided shopping experience. The Rescue Algorithm predicts when a shopper is about to leave the site, with an accuracy rate of 92%, and engages them in a conversation to bring them back. ChatGPT powers the conversational shopping assistant to handle all conversations, including product questions, checkout and recommendations. Rep AI understands natural language and idioms, thus making it ideal for big catalogue stores with complex queries. It can recommend complementary products for upsells and can handle multiple languages. Rep AI integrates with popular Shopify apps seamlessly, and requires no changes to the support stack. Merchants have reported increased Conversion Rates of up to 13%, Average Order Value increment of 20%, and an average sales increase of 9%. Rep AI provides customers with a tailored shopping experience, making it a game-changer for eCommerce sales. Brands such as Underoutfit have seen an exponential increase in their conversion rate. Rep AI offers a 30-day free trial and a 60-day money-back guarantee if the user does not get 10x ROI on their investment.

name: SmartUA
description: SmartUA is an AI-powered tool that generates ad creatives and optimizes ad budgets for ad campaigns. By leveraging AI and performance marketing best practices, SmartUA predicts the next best move for advertisers, allowing them to make data-driven decisions. The tool aims to decrease the cost per click by up to 30% and increase the effectiveness of ad creatives.The process begins by generating the initial set of 10 image creatives using SmartUA's platform. Advertisers can then link their Meta Ad Account to the platform and launch a performance marketing test. SmartUA's algorithms automatically stop the campaign once it reaches statistical significance. Each new creative generated by the tool is optimized for the target audience, with the goal of outperforming the previous one.SmartUA is suitable for various users, including e-commerce stores, startups, and marketing agencies with multiple accounts. E-commerce businesses can benefit from the tool's machine learning model, which generates custom ad creatives for their product catalogs. Marketing agencies can generate ad creatives and banners with significantly higher conversion rates for their clients. Startups can leverage the tool's powerful AI capabilities to maximize their ad spending on highly converting creatives.SmartUA offers different pricing plans based on user requirements, with features such as unlimited generations, integration with Facebook and Instagram, and various credit allowances per month. There is also a special offer for users with marketing budgets over $100k, providing personalized services and exclusive access to premium advertising channels.Based in Wilmington, USA, SmartUA is developed by Incymo.AI. Users can access additional information and resources through the company's blog, and reach out to them via email for further inquiries.

name: Woord
description: Woord is a Text-to-Speech (TTS) tool that allows users to convert text into natural-sounding audio. This technology is able to read any website content aloud, turning web content into accessible speech. It offers users a variety of voices to choose from, that vary by language, gender, and accent. Woord supports over 30 languages, including regional variations such as Canadian French or Brazilian Portuguese. Users have the flexibility to convert any text content they wish, ranging from blog posts to research papers. Woord's smart voice technology utilizes AI to create high-quality, human-like speech, which can be used for a range of purposes, from YouTube videos to e-Learning modules. This tool also provides opportunities for redistribution, supporting MP3 download and Audio hosting with an HTML embed audio player. This allows the creation and sharing of audio files for commercial purposes. Users can start the conversion process by sharing a URL or uploading their text content directly to the platform, choose the preferred voice and listen to or download the resulting audio.

name: Brancher
description: Brancher.ai is a platform that allows users to easily create and share AI-powered apps without needing to know how to code. The platform has a user-friendly interface that provides access to a range of powerful AI models, allowing users to quickly create powerful, sophisticated applications. Brancher.ai offers the opportunity to monetize and share creations with others, allowing users to potentially earn from their work. The platform also offers 100 free credits to users who sign up, allowing them to try the platform and access the potential of AI. Brancher.ai is compatible with a range of AI platforms and tools, making it easy to connect and combine AI models from different sources. The platform is secure and offers support and assistance, including access to documentation, tutorials and other resources, as well as direct support from the Brancher.ai team. Brancher.ai was made in one week by a team of two, and is powered by Fresh, a company that provides strategy, engineering and design services to technology needs.

name: Magician for Figma
description: Magician for Figma is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) powered design tool that is integrated into Figma, a popular design platform. This tool is designed to enhance the design output by providing a range of automated assistance features. Notably, it has the ability to convert text inputs into icons or images, effectively broadening the scope of design possibilities. It can also assist with copywriting tasks as you design. These capabilities are referred to as 'magic spells' and aim to work in tandem with a designer's own creativity and imagination. The Magician tool is a creation of Diagram, and it promotes more efficient and intelligent designs through automation. In addition, the tool is actively in development, with future updates indicated, ensuring the product will continue to evolve its capabilities and meet the changing needs of users. Despite its advanced features, the tool ensures simplicity in integration and usage with ease of installation on Figma. It's worth noting that as of the most current update, the tool is in its beta stage and offers a free license with unlimited use, providing a risk-free way for designers to explore its features and functionality.

name: Retune
description: re:tune is a comprehensive platform designed for building AI applications without the need for coding. The platform facilitates the creation of custom AI applications to optimize various aspects of a business, from customer support to sales. Its core features include bespoke chatbot creation and training them with any conceivable data source, ranging from website-generated data to personalized customer information. Furthermore, re:tune can be integrated into a wide range of existing tools to enhance their functionality with AI capabilities. Its platform is intended to be as accessible as possible, with plans to match the needs of hobbyists, startups, small businesses, and larger agencies with unique security and performance demands. For flexibility and customizability, the platform supports unlimited messages and users, web crawling, file uploads, memory allocation for chatbots, and even custom white-labeled branding. The commitment to adaptability also extends to application integration and custom trained fine-tuned models. The platform promises early access to new features and prioritized feature requests as part of their offering. In summary, re:tune provides a user-friendly, efficient, and customizable solution for building AI applications that can help drive a business forward universally.

name: PalmAI
description: Palm is an AI-powered platform for skill and career management. It offers a range of modules designed to help businesses manage their human capital effectively. The platform uses AI to automatically map skills and provides real-time visualization of the skills gap within an organization. With Palm, businesses can easily identify the skills employees possess and the skills they need to acquire, allowing for targeted training and development.One of Palm's key features is its ability to map job positions and skills. The AI technology extracts skills from job descriptions and assesses their mastery level. This enables businesses to quickly map and catalog all the skills within their organization.Palm also provides career path planning capabilities. The platform helps organizations create personalized career paths for employees by identifying possible career advancements and alternative career paths. These pathways can be based on horizontal or vertical transitions, allowing employees to explore different career options.Furthermore, Palm helps businesses foster employee engagement and retention by presenting internal opportunities to employees. With the platform, employees can easily access information regarding internal projects, job vacancies, and mentoring discussions, ensuring that opportunities for growth and development are visible to all employees.The platform also facilitates people review at scale. Palm helps identify top talent through collaborative assessments with managers and offers a customizable 9-box grid for talent positioning. It then suggests appropriate training and development opportunities for each individual, as well as relevant projects to gain experience.Palm aims to break down silos within organizations and promote talent mobility, resulting in reduced turnover, improved employee engagement, and optimized skill management.

name: Paragraph AI
description: ParagraphAI is an AI-driven writing assistant that helps users write better, faster, and more accurately. It offers a range of features to make writing easier, including grammar, spelling, and vocabulary checks, as well as plagiarism detection. It also provides automated responses to emails, messages, comments, and other tasks. ParagraphAI can generate 99.99% plagiarism-free content with a personalized style and tone, and it can be used to write paragraphs, emails, lists, articles, translations, blog posts, outlines, ad copy, product descriptions, technical manuals, song lyrics, poetry, reports, newsletters, and stories. Additionally, it is trusted by some of the world's leading companies such as Amazon, MIT, Uber, Oracle, Harvard, Samsung, Pepsi, Meta Platforms Inc., and RBC Royal Bank. It can be accessed through its Chrome plugin, iOS and Android apps.

name: Stockimg AI
description: Stockimg.AI is an AI image generation tool designed to make it easy to generate AI logos, book covers, posters, and more. The tool offers a wide range of categories, including stock images, book covers, posters, wallpapers, logos, illustrations, icons, and web and mobile UI. The tool also includes a free trial and an AI-made images section to help users get started. The tool is designed to be user-friendly and easy to use, allowing users to generate images in seconds. In addition, the tool has a contact page, privacy policy, and terms of service page. Finally, users can follow Stockimg.AI on Twitter, Instagram, and TikTok for updates and assistance.

name: Hubble.team
description: Hubble is an in-product user research and feedback platform that enables companies to create world-class products by gathering high-quality contextual feedback from targeted users. With Hubble, companies can collect in-product feedback through SDK, prototype concept testing and create qualitative research questions and build study templates through the use of ChatGPT by OpenAI. It also allows companies to segment users based on their attributes and track results in real-time for summary analysis and create beautiful reports. Heat maps and video clips are also available for understanding customer flow. Companies can also create customized, unmoderated studies to collect any type of product feedback from usability testing to feature satisfaction. All this is available in a user-friendly platform that makes product research 10x easier.

name: ArtBot.ai
description: ArtBot.ai is a dynamic tool leveraging artificial intelligence to craft impeccable Halloween-themed artwork. It simplifies the process of creating custom art, providing a distinct advantage for users lacking advanced design skills. Users input a few short descriptions or attributes of the desired artwork, and the AI system utilizes this to generate the corresponding piece of art. This inventive tool shifts the focus from manual creation to a more automated, AI-infused process. With an ability to shape art around specific themes like Halloween, it provides an unprecedented avenue to generate unique, event-specific art pieces. Though primarily designed with Halloween art in mind, its functionality may extend to other custom thematic artwork. ArtBot.ai makes an excellent tool for content creators, social media managers, event planners and individuals seeking to generate tailor-made art efficiently. Its AI-driven nature aids in reducing time and effort spent on the often cumbersome process of generating thematic artworks manually, which is especially beneficial for users facing tight deadlines.
features: ✅ Efficient tool for social media managers

name: Unfake
description: Unfake.png by Gaspard+Bruno is an AI tool which can transform fake.png images into true, background-less .png files. It is powered by VISIO Studio, and is free to use. To use the tool, users simply upload their image, which can be up to 200MB in size, and the AI will automatically clean the fake transparency grid out of the image. The final image can then be downloaded instantly. Unfake.png is offered by Gaspard+Bruno Ltd, a company incorporated and registered in England and Wales with company number 09363056 and VAT number GB257596750. Additionally, Unfake.png has an Android and iOS app, a Figma Plugin and a Chrome extension. It has offices in Lisbon, Portugal and London, UK.

name: Klu AI
description: Klu is an AI-powered internal search engine designed to help teams locate information across various cloud-based applications quickly. The tool allows users to connect their different apps for seamless searching and organizing of data and documents. By using natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning, Klu can scan and search through all files, messages, and conversations for information that teams need. Its intuitive design and advanced search functionality make it easier for teams to collaborate and improve productivity by finding relevant information faster. Klu ensures the privacy and security of all data by encrypting data in transit and at rest. Additionally, all integrations connected to Klu are only visible to the user, and disconnecting an app immediately removes any data attached to it. The tool is available as a Google Chrome extension and can be downloaded on MacIntel Processor and Apple Silicon devices. Klu’s features and benefits have been positively reviewed by users, highlighting how it has enhanced their productivity and helped find information quickly. The tool is currently in public beta and is funded by Antler VC.
features: ✅ Data encryption in transit and at rest

name: AI Photo - Stable Diffusion Text-to-Image
description: AI Photo is an artificial intelligence tool that uses Stable Diffusion to convert text prompts into images. Encased within a user-friendly interface, the tool is currently facilitated on iOS, macOS, and iPadOS. AI Photo operates fully offline and is designed with privacy in mind. It ensures none of your text prompts or resultant images are sent outside your device. For safety, it is programmed to avoid accidentally generating harmful or offensive content. The utility of the tool is augmented by its compatibility with custom CoreML models for research purposes. A special feature of this tool is its implementation of SafetyChecker files while using these custom models. AI Photo functions optimally with higher RAM availability. The developer, App ahead GmbH, positions this tool as a catalyst for creative individuals, promoting the exploration of prompt-based image generation. AI Photo is ideal for users who prioritize data privacy and the capacity to operate offline.

name: Subtxt
description: Subtxt is an AI-powered storytelling tool designed to help writers craft complete stories with greater precision and clarity. It provides users with a narrative framework to help identify and enhance a story, as well as an AI writing assistant to offer guidance and feedback. Subtxt also features a unique structure that is designed to capture the audience's attention, and a library of examples to draw creative inspiration from. Subtxt also uses the four Throughlines to provide a solid foundation and encourages users to explore new avenues of creativity to bring their stories to life. Subtxt has been developed by an experienced writer and storyteller in the film and television industry, and has been praised by notable people in the industry for its ability to uncover the deeper meaning of stories.

name: Dystr
description: Dystr is an artificial intelligence (AI) based analysis platform that's crafted to streamline and automate workflows. Leveraging the power of AI, Dystr seeks to revolutionize the manner in which tasks and processes are managed by providing dynamic solutions that take into account myriad variables, opportunities, and challenges. This platform's primary utility lies in its potential to reduce manual effort and time-intensive processes, thereby enhancing efficiency and productivity outcomes. Equipped with AI technology, Dystr is capable of performing complex analysis which can be potentially instrumental in data-driven decision making. It can automate repetitive tasks, enabling users to place their focus on more critical issues that demand their attention. Dystr's AI-powered capabilities provide for intuitive user experience, unearthing valuable insights from data to support strategic initiatives. Its user-friendly interface offers a supportive environment that is designed for individuals from various expertise levels. However, despite its broad methodological provisions, it maintains a keen focus on providing customized interaction for users, in order to cater to specific business requirements. Ultimately, Dystr stands as a tool that facilitates effective integration of AI into regular workflows, promoting an advanced and evolved work approach.

name: Codiga
description: Codiga is an AI-powered static code analysis tool that can be used in any development environment, including VS Code, JetBrains, VisualStudio, GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket. It provides customizable static code analysis with secure code analysis, automated code reviews, and code snippets.The static code analysis feature allows users to create their own static code analysis rules in 5 minutes and works with rules from the Codiga Hub. It also offers automated code fixes for vulnerabilities and coding issues in a single click. Additionally, it offers security-focused code analysis with support for OWASP 10, MITRE CWE and SANS/CWE Top 25.In addition, Codiga offers automated code reviews with support for more than 12 languages and 1800+ rules for 12+ languages. It also provides multi-branches support and works with the most popular languages and libraries.Lastly, Codiga offers code snippets which can be used to create and share smart code snippets with the world or with your team. It allows users to create code snippets in a click and share private code snippets with the team. It also provides access to a large collection of code snippets available in the IDE.

name: Chatbot Daddy
description: Chatbot Daddy is an intuitive tool designed to simplify the construction of chatbots and conversational forms. It is an accessible chatbot builder requiring no coding skills, offering a solution for automating customer interactions, helping customers select suitable products, and generating leads. Users can create and manage their chatbots through the Chatbot Daddy application, eliminating the need for consistent IT support.Chatbot Daddy allows users to embed their constructed chatbots onto their websites or establish standalone conversational landing pages, aiming to increase conversion rates and lead collection. Furthermore, it enhances user engagement by transforming traditionally dull forms into interactive, conversational interfaces.The tool also facilitates automation of various business processes. These include product recommendations, lead collection, leads scoring, sales automation, and form and settings customization without the need for IT specialists. Additionally, it can auto-upload leads into a user's Customer Relationship Management tool and send email notifications.In a unique feature, the platform provides an option to code the chatbot using human-readable code inspired by markdown. This empowers users with technical expertise to create, share, or sell chatbot templates in the form of text files, providing an additional degree of flexibility.Built to be used anywhere, you can link your chatbot to various applications you frequently use, subscribe users to newsletters, and receive email notifications. The interactive builder makes the process as simple as creating a Word document, making it an effortless experience for users.

name: Creatosaurus
description: Creatosaurus is an all-in-one creative and marketing platform designed to streamline the workflow and enable scalable marketing strategies for marketing teams. It offers a comprehensive set of features that span from curation and collaboration to creation, distribution, analytics, and apps.One of the notable features of Creatosaurus is its AI content writer, which allows users to generate marketing copies at scale in a matter of minutes. It also provides an easy-to-use design editor for creating beautiful graphics, with drag and drop functionality and access to free stock images and templates.The platform includes a hashtag manager that helps users find and manage hashtags to optimize their social media workflow, as well as a quote finder that allows users to search and save quotes for later use. It also offers the ability to schedule social media posts across different platforms.Creatosaurus is built for companies with distributed teams and global creative individuals, providing a centralized workspace for creators and marketers. It aims to combine productivity and creativity by offering a range of tools and features in one place, enabling efficient collaboration and improving the overall storytelling process.The platform is supported by deep integrations with other popular apps, allowing users to connect their favorite tools and stay on top of their work. It is designed to be user-friendly, offering a transparent and simple experience for every team member.Creatosaurus is used by influencers, creators, publishers, startups, and brands worldwide as a powerful tool in their marketing strategies. It aims to provide a complete solution for all creative and marketing needs, allowing users to focus on telling impactful stories while the platform takes care of everything else.

name: Yellow
description: Yellow.ai is an AI-powered tool that offers Enterprise GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) for autonomous customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX). It enables businesses to automate interactions with customers and employees across various channels and languages, delivering actionable outcomes while reducing costs.The tool provides a Dynamic Automation Platform (DAP) that combines Generative AI with Enterprise-level Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate chat and voice automation. Built on multi-LLM architecture, DAP continuously trains on billions of conversations for scalability, speed, and accuracy. It can automate conversations across channels, reducing operational costs.Yellow.ai leverages the latest advancements in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and generative AI to deliver human-like and context-aware conversations. It aims to exceed customer expectations by providing empathetic interactions.With advanced ML and NLP technologies, Yellow.ai continuously learns to improve understanding and personalize responses. It offers zero-setup bot deployment, allowing users to create and deploy bots quickly by uploading documents, connecting to desired channels, and designing dynamic conversation flows.The tool emphasizes enterprise-grade security, boasting ISO, HIPAA, SOC2, and GDPR certifications to protect sensitive data and maintain industry-leading security and compliance practices.Yellow.ai also provides advanced analytics to enhance customer and employee satisfaction through real-time bot insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and improved business outcomes.Overall, Yellow.ai empowers businesses to transform their operations through AI-powered automation, delivering 24/7 customer support, automating employee interactions, and streamlining marketing efforts, all while saving time and costs.

name: Snipd
description: Snipd is a tool designed to provide high-quality AI-generated summaries for podcasts. Utilizing OpenAIs ChatGPT, Snipd is capable of listening to an entire podcast episode, extracting and surfacing the best ideas and key insights. This allows users to get a quick overview of a podcast and review important points, whether they are on the go or multitasking. Users can explore summaries related to a wide range of topics and jump into the full episode directly from the summary. Moreover, Snipd offers an option to both read and listen to these summaries. This tool is a useful resource for podcast enthusiasts, providing an efficient way to discover new podcasts and gain access to knowledge quickly in a digestible format. It's easy to use and accessible on multiple platforms.
features: ✅ Option to jump directly into full episode from summary

name: Unpromptedgame
description: Unprompted is an A.I. image guessing game that challenges users to guess the words used to create A.I. images. The game is simple to play - users type words into a text box and press “Guess” to submit. If the guess is correct, the words will appear in place of blanks. Three new images are available to play every day. The “Yesterday” tab allows players to view the answers from previous days. Unprompted also features social media sharing buttons for Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp and ShareThis. These buttons allow users to share their progress with friends and family. Unprompted is a fun, engaging way to learn more about A.I. and hone creative thinking skills.

name: Fobizz
description: Fobizz Tools is a suite of digital tools assisted by AI, specifically designed for schools. The toolset provides an array of functionalities from font-end user interface to in-depth data analysis, aimed at promoting efficient learning processes and easing classroom management. These tools are developed with and for teachers, with a focus on simplicity, privacy, and security. Fobizz Tools are also GDPR-compliant, ensuring that the collection and use of data adhere to the legal guidelines for data protection. Due to its reliance on JavaScript for optimum functionality, users are recommended to ensure that JavaScript is enabled in their browser settings. Notably, Fobizz Tools underscores an attention to privacy, adding an extra layer of trust in its service. This toolset, therefore, serves as a comprehensive resource for digital education, facilitating seamless and secure integration of AI-assisted tools in the learning environment.

name: Xpeacho
description: Xpeacho Best AI-Based Text to Speech is an online tool that allows users to convert any text into a natural-sounding voiceover in just a few clicks. It is specifically designed for video creators and offers an alternative to traditional text-to-speech (TTS) engines. The tool supports over 80 languages and provides access to 880 voices, with continuous updates and expansion of the available options. Users can choose between standard voices and AI voices (also known as Neural Voices). Standard voices come at a lower cost, while AI voices offer smoother and more fluent speech.Xpeacho offers flexible pricing models, including Pay-As-You-Go, Package, and Subscription options. Payments can be made via PayPal or Credit Card, allowing users to start using the service at a minimal cost.The tool is versatile and can be used for various purposes, such as creating professional narrations for YouTube videos, marketing content, tutorial content, news narrations, audiobooks, podcasts, presentations, business content, customer support audios, call center audios, voice assistants, and documentary audio.Xpeacho has received positive feedback from users worldwide, with praises for its user-friendly features, wide range of voice options, and convenience. The tool offers a unique TTS engine, allowing users to define word pronunciation and adjust speech speed. While it currently supports a substantial number of languages, the language options are expected to expand over time.Users can stay updated with the latest information from Xpeacho by following their social media platforms.

name: Stable UI
description: Stable UI is a unique tool that leverages the power of Stable Diffusion to facilitate the creation and modification of images. It is designed to empower users with an uninterruptedly creative platform to freely generate distinct visual content. Stable UI works by using Stable Diffusion, a technique that allows for the inception and manipulation of images. This tool is built to unlock endless creative potential, as it furnishes users with the means to author visually appealing graphics without any imposed limitations. Considerably user-friendly, the Stable UI is marked by its capacity to accommodate users of different expertise levels. The Stable Horde feature incorporated in the Stable UI extends the tool's functionality by enabling users to generate unique, personalized images, providing an enhanced customizability that greatly fuels creativity. All in all, Stable UI is much more than a simple image creation tool; it's an extension of your creative mind that can be leveraged to transform your artistic concepts into aesthetically pleasing visuals.
features: ✅ Range of models to choose from
✅ Suitable for users of different expertise

name: Nureply
description: Nureply is a cold email software that uses advanced AI technology to personalize emails, rewrite content, and send out emails with maximum efficiency. It is designed to help outbound teams generate more sales and more revenue with its suite of AI-driven tools. Nureply's AI model has been trained on over 1 billion parameters to ensure that emails are written with a mix of human and artificial intelligence. It is also capable of automatically creating email campaigns and scheduling follow-ups for months in advance. Furthermore, the AI model can optimize campaigns for key performance indicators (KPIs) such as open rates, response rates, and click-through rates.Nureply also offers features such as one-click cancellation, no contract, and zero chances of emails landing in the spam folder. It also offers a spam keyword checker to ensure emails get delivered to the right inbox. Additionally, Nureply can generate personalized first lines in seconds and is 3x faster than any other AI tool. With Nureply, users can save up to 200 minutes per day and increase response rates by up to 240%. Lastly, Nureply offers a 7-day free trial with 30 free credits to try out all its features.

name: AI-Responder for HostAway
description: AI-Responder for HostAway, developed by AI Duh, is a Chrome extension designed to significantly optimize writing time by generating AI-powered responses. The inherent purpose of this tool is to automate written communication for hosts, specifically catered towards the HostAway platform.The AI Responder draws from three information sources to generate informed responses: Property-Specific Knowledge Document, Guest Data, and Previous Chat History. The Property-Specific Knowledge Document aids the AI in answering property-related queries with a comprehensive text of up to 800 words. Guest Data includes reservation details like the guest's name, dates, check-in and check-out times, and so on. Lastly, incorporating the Previous Chat History ensures continuity of conversation.The AI used in beta tests is interchangeably OpenAI GPT3 Davinci-003 and GPT NeoX 20B, both of which are known to deliver high-quality text often indistinguishable from human-written texts. The responses generated are reliable, needing no edits in most cases and thus can be directly provided to the guests.While the primary platform is HostAway, and the primary browser Chrome, potential extensions to mobile, other platforms, and browsers are under process. Any queries regarding the tool can be forwarded to the official communication email of AI Duh.

name: Generai
description: Generai is an AI-powered platform designed to transform creative ideas into reality. It is a powerful tool for creating artwork from simple descriptions and is ideal for businesses and artists alike. With Generai, users can provide a brief description of their desired artwork and the platform’s AI artists will take over from there, creating a unique image based on the words provided. Generai’s AI artists use the latest algorithms and hardware to produce high-resolution 4K+ images with a high level of detail. The platform also offers a smart prompting system that helps users find the perfect description for their artwork. Generai also provides consulting services for businesses, as well as free worldwide shipping on canvas prints, poster prints, and aluminum prints. To ensure privacy and security, Generai uses cookies to store information while providing users with a better, faster, and safer experience.

name: Ginimachine
description: GiniMachine is an AI Automated Decision Making Platform offering dedicated decision-making software primarily for financial-based business predictions, which includes banks, lenders, telecom companies, and auto dealers. The tool offers a range of solutions such as Credit Risk Management, Credit Scoring, Collection Scoring, Application Scoring, and Predictive Analytics. These solutions are aimed at enhancing decision-making processes, and reducing risks through AI-powered underwriting and credit scoring. It also helps in prioritising debtors and suggesting the most efficient collection tools. GiniMachine is built to process large volumes of historical data for generating, validating, and deploying predictive models with high speed.GiniMachine also provides data provision and data preparation services, offering AI assistance in analysing and utilising data more effectively for strategic operational decisions.Moreover, alternative lenders can use GiniMachine for scoring credit applications and loans using various alternative data sources, enhancing credit portfolio risk management. The tool facilitates automated pre-approval systems for incoming applications, saving on manual work and hastening loan approval processes. For the implementation, GiniMachine requires as little as 1000 raw records of past business decisions and their outcomes to build a predictive model. The model then validates itself for its accuracy and suitability for business forecasting.
features: ✅ Bespoke lending solutions for banks and fintech

name: Jinnee for Fintech
description: Jinnee is an AI-bot designed for fintech applications. It supports first-line customer interactions by automating the response process to customer inquiries. With the ability to operate round the clock, Jinnee alleviates long waiting times that could be caused by time zone differences or high volumes of support requests. It tackles common and repetitive questions, reducing the burden on human support staff and improving efficiency in the workplace.Beyond basic customer support, Jinnee also functions as a virtual financial advisor providing personalized banking services. By utilizing Jinnee, customers can ask questions and receive replies promptly, including information related to their spending patterns, savings plans, deposit options, and budgets. The bot is capable of suggesting relevant financial products and solutions, personalized to the customer's needs and background.Furthermore, Jinnee is built for enhancing marketing strategies. The tool collects and analyzes all inquiries, providing valuable insight into client needs and wants. This information can be used to adjust the bot's behavior, continually improving its performance and potentially deriving new solutions from the identified patterns.Jinnee comes equipped with features for making polls and complex chatbots using clear visual interfaces and ready-made templates. With real-time analytics, users can monitor key metrics to improve the performance of their AI bot.The tool uses advanced technologies such as natural language processing (NLP) and automated learning to improve customer satisfaction. It's capable of identifying and learning from clients' intents, adapting over time for a more personalized user experience. Furthermore, Jinnee can swiftly locate documents in corporate storage and deliver them to clients, providing quick access to information.

name: Avanzai
description: Avanzai allows you to build autonomous AI agents for finance. These agents can leverage tools to automate portfolio management, stock screening, risk management and scenario analysis.

name: Signapse
description: Signapse AI is an artificial intelligence tool designed to break barriers by providing automatic sign language translation with a photo-realistic synthetic signer. The tool is created to solve challenging technical problems that have a genuine social good and offers access to sign language translation and interpretation solutions for clients. Signapse AI has a team of entrepreneurs, engineers, and researchers who build high-quality artificial intelligence solutions to enable accessibility for Deaf people to broadcast media, public spaces, and websites. Signapse AI uses synthetic signers who translate audio, text, and video in real-time. The synthetic signers are based on actual video footage of translators who are compensated each time their image is used commercially. The tool provides visual anonymization of sign language content online to enable safe sharing, and all personal data is deleted within seven days. Signapse AI is built on world-leading research and allows organisations to provide great access to Deaf people. The tool is designed to provide accessibility to an audience of up to 80,000 Deaf people. Signapse AI seeks forward-thinking clients that aim to build the next generation of access for sign language users and values working with those who want to be part of the future of equality, are commercially astute and able to effect change from within their organization. Signapse AI has partnerships with peerless quality of service and clarity of vision that includes cultural and linguistic ownership of sign by the Deaf Community. Signapse AI provides employment opportunities at Surrey Technology Centre, Guildford, Surrey.

name: Blush
description: Blush is an AI-powered dating simulator that offers a safe and fun environment for users to learn and practice relationship skills. It provides a judgment-free space for refining communication and relationship dynamics, helping users gain a better understanding of relationships and navigate various situations. Blush also allows users to experiment with different approaches to flirting and communication, building confidence in a secure space free from the fear of rejection or embarrassment.The tool offers a unique feature of providing companionship and emotional support through conversations with AI characters. This can be particularly helpful for individuals dealing with isolation or facing challenging emotional situations, allowing them to feel more connected and understood.Blush encourages users to explore their desires, creating room for fantasy and excitement in their daily routines. This can have a positive impact on mental well-being and reduce stress levels, promoting authenticity and nurturing imagination and creativity.Users have the opportunity to meet potential matches, each with their own unique personality and relationship style. By engaging with these characters, users can develop deeper connections and potentially find their next crush.Blush has been praised by users for its ease of conversation, the ability to notice communication patterns, and its assistance in overcoming social anxiety. The success of users in real-life relationships serves as a testament to the effectiveness of AI dating.Overall, Blush provides a valuable platform for individuals to develop and improve their relationship skills, supporting them in building stronger and more fulfilling connections in the real world.

name: PlagAI
description: Plag.ai Plagiarism Checker is a comprehensive tool designed for detecting plagiarism in various types of documents. It employs an AI-driven system to provide unique and precise plagiarism detection results. Its comparison database contains billions of articles, allowing a broad spectrum for cross-checking and verification. This product is predominantly used by educational institutions across the globe for checking scientific articles, thesis, research papers, essays, and other academic documents. The software offers a freemium model, where users can get approximate plagiarism scores for their papers for free before deciding to purchase a detailed report. The tool also extends its utility for different use-cases like checking for plagiarism in website content, duplicate content in papers and articles. It's operational and highly functional across multiple languages, making it a globally accepted platform for plagiarism checks.One of the unique value propositions of Plag.ai is the partnership with heavyweight data aggregators like CORE that allow the tool to cross-verify papers against a vast database of scientific articles. The service assures full confidentiality and does not share any personal data with third parties. It has been in operation for more than 10 years and is endorsed by many of its users across various demographics, including students, educators, and professionals.

name: Dezgo
description: Dezgo’s Free Text-to-Image Stable Diffusion AI Generator is a tool that allows users to generate high-quality images from any text prompt. It uses a combination of AI technology and a sampling method called DPMSeed to create the images. The AI technology is Stable Diffusion 1.5, which can be adjusted to fit the text prompt more strictly or to provide more freedom in its interpretation. The user can also specify the aspect ratio of the image, such as portrait, square, or landscape. To further refine the image, the user can provide a negative prompt, which describes what should not be included in the image. The output of the AI is provided under the terms of the CreativeML Open RAIL-M license. Additionally, the user has the ability to manage their privacy preferences, such as allowing or rejecting certain types of data processing, or selecting certain types of personalized ads and content. The user can also opt in or out of allowing their device to be identified by scanning its unique characteristics.

name: Prezo
description: PrezoPage is a versatile tool that aids in building presentations, documents, and websites using artificial intelligence. This AI-driven technology primarily functions as a comprehensive presentation canvas, designed to enhance and streamline the workflow. It features a unique offering in the form of interactive blocks, enabling users to create dynamic and visually appealing content with ease. These extend not only to slide presentations, but also to digital documents and websites. This aspect of PrezoPage provides users with wide-ranging flexibility in their content creation processes. The platform is characterized by its focus on AI-first operations, positioning it at the forefront of the new generation of tech-savvy presentation tools. A significant feature of PrezoPage is its shareability, as users can disseminate their creations to their desired audience at a click, promoting seamless information exchange. Overall, PrezoPage is a holistic, AI-integrated solution that seeks to transform the usual tasks of creating slides, docs, and websites into a more enhanced and efficient experience.

name: ResearchAI
description: Research AI is an AI-powered tool designed to assist creators in writing course content and marketing materials more efficiently. It utilizes the power of deep learning algorithms to deliver high-quality copywriting. With Research AI, creators can generate impactful and easily understandable course content, as well as engaging marketing content such as ads, videos, sales pages, and emails. The tool also offers AI-driven editing tools, eliminating the need to worry about grammar rules. This frees up time for creators and their staff to focus on other important tasks. Research AI can help increase both student engagement and marketing performance, including conversions, while reducing costs. Additionally, the tool supports the development of new ideas to expand and improve courses. Research AI provides a range of powerful features, including research briefs for detailed and well-researched articles, AI templates for various types of content, keyword research for marketing purposes, and more. The platform is easy to use and navigate, and it offers integration with SEMrush. Research AI is suitable for course creators, marketing teams, and entrepreneurs looking to create compelling content to empower students, drive interest, and communicate effectively with their target audience.

name: CHCKR
description: CHCKR is an AI application essay coach that provides instant essay scoring, feedback, and recommendations on how to improve. It evaluates multiple dimensions of your writing, including essay structure, flow, syntax, and grammar, in seconds. By taking a funnel approach, it first assesses what you write and then how well you write it. This tool is designed to catch common issues such as topic jumping, conflicting plots, inefficient sentence structures, and poor word choice.With CHCKR, you receive instant feedback that includes actionable recommendations, a detailed explanation of why changes are necessary, and illustrative examples of good and bad writing. It offers dynamic feedback tailored to address your biggest gaps and prioritizes the aspects of your essay that require attention based on its maturity. Additionally, it provides live editing and real-time refresh functionality, allowing you to iterate and improve rapidly.CHCKR leverages over 50 proprietary machine learning and natural language processing algorithms, as well as a vast database of essays, to make highly individualized suggestions on how you can enhance your essay. It generates a succinct summary report that highlights the key strengths and weaknesses of your application essay, helping you understand what is working well and where to focus your efforts. The tool is available for a one-time payment of $9.99, and there is an option for group membership for institutions with custom pricing. CHCKR aims to empower every applicant to tell a structured, insightful, and memorable personal story to admissions.

name: AI Art Latitude
description: AI Art is a platform that enables users to create, view, and share art generated by artificial intelligence. AI Art uses a variety of models to generate images, including Stable Diffusion, Disco Diffusion, Pixray, and VQGAN. Stable Diffusion is a text-to-image model, meaning users can type in a phrase and the model will generate an image based on the input. Disco Diffusion is a slow but high-quality model for generating scenes, while Pixray and VQGAN generate abstract and surreal images. AI Art provides users with a unique and creative way to explore the possibilities of AI-generated art.

name: Langame card game
description: Lang Game is an AI-generated conversation card game designed to be enjoyed with friends and family. Using a swiping mechanism, users can select which cards should be part of their personalized deck. These cards are grouped into different categories such as Ice Breaker, Philosophy, Deep Talk, Education, Self Exploration, Relationship, Entrepreneurship, Science, and Startup. These cards provide topics and conversation starters to be used during game play. The game is available for pre-order for $25 and comes with a set of 20 cards. Users can also add their own questions to the deck. The game helps to facilitate meaningful conversations and encourages users to explore new topics.

name: SHUFFLL
description: SHUFFLL is an advanced video production platform utilizing artificial intelligence to refine and expedite the content creation process. This platform provides businesses the means to generate high-quality, customized video content in a substantially shorter time as compared to conventional processes. Notably, SHUFFLL serves as a solution for the creation of branded thought leadership videos, expert videos, and testimonials. The platform features a three-step process where users can describe their video and let the AI generate appropriate scripts, art, storyline, and branding. Further customization can also be made to better match the brand's voice. In addition, it offers an integrated teleprompter feature which eliminates the need for auxiliary screens or open text files. The platform ensures high-quality recording for each video and encourages variety in video concepts. SHUFFLL provides a platform for creating diverse types of videos including thought leadership videos, marketing videos, tutorials, interviews, testimonials, and many more further enhancing brand visibility and community reach.

name: Unrealme
description: Unrealme FR/EN is a tool that uses AI to generate images of you. After you click the get button, you will be redirected to a secure payment interface where you can choose from two options - Get 50+ AI images surprise for 22€ or Choose my themes for 15€ (this can be offered as a gift for someone else). After you upload your photos, you will receive your images at the end (it might be in spams). The images are 512*512px, jpeg images and usually about 70% of pictures generated look like you.
