The models can be deployed immediately with high uptime and low latency, allowing developers to scale to millions of invokes from day one.Nyckel offers an easy-to-use UI for model training and evaluation, and users can also access the API directly for more advanced functionality. The tool provides free evaluation options, including open sign-ups, an always-free tier, and a one-month free trial at the enterprise level, with no data lock-in.Overall, Nyckel helps developers leverage the power of machine learning without the complexity, allowing them to focus on their data and problem-solving.

name: Stable Diffusion Inpainting
description: Stable Diffusion Inpainting is an AI-based tool designed to perform inpainting tasks using a technique called 'Stable Diffusion'. Inpainting task, in the realm of AI, typically involves filling in missing or corrupted parts of images with plausible data. This tool allows users to upload an image and generate results with the help of Stable Diffusion. Apart from this, the tool provides a functional API, encouraging developers to implement and interact with this tool more efficiently within their own systems and applications. A unique feature of this tool is its transparency in terms of its design and implementation, with its codebase publicly available on GitHub. This allows for a more in-depth understanding of the inner workings of the tool and potentially contributes to its improvement, making it a tool that can evolve and adapt based on user interactions and feedback. The service is hosted on Replicate, a platform known for providing open-source AI models. In summary, Stable Diffusion Inpainting is an advanced AI tool that offers a robust solution to inpainting tasks with the added benefits of accessibility and transparency.

name: Naming Magic
description: Naming Magic is a tool created by Swift Ventures + OpenAI to facilitate the process of naming a company and finding a suitable domain. It is powered by GPT-3 natural language technology and designed to be used by entrepreneurs who are in need of a creative tool to brainstorm a company name. The tool is fairly straightforward to use, as the user just needs to input a product description and a few keywords, and the AI will suggest potential ideas. Naming Magic was originally founded by the TubeMogul founders, who wish they had this tool when they had to come up with a name for their own company. They have since gone on to invest in AI and data-first businesses and are open to hearing about new ideas.

name: Smart Copy - AI Copy Assistant
description: Smart Copy, offered by Unbounce, is an AI-powered copywriting tool designed to generate on-brand, creative content effectively. This tool is designed to eliminate writers block and facilitate smooth content creation for various kinds of materials such as documents, emails, messages, posts and others. Smart Copy allows users to generate sentences, paragraphs, and even entire stories with minimal input, making it a practical solution for diverse writing projects. Users can also construct blog posts, emails, poems and more within a matter of minutes. Smart Copy is designed to ensure high-quality writing while saving time, enhancing productivity, and fostering understanding of different topics at an expert level. The tool also supports translation into over 30 languages, allowing users to cater to audiences worldwide. The AI writing assistant is equipped with a library of over 45 templates to suit different content needs. Whether brainstorming ideas for viral content or writing for various platforms, Smart Copy is designed to generate original ideas and content. The tool is available as a Web App and Chrome Extension for streamlined copywriting, and its desktop app offers a distraction-free workspace. Smart Copy can be incorporated into favorite applications for a seamless writing experience.

name: Hitpaw watermark remover
description: HitPaw Online Image Watermark Remover is an AI-powered tool designed to remove watermarks from images effectively. It is capable of handling any watermark, offering a convenient solution for users with no photo editing skills required. This tool operates online, providing users with easy access across different platforms. Whether you need to remove logos, text, or any type of watermark from your pictures, you can rely on this tool for quick and accurate results. It also promises to maintain the integrity of the original images, avoiding unnecessary blur effects. This makes it particularly handy for those who handle a lot of images and need a clean, professional final look. Besides watermark removal, HitPaw offers a variety of other AI tools to enhance, upscale, restore, and colorize photos, among other functions, making it a comprehensive toolbox for all your image editing needs.

name: Texttovoice
description: The Online Text to Speech with Emotions tool is a free online converter that allows users to convert any text into English speech using the power of AI. With a wide range of English voices available, users can create realistic and convincing voiceovers for their text. The tool offers a diverse selection of voice options, including male and female voices, as well as different emotional tones.The tool also introduces Generation 2 voices, which provide ultra-lifelike audio experiences by capturing a wide range of emotions derived from the text context. This ensures that every playback offers a unique and dynamic voice tone, enhancing the listening experience.Users can easily navigate the tool's interface, which includes features such as play, pause, and seek options for each voice sample. Moreover, the tool offers the ability to adjust the playback speed and background audio settings. Users can choose to use premium characters for background audio, but this feature requires a certain number of characters.Overall, the Online Text to Speech with Emotions tool provides a convenient and efficient way for users to convert their text into realistic English speech, allowing them to enhance their content with engaging voiceovers.

name: Writecream
description: The AI Script Generator offered by Writecream is a free tool that uses advanced AI technology to create high-quality scripts for videos or podcasts quickly and easily. It simplifies the process of script writing by generating scripts based on the topic entered by the user. The tool can be accessed through the Writecream dashboard by selecting the Command Mode. The user needs to enter an elaborative version of the topic for which a video or podcast script is required, and the AI tool generates compelling results within seconds. In case the initial response is unsatisfactory, the user can re-click the generate button for another story on the same topic and instructions. This AI-powered writing tool is highly versatile and user-friendly. It helps video content creators to enhance accuracy, productivity, and creativity while producing high-quality content without putting in hours of brainstorming, reading, and editing. Using this script generator can save time and effort. Scriptwriting is an essential component of video editing, and no professional video can be produced without an excellent and proper script. This tool can help writers, content creators, and not-so-professional writers to generate scripts quickly with no credit card required and free forever, with an option to upgrade as business grows.

name: Flair
description: Flair is an AI-powered design tool for branded content. It enables users to create visually stunning content with just a few clicks. With a drag and drop interface, users can upload their own branded assets onto a flexible canvas and build a scene around their product with the help of accessories. Flair also features smart prompt recommendations and an autocomplete feature to help users communicate with the AI. Tutorials are also available to help users learn how to make the most of the tool. Furthermore, users can explore examples of user-generated content and watch a demo video to quickly get started. Flair is currently in private beta and offers a free trial.

name: Slideas
description: Slideas.ai is an AI-powered presentation assistant that enables users to quickly and easily create high quality presentations and slide decks. It allows users to choose a topic for their presentation and automatically generates headlines and talking points for them. It also has an easy-to-use Notion-like editor that enables users to edit, add, or remove headlines, bullet points, and texts. Users can present their slides directly from within Slideas or export to Google Slides or PowerPoint. It also has real-time collaboration features that allow users to work on the presentation with their team members. It has two pricing plans - a free plan that includes unlimited personal decks, export to Google Slides and access to all themes, and a pro plan that includes all the features of the free plan plus team collaboration, export to PowerPoint, theme customization, brand guidelines, and real-time capabilities.
features: ✅ Unlimited personal decks in free plan
✅ Includes team collaboration in pro plan

name: Grit.io
description: Grit is an AI tool that automates the process of fixing technical debt in code. It achieves this by combining static analysis with machine learning techniques to generate pull requests that clean up code and migrate it to the latest frameworks. The tool offers users the option to either write their own migrations or use default migrations that are available. By putting code migrations and dependency upgrades on autopilot, Grit helps save time and improve developer velocity. It enables high-velocity software teams to move faster by automating maintenance tasks, allowing them to complete migrations up to 10 times faster than manual efforts. Grit can be accessed from multiple platforms, including GitHub, VS Code, and the command line, ensuring seamless integration into existing workflows. The tool is trusted by beta customers and has successfully generated tens of thousands of changes.The underlying technology of Grit is based on machine learning and static analysis. The tool utilizes pattern matching to identify areas of code that require migration or cleaning up. For example, it can convert JavaScript to TypeScript, convert class components to functional components, and convert JavaScript to arrow functions. Grit also supports migrations from AngularJS to Angular.Overall, Grit is a powerful tool that streamlines the process of fixing technical debt and upgrading code by leveraging the capabilities of machine learning and static analysis.

name: Plagiarismremover
description: Plagiarism Remover is an AI-based tool designed to eliminate plagiarism and generate unique content. It offers four different modes to cater to various needs. The basic mode, "Plagiarism Remover," utilizes synonymizing and sentence structure alteration to eliminate plagiarism from the inputted text. The "Word Changer" mode focuses specifically on changing words in the content. The "Formal" mode gives the content a professional and concise look, while the "Shorten" mode reduces its length while ensuring it remains plagiarism-free.The tool employs modern algorithms, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Deep Learning technology to rewrite content accurately, maintaining the original context. It supports users in over 15 languages, making it globally accessible. Users can either paste the content or upload a file for analysis. After plagiarism removal, the resulting unique content can be downloaded in either .txt or .docx format.Plagiarism Remover is a cost-effective solution that can be used for articles, essays, research papers, and other written content. By offering human-level plagiarism removal, it ensures 100% uniqueness and smooth language flow. Users looking to maintain a good reputation and avoid the negative consequences of using plagiarized content can greatly benefit from this tool. The advanced features, such as multiple language support and different modes, distinguish Plagiarism Remover from other similar tools.

name: Face Swapper
description: FaceSwapper is an online tool that enables users to seamlessly swap faces in photos and videos. It is free and unlimited, allowing users to upload a photo or drag and drop a .jpg or .png file. The tool then automatically swaps the faces in the photo or video, giving the user a realistic result. The user can then hover the mouse on the face to see the difference. FaceSwapper is easy to use and does not require any technical skills. It is also secure, with a Privacy Policy and Terms of Service in place to protect user data. FaceSwapper is fast and reliable, and can be used for a variety of applications such as entertainment, education, and research.

name: Wonderslide
description: Wonderslide is an AI-powered presentation maker that offers a fast and easy way to design stunning presentations. With Wonderslide, users can upload their draft slides and the AI designer, powered by a neural network, quickly finds the perfect design for their presentation. The finished presentation is ready for downloading in just a few seconds. One of the key features of Wonderslide is the ease of making changes to the design or color scheme of a slide with just a single click. The AI designer takes care of all the necessary adjustments, eliminating the need for users to go through unnecessary settings. The tool also allows for customization and branding, enabling users to choose colors, fonts, and styles that align with their company's brand book, and add a logo to all slides. Friendly interaction is another advantage of Wonderslide, as it works seamlessly with PowerPoint and Google Slides files. The AI designer arranges and aligns all the elements, returning a file that users can further edit if needed. Wonderslide is popular among professionals from medium and small companies who want to save time on designing presentations and focus on more important tasks. It is particularly beneficial for people like sales representatives, HR managers, and marketing associates who can't spend much time on design.The tool offers a free trial period of 7 days, during which users can process unlimited draft files and preview designs. Wonderslide also provides flexible pricing plans, including a yearly plan with a 40% discount and a monthly plan, giving users full access to all features. Enterprise plans are available as well, offering customization options to suit the specific needs of companies. In the future, Wonderslide aims to improve composition for slides with tables, charts, and schemes, as well as create impressive graphs and charts from user data. Users are encouraged to share their feedback with the team for continuous improvement.
features: ✅ Seamless integration with PowerPoint and Google Slides

name: HotConvo
description: HotConvo is an AI tool designed to improve and personalise your online dating chats. It works by providing engaging chat suggestions based on your conversation style and the context of your interactions, helping you break the ice, maintain the flow of conversation, and establish meaningful connections. Functionality includes the ability to upload screenshots of profiles and ongoing conversations from any dating app, which the AI then analyses to offer diverse chat suggestions. Alternatively, users can manually enter text of interest for personalised recommendations. HotConvo does not aim to autocomplete your chats, but to provide witty and interesting suggestions that inspire your own messaging, thereby helping improve your overall conversation skills. The tool assures security and privacy as any uploaded screenshots are not stored and no personal information is processed. Available across all major dating platforms like Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, Coffee Meets Bagel, and OkCupid, HotConvo caters to all genders and sexual orientations, offering a versatile solution for initiating conversation or revitalizing ongoing chats.

name: Arcwise
description: Arcwise is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) analysis tool primarily designed to enhance the analysis process within Google Sheets. The principal operation of Arcwise is to function on top of the user's data, thereby streamlining the process of data analysis. The tool dispenses with the need for specialized knowledge in data analytics, making it easily accessible to a broad audience. Arcwise aims to simplify data analysis by providing a platform where regular Google Sheets users can execute complex analyses within an environment they are already comfortable with. In essence, this tool translates and performs data analysis processes directly in Google Sheets, allowing for immediate implementation. The purpose is to foster a self-service analytical toolset that is easy to use for anyone, making data analysis more holistic and accessible. Thus, Arcwise is positioned as an AI analyst that complements Google Sheets by providing robust analytical capabilities.

name: Document Crunch
description: Document Crunch is an AI-assisted platform designed to simplify and streamline contract review in the construction industry. Notably, the tool helps in the identification of critical risks within construction contracts, thus reducing the time usually spent on contract reviews. With this system, construction professionals can become empowered with a thorough comprehension of their contracts, ensuring clarity and eliminating guesswork with regards to contract specifics. The platform provides a 'Project Playbook', a condensed reference guide designed to demystify legal language and make contract terms easily understandable. It also offers a standardized review process intended to make contract review consistent, measurable, and repeatable. Additionally, Document Crunch includes a 'Chat with Your Contract' feature, which presumably provides interactive contract understanding and clarification. The platform integrates with other key software in the construction industry, like Procore, enhancing its collaborative capabilities. Document Crunch assists in advancing contract risk review and compliance in construction projects, which contributes to more effective project management and potential profitability protection.

name: DipSway Crypto Trading AI bot
description: DipSway is a cryptocurrency trading AI bot designed to offer automation in the space of crypto trading. The bot operates automatically, executing trades 24/7 on a user-friendly interface. The bot is primarily designed to remove manual and tedious tasks associated with trading. DipSway employs a variety of trading and investment strategies and encompasses over 121 indicators tailored with a Walk Forward Optimization methodology to optimize the time to execute buying or selling trades. A cloud bot component provides the capability to automate buying and selling operations, making it possible for the bot to carry on trading even when the user is absent. While the amount of return per trading operation varies, the bot along with the dashboard provides visibility to users on the profits earned. The product does not require deposit and offers a trial period for users. This platform supports a multitude of exchange markets, making it versatile for various trading scenarios. The AI bot also incorporates wallet management and other pertinent metrics within a single platform. Trading strategies include positioning before the rise and automatic selling prior to a drop, thereby maximizing potential earnings.
features: ✅ No need to monitor market all day

name: Blur On
description: BlurOn is a plug-in specifically designed for After Effects, aiding in the process of video editing. The primary feature of this tool is its ability to automate the masking process in videos. It leverages AI to identify certain elements within the footage, such as faces, heads, full bodies, and license plates, which it can then apply a blur to, reducing the need for manual mosaic work. This technology can significantly enhance efficiency, as it aims to lessen the manual time and effort spent on this detailed editing work. Primarily, it is utilized by TV stations and post-production companies. With its automatic detection and blurring capabilities, BlurOn streamlines the video editing process, making complex post-production tasks more manageable while maintaining a consistent level of quality in the final outputs.

name: SoundHound
description: SoundHound offers voice AI interfaces for various platforms including hardware devices, services, vehicles, and mobile apps. Their conversational intelligence solutions rest on their independent voice AI platform which is built to facilitate more natural conversations. The end-to-end tech stack includes features like Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Intelligent Transcription, and Text-to-Speech (TTS). The ASR uses both acoustic and language models to deliver increased accuracy, while the NLU enables conversion of speech to meaning swiftly, and Intelligent Transcription provides real-time transcription that interprets meaning through intent and context. The TTS offers a unique voice to enhance brand experiences. SoundHound's platform also accommodates multiple languages and supports both Edge and Cloud connectivity solutions. It also has an Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) feature that can accurately scan and report copyrighted material. Further, SoundHound offers solutions catered to different industry needs such as automotive, hospitality, restaurants, among others, providing hands-free access to increase retention and engagement. Developers have the opportunity to build their voice assistant on the Houndify Developer Platform.

name: SpeechEasy
description: SpeechEasy is a text-to-speech tool designed to convert text into audio. It uses the power of AI and machine learning to generate high-quality synthetic voices that are easy to understand and consume. SpeechEasy also supports cross-platform usage, allowing users to generate and listen to audio voice files on both desktop and mobile devices. It features nearly a dozen high-quality synthetic voices, a simple and intuitive interface, and a privacy-first approach to ensure the security of personal information. SpeechEasy also offers a free version, as well as an Enterprise option. SpeechEasy is perfect for anyone looking for an easy to use synthetic voice solution for presentations, e-Learning content, marketing, publishing, and more.

name: Durable AI Website Builder
description: The Durable AI Website Builder is an artificial intelligence-driven tool that simplifies the process of creating robust and professional business websites. This tool offers features such as automated website generation by providing curated imagery and AI-written content tailored to the specific business need, making it ideal for entrepreneurs, small and medium businesses to establish a compelling online presence. Its intelligent features also include an AI-powered blog builder and brand builder which facilitate automated creation of blog content and brand building initiatives respectively. It is versatile, with components that support a range of industries from digital marketing to pet grooming. As it is hosted through Cloudflare, websites built with this tool can benefit from secure SSL generation, firewalls, and protection from a variety of web attacks, which assures security for user data on the platform. Additionally, the built-in SEO capability of the site generator ensures it's easily discoverable by users on search engines. Also included in the website builder suite are CRM for customer management, invoicing tools, AI assistant for completing administrative tasks, and resources such as guidance and updates from its team. Importantly, Durable is a 'no code' platform, hence completely removes the technical complexity of website creation and modification.

name: Nolibox
description: Nolibox Creator is an AI tool that offers users an accessible and uncomplicated way to utilize a wide range of AI functions. Powered by the open source backend carefree-creator, this tool enables users to seamlessly integrate various AI techniques into an infinitely expandable draw board. The primary objective of Nolibox Creator is to provide a user-friendly platform, allowing individuals to effortlessly explore and enjoy these AI capabilities at no cost.Some of the notable features provided by Nolibox Creator include Txt2Img, VariationImg2Img, HD Erase & Replace, Inpaint, Negative Prompt, Outpaint, and Matting. Users can further customize their experience through parameter settings such as choosing different models like General, Real, Anime, 3D Anime, and Dreamlike. They can also adjust the art mode to either Simple or Advance.The tool offers a diverse range of prompt generation options for users to experiment with, from creating pretty anime characters or fantastical creatures like Elvish maidens and Forest Goddesses to generating landscapes, stylized artwork, or even traditional patterns. Users also have the flexibility to choose any artist, optimizer, and resolution suitable for their needs.To enhance usability, Nolibox Creator provides various operations such as generating circular textures, adding images, and enabling auto arrangement. Additionally, users can easily share their creations, access useful tips and shortcut keys, or contact the support team for any assistance.Overall, Nolibox Creator is a comprehensive AI tool that empowers users of all skill levels to effortlessly explore and create using a vast array of AI techniques.

name: Fermat
description: Fermat is a game-changing AI tool designed to revolutionize the fashion industry. It enables users to ideate, design, and present fashion designs at an accelerated pace, greatly enhancing their creative workflow. Fermat is also a collaborative whiteboard that empowers designers to convert their ideas into realistic visuals. User can convert their hand-made sketches into reality by obtaining high-quality renders with one click. The tool encourages designers to apply their unique style using visual references to maintain coherence in their collections or to revamp their best-sellers. A significant provided feature is the ability to alter the vibes, materials, and colors of fashion pieces within seconds. It also offers the ability to visualize an outfit on different models and adjust settings as needed. Fermat also allows for high-resolution upscaling to enhance crafted designs and provides the option to turn designs into editable vector formats. It's a vital tool that enables fashion creators to turn their ideas into tangible prototypes, aids in visual expression of ideas, and promotes effective collaboration among teams. It is trusted and utilized by various established companies and freelance fashion consultants.

name: Image Computer
description: Room AI is a user-friendly, professional-grade tool that uses AI technology to create interior design solutions. The tool allows users to try out a variety of interior design styles for their homes and generate photo-realistic renders of room designs. With Room AI, users can upload an image of their room and have the software restyle it according to their chosen design preferences. Room AI caters to various room types and styles, providing a wide range of customization options for colors and materials, offering both preset and AI-generated color palettes. It also presents a selection of material options, enabling users to visualize different combinations in their interiors. This tool is built not only for homeowners but also for interior designers, architects, and real estate agents. For designers and architects, it simplifies the design process by generating diverse design ideas quickly. For real estate agents, it can showcase a property's potential by presenting various interior design possibilities, facilitating faster sales. Room AI supports both personal and commercial use, depending on the type of subscription held by the user. It promises secure transactions and protects user data while maintaining privacy.

name: Facia AI
description: Facia is an advanced tool that utilizes facial recognition technology and 3D liveness detection capabilities to prevent fraud and spoofing attacks. By ensuring fast and accurate face matching and verification, it represents an essential addition to secure identity verification systems. Facia not only offers the world's fastest 3D Liveness Detection Platform, but it also accommodates a wide range of features such as face matching, face search, age verification and iris recognition. A distinguishing quality of Facia's face recognition technology is its ability to onboard real clients through advanced facial recognition services while assuring a quick and precise match with stored profiles. Facia's solutions cater to a variety of industries including retail, government, healthcare, and education, to name a few. The tool offers a customizable solution dovetailed to the specific requirements of each sector. Facia's applications are broad, as it can be used for anything from access control and employee productivity monitoring to attendance management, and from security bolstering via criminal identification to automation of immigration processes.

name: Zebracat
description: Zebracat is an AI-powered technology that streamlines video production. The tool incorporates multiple features designed to transform text-based content into engaging videos. It has specialized functionalities that turn blog posts and other text-based materials into professional videos and animated scenes. The tool also features a text-to-speech functionality that can further repurpose textual content into videos. An additional feature of Zebracat is its automated editing capability, enabling quick and efficient modification of content. It also includes a feature to convert uploaded footage into videos, offering a new approach to video editing using AI technology. Zebracat's application ranges from creating AI video ads and faceless social videos to repurposing blog posts into videos within minutes. Furthermore, it proves useful in generating videos at a comparatively lower cost, which efficiently boosts viewer engagement. The system also lets you combine your uploaded footage with AI-generated visuals or stock clips for added variety. Ultimately, Zebracat aims to reinvent visual storytelling by leveraging the advantages of AI, prioritizing ethics in its operations and developments.

name: Lexii
description: Lexii.ai is an AI tool designed to assist in the generation of articles that are both finished and SEO-ready in a quick and efficient manner. A key feature of Lexii.ai is its capacity to deliver content that doesn't sound generic, enhancing the relatability and engagement factor for human readers. The AI tool has the ability to write articles to a specific word count according to user requirements. This makes the tool quite unique in comparison to other systems like ChatGPT. In order to maintain originality and avoid legal complications, Lexii.ai includes a plagiarism detection feature ensuring all content is authentic and is re-worked if found otherwise. The AI tool offers customization for voice and tone settings to enable more effective communication with the target audience. Another noticeable attribute is that Lexii.ai designed its articles to be optimized for Yoast, a well-known tool for SEO. Lexii.ai stands out from other AI tools in the market with its commitment to high output quality and ease of use. It caters to a wide range of users from individual freelancers to large organizations with custom models. Lexii.ai is built on an advanced foundation model, GPT-4 and focuses on constant evolution of algorithms to deliver the best results. In summary, Lexii.ai is an AI article writer aimed at delivering SEO-ready content efficiently and effectively.

name: OverQuota
description: OverQuota is an AI tool designed to enhance sales meetings and improve sales performance. It provides real-time insights during sales meetings to help users win more deals. With OverQuota, users can create meeting plans using templates that incorporate sales best practices to ensure preparedness. During the meeting, the tool offers AI-powered assistance, providing insights to navigate objections and deliver effective talk tracks to increase the chances of closing the deal. OverQuota also automates note-taking, capturing important details from the conversation and summarizing them into notes that align with the meeting plan. This feature eliminates the need for manual note-taking, saving time and allowing users to focus on the conversation. After the meeting, OverQuota simplifies the task of updating the customer relationship management (CRM) system by providing a one-click solution. This eliminates the need for multiple browser tabs and tedious copying and pasting from notes, streamlining the process and ensuring accurate and efficient CRM updates. OverQuota aims to transform sales processes by leveraging AI technology to provide valuable insights, enhance productivity, and improve the overall sales performance.

name: USP
description: usp.ai is an AI-powered image generation tool designed to help writers and creatives create high-quality, unique blog images quickly and easily. The platform is powered by cutting edge deep learning and text-to-image models, allowing users to generate images from text descriptions. Users can select from a range of image ratios and styles, as well as unique pre-existing recipes. The platform also includes a WordPress plugin, enabling users to generate images directly from their WordPress dashboard. usp.ai offers a free plan with limited options, as well as various paid plans with unlimited image generation and access to exclusive features. Paid plans also come with either a standard or enhanced image license, allowing for unrestricted web distribution and print runs up to 500,000 copies. Support is available via email, live chat, and Discord.
features: ✅ Range of image ratios and styles

name: Augxlabs
description: Augie is an AI video editing tool developed by Aug X Labs for both individuals and businesses. This tool aids in seamless transformation of ideas into professional, engaging videos. Users can convert their webcam recordings or narrations into videos that align well with their story. Augie also offers capabilities like an AI script writer and AI voices, which enable production from a simple prompt. The AI-assistant in the tool can generate media and provide access to a commercially licensed premium content. Augie is designed with a user-friendly interface, and includes intuitive editing tools which make it straightforward for users to create professional-quality videos. It offers text-to-video features and has the ability to transform narratives into visually enthralling videos with music and captivating visuals. A popular use case for Augie is its application in marketing, where users have utilized it for creating compelling, visually engaging narratives, and high-quality marketing videos. It is web-based and driven by the latest generative AI capabilities, empowering anyone to take control of their own visual storytelling.

name: Notably
description: Notably is an AI-powered research enablement platform that provides an all-in-one solution for researchers from different industries. The platform uses best practices and AI to conduct better, faster, and smarter research. It helps researchers create a research repository that gets smarter the more it is used, enabling them to easily import raw research data such as audio, video, surveys, notes, and whitepapers. One of the highlights of Notably is its video transcription feature that converts video into high-quality transcripts and automatically organizes sources. Notably provides an analysis function that works the way the human brain works – highlighting, tagging, and clustering research data to discover patterns. The AI algorithms also help with automatically analyzing sentiment and suggesting tags, making tagging data consistently across projects easier than ever. Researchers can create and share insights using video and data, which makes it easy for them to bring research to life, motivate, and inspire others. Moreover, Notably offers a search engine feature that helps researchers search across all projects, making it easy to find what they know and don't know. Notably supports research and analysis across four industries – Clinical, Market, Product, and Academic research. The platform helps identify new opportunities to solve problems with technology, understand patient experience with precision, discover consumer needs and preferences, and find themes and patterns in research to support a central thesis. Overall, Notably is a comprehensive research platform that enables high-quality research and insights in a fraction of the time.

name: Voxel
description: Voxel is an AI-powered site intelligence platform intended for various industries, such as food and beverage, logistics and supply chain, manufacturing, and the ports and customs sector. This multi-functional tool is designed to enhance the safety and efficiency of operations and to empower leaders to make strategic decisions. The platform provides intelligence, visibility, insights, action functionalities, and boasts robust security features. It offers multiple resources including case studies and blogs. Voxel can be particularly useful for insurance companies and employers, helping protect the workforce and accelerate operations. The tool is provided by a dedicated team, with a careers section on their website for further growth of the organization. Users are able to login and request a demo to fully experience the capabilities of the platform. Overall, Voxel is a versatile tool that leverages AI to help improve decision-making and increase operational efficiency within businesses.

name: StableCog
description: Stablecog is a free, open-source AI image generator that uses Stable Diffusion to produce high-quality visuals. It is designed to be easy to use, and is available in multiple languages. The tool has a wide range of features and options, allowing users to create 3D digital art, anime, 3D renders, animated movies, 3D comics, and more. The tool also has a Pro version, which unlocks additional features and allows users to customize the visuals even further. It is a great tool for those looking to create stunning visuals quickly and easily.

name: OddityAI
description: AI Homework Helper, provided by OddityAI, is an advanced artificial intelligence solution primarily designed to assist students with their homework. Implemented with cutting-edge AI technologies like GPT-4, it is crafted to provide comprehensive and individualized learning support. The tool serves multiple functions, extending from solving assignments to providing insightful solutions in various subjects like History, English, and Science. The AI can efficiently read assignments through uploaded images, interpret the tasks, and deliver precise solutions swiftly. An added advantage is its capability to explain the methodology adapted to arrive at an answer, which facilitates a deeper understanding of various topics for the user. Whether it's assistance with a complex scientific concept or help with literature analysis, AI Homework Helper is equipped to provide accurate, reliable, and timely assistance. It offers value-based subscription plans with assorted features to suit differing learning needs and budgets. Overall, AI Homework Helper presents itself as an innovative and efficient learning enhancer, reinventing the way students approach their schoolwork.

name: Imaiger
description: Imaiger is a powerful AI image search tool that enables users to search millions of art and images generated using cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology. This tool is tailored for those who are looking for generated art and images, including those who may be looking for more unique or personalized images. Imaiger is easy to use, with a simple login and search process. It is built by Babatunde Lawal, a recognized expert in AI technologies. With Imaiger, users can quickly and easily find the perfect image for their needs. The tool is also in beta, so users should expect to find more features and improvements as the development progresses. Imaiger provides a highly efficient and reliable image search experience, which makes it an ideal choice for anyone looking for AI generated art and images.

name: Speechelo
description: Speechelo is an AI-empowered text-to-speech converter that seamlessly translates written contents into human-like voiceovers. This tool has an intuitive engine that includes over 30 male and female voices, adding inflections to your text-to-speech products for an added touch of authenticity. The versatility of Speechelo is showcased by its ability to create voiceovers in 24 languages including English, Mandarin, Spanish and others, making it suitable for a global user base. In addition, the tool provides a choice of three reading tones: normal, joyful, and serious, catering to various contexts. Furthermore, Speechelo is compatible with prominent video creation software such as Camtasia, Adobe Premier, Animaker, and Powtoon, offering you flexibility in your creative process. Key benefits include saving on cost and time associated with hiring professional voiceover artists and recording studios, and is a much-improved alternative to robotic text-to-speech services. The easy-to-use platform requires only a few clicks, to input text, select a preferred voice and language, and generate the voiceover. Developers have found its applications beneficial for creating voiceovers for sales videos, training videos, and educational content.
features: ✅ Broad language range covers global user base

name: ExamCram - AI Quizzes
description: ExamCram is an AI-powered study assistant designed to facilitate smarter and more effective studying. This app brings innovative features for a tailor-made learning experience. Its Quick Quizzes feature, powered by advanced AI technology, transforms study material into interactive quizzes, supporting a versatile range of languages for global accessibility. Chip Chats introduces students to Chip, an AI tutor capable of playing a variety of roles to make learning more enjoyable. The Deep Docs feature, backed by GPT-3 AI, allows students to delve deeper into their study materials by interacting with their documents, promoting a profound understanding of their learning materials. Additionally, ExamCram provides Insightful Analytics, a tool that tracks academic progress by displaying accuracy levels of study subjects with dynamic charts, widgets, and notifications. This way, students can learn from their study habits and understand where to focus their efforts. The app aims to revolutionize studying by making it more engaging and productive.

name: UChat
description: UChat is a comprehensive chatbot platform designed to assist businesses automate their operations. One of its defining features is its no-code nature, which empowers businesses to create their own chatbots without any programming knowledge. UChat is touted as a visually-based platform which implements a drag and drop flow builder, enabling users to design and deploy complex conversational flows intuitively. Moreover, UChat provides a reach across a variety of platforms with the promise of engaging customers wherever they may be. The channels supported include but are not limited to Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Google Business Messenger, Telegram, SMS, Voice, Line, Viber, WeChat, Slack, and Email.Furthermore, UChat incorporates artificial intelligence capabilities to develop chatbots that deliver automated, contextually appropriate responses 24/7. The platform employs AI services like OpenAI/ChatGPT & Dialogflow to enhance the efficiency and quality of the bot interactions.In addition to chatbot building, UChat boasts an integrated eCommerce feature offering a seamless checkout process for customers across all supported channels. The platform also has a centralized live chat and inbox system that allows for increased interaction with customers and streamlined internal communication.In terms of adoption, UChat is notably open to anyone interested in automated conversational marketing, as it follows a template-based approach with a library of pre-designed templates ready for use. The platform is also equipped with various advanced building blocks for crafting more refined and effective chatbots.

name: AI Profile Pictures
description: AI Profile Pictures offers the ability to generate personalized profile pictures using artificial intelligence. The whole process begins with the purchase of credits that enable the processing and creation of over 200 images. Users are then prompted to upload between 10 to 20 photos of themselves or the intended subject of the pictures. A broad variety of photos including close-ups, different poses, facial expressions, backgrounds, and lighting conditions are preferred to ensure the diverse and realistic output. However, the tool advises against using identical expressions, settings or the inclusion of multiple people per photo for optimal results. Nude or sexually explicit content is also expressly prohibited. Following the photo submissions, the AI processes the images and creates the finalized profile pictures within an estimated timeframe of 2 to 3 hours. The generated photos are then sent to the user via email. Users who are unsatisfied with the result obtained after the initial generation can request for further iterations within a 7-day period to ensure satisfaction. Due to the costs associated with training the AI model, refunds are not extended once photos have been submitted.

name: Eimis Anime Diffusion
description: The EimisAnimeDiffusion_1.0v tool, developed by eimiss and hosted on Hugging Face, is an AI model designed for generating anime-style images. This tool is specifically trained on high-quality and detailed anime images, making it a suitable choice for any project that requires anime-inspired visuals.The tool offers several features, including a text-to-image diffuser, which allows users to input text prompts and generate corresponding images. It also supports image-to-image diffusing, enabling users to transform existing images into anime-style visuals.The EimisAnimeDiffusion_1.0v tool is licensed under CreativeMLOpenRAIL-M, an open access license that grants users the freedom to use the generated outputs. However, the authors emphasize that the tool should not be used to produce or share illegal or harmful content.The tool provides sample generations to showcase its capabilities, both positive and negative, and highlights the steps and parameters used in the image generation process. It advises users to add more prompts if the results are not satisfactory and suggests combining the tool with img2img for added detail.Although the exact download numbers are not provided, the tool has received consistent usage, as indicated by the "Downloads last month" statistic. Additionally, it can be loaded on-demand via the Inference API for seamless integration into applications.The tool's performance and compatibility are validated by its integration with Gradio, a web-based UI, and its use in various spaces within the Hugging Face community. The model card and files are available for easy access and customization.Overall, EimisAnimeDiffusion_1.0v is a versatile and accessible AI tool that empowers users to generate anime-style images effectively and creatively.

name: Second Nature AI
description: Second Nature is a sales training software that leverages conversational AI technology. It functions by engaging sales representatives in realistic discussions to help them enhance their skillsets and excel in their sales calls. The platform aims to improve the performance, training effectiveness, and productivity of customer-facing teams. The software offers life-like sales training, enabling users to role-play a wide variety of sales scenarios. Additionally, Second Nature boosts results by strategically sharpening sales skills, elevating the sales performance and driving better outcomes. The platform also provides options for personalized AI simulations which users can tailor according to their specific needs. These simulations use different templates for sales, services, HR, learning, and marketing. Users can easily load various types of content to generate customized sales simulations and train on any subject. The feedback system within the tool aligns with your specific guidelines, ensuring that the training process is effectively addressing your team's needs. The software also introduces AI sales training avatars for a more interactive training experience.

name: Picsart
description: Picsart is a comprehensive all-in-one creative platform for photo, video editing, and design tools. It is designed for users of all skill levels, from beginners to experienced professionals. It features a wide array of editing tools, such as exposure and contrast adjustments, cinematic color grading, dramatic filters, AI-generated photo effects, stickers, text overlays, backgrounds, and more. Additionally, it offers a selection of templates for social media posts, business cards, logos, posters, flyers, YouTube channel art, and more. Additionally, it includes a content library of free-to-use images, videos, and inspiration from other creators. With its intuitive user interface and AI-powered editing tools, Picsart enables users to easily create professional-level designs and content without any graphic design experience.

name: Hocoos
description: Hocoos AI Website Builder is an AI-based tool that enables users to create professional websites and online stores without any coding skills. By answering just 8 quick questions about their business, the AI tool generates a unique and business-ready website with customized content, layout, and design. Hocoos AI Editor further facilitates customization to give users the power to change text, images, and widgets themselves in moments, or generate brand new content with just a few clicks. Users can also choose to use their own branding or let the AI tool create different color palettes, fonts, and layouts options. Hocoos AI Website Builder provides sales and marketing tools to enable businesses to start and grow their online presence. The AI wizard takes care of all customer invoices, allowing quick connections with Stripe or PayPal to start taking payment for products or services. The Hocoos platform includes a powerful marketing toolkit, like AI-generated email campaigns, to increase an audience and find new customers. Hocoos AI Website Builder offers different categories to let users choose more specific options, like beauty & wellness or sports & fitness, to make building websites, even more, hassle-free. Hocoos AI Website Builder claims to be able to create a professional, customized website in under 5 minutes, making it ideal for businesses of all types and sizes, and a perfect choice for users looking to save time, effort, and resources.

name: Vee
description: Vee is an AI-powered tool designed to help businesses automate customer service processes. It uses cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology combined with the experience of millions of conversations with real people to provide an effective and efficient customer service experience. Vee is capable of handling a wide range of customer support tasks, from helplines to mass outbound campaigns. It can be used to replace the need for a call center employee, and is as effective as one. Vee has already spoken with 5 million Poles, successfully implementing business processes for companies from various industries. It also provides a Brilliance ecosystem, which allows for the development of conversational AI. Finally, Vee Care provides users with customer service support and contact information.

name: SQLAI.ai
description: SQLAI.ai is an advanced AI technology tool designed to facilitate the generation, fixing, explanation, and optimization of SQL and NoSQL queries, ultimately enhancing productivity. It is a versatile tool capable of transforming everyday language into simple or complex SQL queries with high accuracy. The tool greatly aids in optimizing SQL queries for better performance, whereby users can input a SQL query to be optimized, and the AI generates an improved query in return. SQLAI.ai can validate SQL queries, detecting and fixing syntax errors to produce a completely fixed query. The tool also provides users with a deep understanding of SQL queries by giving a detailed explanation with inline comments. It also features AI-training capabilities, allowing the tool to familiarize itself with a user's database schema. The tool can be directly connected to databases for running generated SQL or NoSQL queries. One of its standout features includes data analytics whereby data can be visually represented and questions can be directly asked to the data. SQLAI.ai is not only well-suited for professionals, but also beginners who can learn by doing, enhancing their SQL skills in no time. This tool serves to accelerate workflows, optimize time and cost, whilst providing real-time data insights.

name: Dreamspace.art
description: DreamSpace is a diagramming tool that allows users to create visual representations of their ideas. The user can select a node by pressing enter or space, then use the arrow keys to move the node around, press delete to remove it and press escape to cancel. Similarly, edges can be selected and removed with delete or cancelled with escape. Additionally, users can adjust the width and height of the diagram in increments of 128, 256, 512, or 1024. The tool also offers two modes: Loosely Follow Prompt and Exactly Follow Prompt, which allows users to adjust the level of difficulty. Finally, the tool includes a Start button, which begins the diagramming process, and a Back button, which allows users to undo their last action.

name: Magic Avatars
description: Lensa is a mobile app that utilizes AI technology to create unique, customized avatars from selfies. This app is designed to be easy to use and provide a range of features to perfect images on the go. Lensa's Magic Avatars feature is one of the most advanced AI technologies available and generates avatars in various art styles from your selfies. All images are created by AI and the results have been seen to go viral on social media. Lensa provides a unique experience and is an example of how AI can be used to create stunning visuals. The app is available for download on both the App Store and Google Play, and all images created with the app are non-commercial and used solely as examples of what is possible with the technology.
features: ✅ Ability to link to social media

name: Digital First AI
description: Digital First AI is a tool designed to streamline marketing efforts, democratizing the process for individuals and businesses, regardless of experience level. It provides assistance in the formulation of marketing strategies by recommending best tactics based on answers to selected queries about one's business. A feature unique to Digital First AI is its library of tactics; a resource containing strategies of popular brands and experienced marketers. These tactics serve as a launchpad for developing personalized marketing schemes.The platform uses Artificial Intelligence to optimize various marketing aspects, from content generation for blogs, social media, websites and more, to proposing new markets and segments, suggesting product experiments, and providing permanent business growth recommendations.Moreover, the tool supports businesses of all shapes and sizes to become instant marketing strategists. It operates beyond temporary technology or trends and leans into a human-based decision-making process.Another key feature is its community-driven tactics library which houses more than 500 marketing tactics. These tactics are transparently described and are purposed and effect-oriented to provide clear paths to achieving set objectives. Additionally, the tool also assists users in creating new income sources organically.Customers applaud Digital First AI's effectiveness and collaborative nature, citing the tool as a game-changer in shaping marketing campaigns and strategy formation that leads to significant growth and improved results.
features: ✅ Digital growth plan in one place

name: Holovolo
description: Holovolo is an AI-powered tool for creating immersive volumetric VR180 videos and photos, as well as 3D stable diffusion for Quest and WebVR. It allows users to upload their own photos and VR180 content, as well as browse existing creations made by others. Holovolo's AI-generated content includes trending, most viewed and newest videos and photos from different creators. Examples of content include a virtual reality piano performance, a pirate invasion in Yorktown, Virginia, a cyberpunk neon Tokyo garden district, a spiraling clock face, a man wearing winter clothes walking up a snowy hill and a sea of Izukyu-Shimoda. The tool also has a content guide and EULA. Holovolo is a great tool for users to create and explore immersive virtual reality content.

name: ImagineMe - Personal AI Art Generator
description: ImagineMe is an AI art generator that enables users to create personalized images from text descriptions. The AI system translates users' text prompts into visual interpretations, simulating diverse scenarios and soliciting creative potential. To use the AI, a user provides 10-20 varied pictures, which are used to 'train' a private AI model that then generates personalized art. The training process, while variable in length, ensures safe and personalized outputs. Post-training, users input textual prompts which the AI converts into intricate images. From fantasy concepts to reality-based representation, ImagineMe caters to a wide range of imaginative scenarios. The generated art can be used for varied purposes, including concept character design, photorealistic captures, poster design, gift design, cosplay depictions, fashion conceptualization, and artistic expression. Available for everyone, ImagineMe makes creating personalized art accessible and straightforward.

name: Heyday
description: Heyday is an AI-supported tool designed to distill insights from the user's various sources of data - documents, notes, and conversations. This tool is utilized by professionals to automate various tasks such as creation of meeting notes, extraction of insights from research and drafting content which is influenced by past readings and conversations. Users upload their data input and Heyday creates a searchable database, draws insights from the information, and provides summaries. Beyond its core capabilities, Heyday offers different functionality options, namely - Universal Assistant, Writing Assistant, Topic Assistant, and Call Recaps. Heyday can also draft personalized content based on the user's writing style and it has a feature that connects to conversations and generates notes automatically. Another important feature is its ability to provide important context about clients in the user's calendar. It should be mentioned that user data is safely stored, encrypted and can be deleted at any time. Furthermore, Heyday has undergone thorough security reviews by companies like Zoom and Google. This tool is especially beneficial for professionals who do a lot of reading and research, as well as those who depend heavily on recalling important data from their digital files.

name: Robin
description: Robin AI is an artificial intelligence platform designed to automate the top of the sales funnel for businesses. It uses sophisticated text-to-speech technology and CRM integration to craft and send emails from a business' email address, adjusting the copy based on the lead information. When the lead responds, the email can be forwarded to Robin AI and it will create objection emails to book a call with the lead for a sales team to take over. Robin AI also provides personalized sales advice and real-time insights to help businesses drive better results and gain a competitive advantage. It is integrated with major CRMs, SMS, chat, and voice and can be used for targeted outreach, email campaigns, and customer retention. To try the Beta Demo, click the link provided.

name: Briefly
description: Briefly is an AI-powered briefing platform primarily designed for enhancing creativity and efficiency in marketing efforts. Its key focus is to reduce budget wastage linked to poorly crafted briefs by facilitating the creation of standout marketing briefs significantly faster than traditional methods. To achieve this, it uses a range of features such as Fastdrafts, which aids in producing the first draft in significantly less time. Built on marketing theory and best practice, Fastdrafts also utilize a vast array of innovative case studies. Furthermore, tailored feedback is provided to transform good briefs into great ones, thereby achieving more effective work outcomes. In order to inspire and challenge their agency partners, users can also set creative and effectiveness expectations using thousands of personalized effectiveness case studies through the Inspiration feature. Additionally, ensures that each brief aligns with strategic goals by seeking feedback based on key documents, plans, and priorities. Effective briefs and compliance are two other significant priorities inherent to the platform. Enterprise-grade security, performance analytics, fine-grained admin controls, and personalized onboarding are further capabilities offered by Briefly. The tool is trusted by marketers globally, ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies.

name: Nemo
description: Nemo is an AI digital assistant designed for busy chief financial officers (CFOs) to solve complex problems. It offers voice-controlled analytics to automate financial analysis and simplify the presentation of financial performance data. With Nemo, CFOs can monitor their company's financial performance by analyzing critical statements such as the P&L and Balance Sheet, identifying trends, areas for improvement, and making informed decisions to drive growth. Nemo also integrates with accounting systems to provide daily progress updates, allowing CFOs to track expenses and gain insight into their spending habits. Additionally, Nemo simplifies financial reporting with a visual scorecard that condenses multiple financial metrics into one screen for easy consumption. CEO's can visualize their financial performance using visuals like P&L, balance sheet, cash, accounting ratios, and more. Nemo offers quick answers by delivering reports and analyses within seconds, eliminating the waiting time typically associated with financial information retrieval. It requires only speech or text commands, eliminating the need for a dashboard, spreadsheet, or finance experience. Furthermore, Nemo aims to free up accountants by automating traditionally manual and time-consuming tasks, allowing them to focus on more critical responsibilities and achieve a better work-life balance. By leveraging Nemo's finance automation capabilities, businesses can potentially save up to 60% on labor costs. Overall, Nemo provides CFOs with an efficient and accurate AI tool for financial analysis and reporting, reducing time and effort required for these tasks.

name: Hebbia
description: Hebbia is an AI-powered search engine that helps users find accurate answers to their questions quickly and efficiently. It enables users to search for broad market research, targeted information extraction and more with an AI Analyst that understands the user's needs. Hebbia's neural search uses cutting-edge AI technology to retrieve answers that humans may overlook, allowing for faster and more reliable research results. Hebbia was founded in August 2020 and has since raised two rounds of financing and hired a diverse team of talented people from around the world. Hebbia also offers open positions for highly passionate and curious individuals who want to make a difference. The company is committed to providing users with the best search experience possible and is dedicated to reinventing the way we work.

name: Athenic AI
description: Athenic AI, formerly AskEdith, is revolutionizing data analysis: - Unpacks the "Why" behind data instantly. - Democratizes analytics for a dynamic data experience. - Integrates data insights into daily workflows for data-driven decisions. - Tailors insights to individual needs, beyond generic dashboards. - Simplifies data analysis across various industries. - Features a magic search bar for analyzing data from multiple sources. - Empowers self-service analytics, increasing efficiency and reducing dependency. - Compatible with every database, CRM, ERP, and application. Experience the Athenic AI difference for a simplified, efficient, and empowering data analysis journey.

name: Coolifyme
description: CoolifyMe is an AI tool that generates unique and cool avatars for use as profile pictures. By transforming your photos, CoolifyMe creates over 100 distinct avatars that reflect your individuality. The process is safe, secure, and personalized, ensuring that your pictures are only visible to you and will never be shared without your consent. The tool utilizes state-of-the-art encryption to protect your images, and authorized personnel are the only ones with access to them. After 30 days, the pictures are completely erased from the server. To generate the avatars, you need to upload 18 photos showcasing different clothing, backgrounds, and perspectives. The AI then undergoes training that can take up to 3 hours. You will be notified via email once the training is complete. Upon completion, you will receive a collection of 100+ newly created profile pictures that are unique and cool. The tool offers examples of AI-generated avatars received by real CoolifyMe users to give you an idea of the results you can expect. CoolifyMe charges a reasonable fee for its services to cover the cost of specialized hardware required for training the AI. This enables them to provide high-quality products and services while continuously improving and innovating. Additionally, the tool's pricing ensures that you can obtain amazing avatars for your profile. For any further inquiries or assistance, CoolifyMe provides support via email or chat. They also have a privacy policy and terms and conditions that outline how your pictures are used and protected.

name: CrystalSound
description: CrystalSound is a smart noise cancelling and screen recording application that provides solutions for challenges typically encountered during virtual meetings. The application is built with innovative AI-driven noise cancelling technology which includes bi-directional noise cancellation, background voice suppression, microphone volume booster, and acoustic echo suppression. These features help users focus during meetings by reducing distracting background noises. The recording capability captures screen and bidirectional audio, and offers cloud recordings that are easily shareable with automatic titles for easy retrieval. It also provides a smart analysis of the recordings, generating meeting minutes, keywords, and performance insights, which could help improve productivity and communication. Furthermore, CrystalSound simplifies the user experience by serving as a unified recording hub that integrates smoothly with different conferencing tools already in use. This supports a more efficient workflow and a cohesive meeting experience. Users have reported a significant enhancement in their communication experience, particularly in noisy environments, through CrystalSound's comprehensive noise cancelling, ease of integration and deep neural network technology.

name: AI-Translate
description: AI Translate is an automated translation API service that utilizes advanced neural networks to translates text into over 99 different languages. The intricate design of its neural networks allows for exceptional accuracy in even nuanced translations. This precision is regularly evaluated through blind tests, where professional translators assess translation quality without prior knowledge of its origin. AI Translate has reportedly outperformed competitive services in such blind tests. The API is designed for rapid and precise translation, making it a preferred tool for numerous organizations worldwide. This service has been seamlessly integrated into products by various companies who have praised the translation quality and the constant improvement in the technology. It has proven to be especially useful in speeding up the execution of urgent projects and facilitating a global scaling of business solutions. Furthermore, the tool provides access to daily free character translations while offering additional benefits under its Pro version.

name: checklist.gg
description: Checklist.gg is an AI-driven checklist management tool designed to streamline task, process, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) management. Powered by an advanced AI engine, it enables users to swiftly generate checklists, processes and SOPs based on specific requirements. The tool offers task management functionality to create, edit, and track progress on checklists, and SOPs. Workflow management capabilities include assigning tasks and monitoring real-time progress. Users can also promote cross-team collaboration with real-time editing and sharing of checklists and SOPs. The tool integrates with a variety of platforms, facilitating easy incorporation into existing workflows. Plus, it offers a library of pre-built checklists across various industries. Checklist.gg also allows customization of checklists, processes, and SOPs to meet specific needs. Aimed at companies looking to reduce repeatability in tasks and promote continuous improvement strategies, it proves useful in industries requiring adherence to strict SOPs like manufacturing or healthcare.

name: Artistator
description: Artistator is an AI-powered tool designed to generate artist names across various music genres. Users can utilize this tool to discover potential names for artists according to their preferred music genre. This tool could serve as an inspiration source for music producers, aspiring artists, or anyone who needs to create unique artist names within the music industry. Artistator generates results using underlying algorithms that have been trained on a large dataset of existing artist names ensuring diversity and relevance to the selected music genre. It's made by Pablo Cabezas, furthering his contribution to the AI development community. Please note that while this tool excels at generating artist names, it's always recommended for users to use the generated names as inspiration and validate the uniqueness within their respective music industry context.

name: simulai
description: simulai is an AI-driven tool that helps users identify and establish email connections with websites utilizing specific technologies. It provides a comprehensive list of technologies used across various websites, acting as a unique tool for extensive technology research. From platforms like Twitter and LinkedIn, to technologies such as Microsoft ASP.NET, Google Analytics, and Adobe Experience Manager, simulai's database is diverse and inclusive. Additionally, simulai provides distinct information about various website builders and content management systems, along with analytics tools and third-party add-ons. It even includes data about the use of web development tools and server technologies, giving a clear image of a website's tech stack. Users can leverage simulai to discover who uses particular plugins, themes, and other software, extending its utility for competitive analysis, sales prospecting, or market survey. It can be a beneficial tool for individuals and businesses seeking to explore technology adoption trends, identify potential clients or partners, or investigate competitors. Please note that simulai may offer different plans and pricing models, which are not included in this description, and are recommended to be reviewed directly on the simulai platform.

name: UBOS
description: UBOS is a low-code/no-code platform that empowers developers and businesses to create and deploy web applications quickly and easily, without requiring extensive coding experience. With UBOS, users can seamlessly integrate APIs like ChatGPT, Dalle-2, and Codex from OpenAI, and even use custom ML models. They can also create custom admin client and CRUD functionalities to effectively manage sales, inventory, contracts, and more. Additionally, UBOS enables users to create dynamic dashboards that transform data into actionable insights and fuel innovation for their business. It also allows users to easily create chatbots to improve customer support and create a true omnichannel experience with multiple integrations.UBOS's all-in-one cloud platform combines low-code/no-code tools with edge technologies to make web applications scalable, secure, and easy to manage. Its tooling includes a low-code/no-code Node-Red flow builder for integrations and ETL, an Appsmith UI Builder for internal tools, an extended UI editor by UBOS.tech, a no-code database tool like Airtable, and much more. UBOS also provides an AI Creator function for creating UI widgets with ChatGPT, a deployment manager for CI/CD, and app templates to create or install composite apps. UBOS has a workspace that functions as a single space to manage tools and services.UBOS also helps businesses optimize their operations, reduce costs, and drive growth with low-code cloud solutions. The platform's speed, security, and scalability are the cornerstones of successful software development. Its features include an AI assistant based on LLM/GPT-3 type of models, cutting-edge ecosystem of visual development tools, background workers and automation services, and a seamless collaboration workspace. UBOS's advanced integration solution connects to any data source, integrates with any legacy or external systems, and executes business processes with ease. Overall, UBOS is a user-friendly, low-code platform that allows users to create powerful web applications with ease and speed.

name: OddVibe
description: OddVibe is an AI-generated image collection designed to unnerve and shock viewers. It contains a wide range of creepy images created by AI. The images can be used for entertainment or research purposes. For the extra brave, users can submit their own AI-generated images to the website and see if they are considered creepy enough to be featured. For a different experience, users can visit PixelVibe instead, which is said to be less creepy. All images are moderated by OddVibe staff to ensure that they are of a certain quality and adhere to the standards of the site.
features: ⚠️ No user control over image generation
⚠️ User submission might not get featured

name: Salespitch
description: Salespitch is an AI-driven tool that automates the process of writing and sending cold emails to prospective customers, with a focus on increasing their conversion rate. It is accessed through a website and can be connected to a user's email account through SMTP. The tool allows users to create campaigns by specifying their product or service, benefits, and call to action. Prospects can be imported through a spreadsheet or added manually. Once the campaign is launched, Salespitch's AI generates hundreds of personalised emails every day, which are sent directly from the user's email account. Users can monitor the performance of their campaigns, and the tool's hyper-personalised email writing ensures that emails are written specifically for each individual prospect, increasing the chances of success. The tool offers a range of features to help users optimise their campaigns, including automated B2B email prospecting, smart summarisation of URLs ("SmartSummarize"), and subject line suggestions. Salespitch is available at different price points, with accessible pricing for individuals as well as for startups and larger organisations. Users can try the tool for free, with the ability to add up to five products or services and send personalised emails from the dashboard. Personalised email tone is a key feature of Salespitch that ensures the emails speak to each prospect as an individual, spending more time and attention to detail than traditional cold email templates.

name: Jot - AI Ad Copy
description: Jot - AI Ad Copy is a tool designed to assist teams in generating various ad copy text variations by leveraging artificial intelligence. A key feature of this tool is its use of OpenAI's GPT-3, an autoregressive language model that can generate human-like text based on a given product description. This is particularly beneficial for teams faced with writer's block, or those who wish to speed up their copywriting processes with diverse and innovative ad copy ideas. The output of AI can remarkably emulate the flow and creativity of human writing, making it an effective solution for generating ad copies. In addition to its core functionality, the tool also provides a simple dashboard for managing brand links and its user-friendly interface allows easy use, from dropping in a product description to retrieving the finalized ad copy. Through efficient and smart automation, Jot - AI Ad Copy aims to save teams time and enhance their marketing efforts across different platforms.

name: Revoldiv
description: Revoldiv is an AI-based tool specifically designed for converting audio or video files to text with impressive accuracy. This tool is incredibly useful for creating transcriptions of various media files, like podcasts, interviews or video calls. Media contents less than two hours long are supported in widely used browsers such as Chrome and Firefox. With its robust AI, Revoldiv detects speech, applause and cheers within the media files. Users are also able to edit transcription text to correspondingly edit audio, dramatically streamlining the editing process. Revoldiv features the unique functionality of being able to remove filler words like 'um', 'like', and 'uhh' with a single click, making for cleaner, crisper content. Moreover, user-friendly features allow users to export their content in several formats, share projects or snippets via the share feature, and create chapters for easier content navigation. Additional capabilities extend to commenting and discussion functions, enabling users to communicate their thoughts and responses on the platform. This transcription and editing tool also supports media files via a Chrome Extension and facilitates the creation of audiograms. Novel features such as 'flag post' and 'detecting speakers' add an extra layer of utility and convenience for user experience. However, it is important to note that editing functions are currently only supported on non-mobile devices.

name: Nuelink
description: Nuelink is a multi-platform social media scheduling and automation tool. It functions with platforms including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Google My Business, and Pinterest. Nuelink is designed to plan, automate, and manage social media content, allowing users time to focus on other aspects of their business. Users can schedule a vast amount of social media posts and arrange them into collections.
