Finally, Edge provides workflow management to help organize and categorize disclosures for ease and efficiency. Users can manage all disclosures in one place, and then share them with outside counsel as needed. Please note, Edge aims to serve as every patent professional's personal patent assistant; therefore, expertise in patents is an integral aspect of the tool's offering.

name: Tarotnova
description: AI Tarot Nova is an AI-powered Tarot Reading Master that offers free tarot readings, tarot card meanings, and daily tarot draws. It is a free tarot reading app that utilizes artificial intelligence to provide guidance and insight. Users can ask specific questions in various categories such as love, career, and finance. The tool allows users to pick their own tarot cards using different spreads, including a 3-card spread, a 1-card spread, and a yes or no spread, among others.AI Tarot Nova aims to provide clear guidance for personal journeys. It offers personalized and interactive conversations through AI-powered tarot readings. The tool ensures a consistent and objective experience by eliminating human bias. Additionally, it prioritizes privacy and security by not requiring users to reveal personal information during the readings.It utilizes the Rider-Waite Tarot deck, created in 1910, known for its captivating and influential illustrations by Pamela Colman Smith. The deck provides a rich symbolism that enhances the tarot reading experience.While AI Tarot Nova is designed for entertainment purposes, it encourages users with serious problems or concerns to seek professional help. The tool is committed to user privacy and safety, as stated in its Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.Overall, AI Tarot Nova is a free AI-powered tarot reading app that offers personalized and objective tarot readings, allowing users to gain insights on various aspects of their lives.

name: Novita
description: novita.ai is a platform that offers hundreds of fast and affordable AI image generation application programming interfaces (APIs). It boasts a wide range of over 1000 models and guarantees the fastest image generation process, with some models capable of generating images in just 2 seconds. Users can access these APIs on a pay-as-you-go basis, with each standard image costing $0.0015. novita.ai also allows users to add their own models and eliminates the need for GPU maintenance.The platform provides various AI image generation and editing APIs, such as Text to Image, Image to Image, Remove Background, Cleanup, Upscale, and Refiner. These APIs offer effortless integration, versatility, and powerful image generation capabilities. Users can generate images from a diverse selection of over 10,000 models with a single click. The available models include those from Civitai and Hugging Face, and users also have the option to upload their own models.novita.ai caters to a range of applications, including blog automation, blog cover and illustration generation, SEO optimization, and creating high-quality images through a Telegram bot command. The platform also offers a comprehensive FAQ section that addresses common questions about their Stable Diffusion and other APIs.To access the novita.ai APIs and take advantage of their extensive offerings at competitive pricing, users can visit their documentation, pricing page, or get started with integration through their website. novita.ai aims to streamline the image generation process, saving time and reducing access costs for users.

name: VoxReplay
description: VoxReply is an AI writing assistant that helps users to compose email replies using their voice. The tool accepts any pasted email message as a basis for a reply and allows users to record their reply ideas using their voice. The AI assistant then takes over the task of constructing a grammatically correct and contextually relevant reply. The tool offers users the option to choose between different write-up styles such as informal, business, friendly, and formal. In addition, it supports multiple languages, including English, Arabic, French, German, Japanese, and many more. Users can select their desired language and generate an email reply, which can be copied to the clipboard or sent directly from the website.It is worth noting that the website has a feature that caters to visually-impaired individuals. However, users should be aware that the tool may share their input data with third-party services like OpenAI, Google Cloud, and Pipedream. Upon successful email reply generation, the website will attempt to delete the information from these services if feasible. The tool is powered by Findly.ai, a chatbot platform for data warehouses that promises 97% faster insights. The website includes a waitlist link for users interested in trying the chatbot. Overall, VoxReply is a time-saving solution for those who struggle with writing effective email responses or need to reply to emails quickly. It takes advantage of the natural language processing prowess of AI to aid in constructing appropriate responses accurately.

name: CodeMaker
description: CodeMaker AI is a next-generation developer toolkit designed to enhance software developers' productivity by providing advanced automation capabilities. The toolkit offers numerous features, such as context-aware code completion and generation based on the context derived from the input source file. A distinguishing feature of CodeMaker AI is its ability to generate hands-free inline code documentation. Furthermore, it comes with batch processing capabilities that allow operations to run across an entire directory structure. CodeMaker AI aids in automating the generation of source codes, integrating compatibility with popular IDEs, and on-demand task operations, which can also be integrated with CI/CD workflows. The tool can be used to replace or supplement traditional programming and code writing methods, significantly reducing errors and saving time. It also fits seamlessly into existing workflows with its support for IDEs, CLI, GitHub Actions, and GitHub App. CodeMaker AI is designed to work at scale, catering to individual developers, professionals, and enterprises with varying usage requirements.

name: Chat KJV
description: ChatKJV is an AI-powered chatbot that provides users with scriptures from the King James Bible. It is designed to allow users to interact with the scriptures in a more conversational way. It uses natural language processing to interpret users’ feelings and respond with an appropriate scripture from the Bible. The chatbot is designed to be intuitive and user-friendly, so that even those who are not familiar with the Bible can have meaningful conversations with it. Furthermore, it is designed to be shared with friends and family, allowing for more meaningful conversations about faith and spirituality. ChatKJV is a unique and innovative way to engage with the scriptures, providing users with a more interactive, conversational experience.

name: Robust Intelligence
description: Robust Intelligence is a platform designed to offer security and validation to AI models and data. This tool stands as an end-to-end solution to prevent potential adverse outcomes that can result from machine learning model failures. The platform provides real-time protection of machine learning models, notably against security threats, operational threats and ethical threats. Additionally, it offers an AI Firewall that secures production models against attacks and undesirable responses by validating inputs and outputs in real time. Another significant offering by Robust Intelligence is the Continuous Validation feature that ensures AI models and data are validated throughout the AI lifecycle. This is achieved by surfacing weaknesses via automated red teaming, while also establishing a standardized audit record for their health, and tracking adherence to standards and regulatory compliance. Furthermore, the platform supports Generative AI and other major modalities, while effectively managing AI risk in compliance with significant AI regulations, guidelines, and frameworks.

name: Lemmy
description: Lemmy is an AI assistant designed to enhance productivity in the workplace. It connects users to essential business apps and data, providing actionable insights to facilitate smarter work. By integrating with daily tools, Lemmy offers a personalized AI chat bot experience that understands the user's work. The tool supports seamless interaction with various essential apps and allows users to chat with their data.Powered by OpenAI's GPT technology, Lemmy's AI chat bot is specifically built to fit into the user's work stack. It aims to streamline workflow by providing efficient assistance and relevant information. The tool can answer questions and provide explanations about code in GitHub repositories, write documents based on reports, summarize document contents, and even provide expenditure details for advertising campaigns.Additionally, Lemmy promotes community engagement by offering a Slack workspace for users and developers to connect, exchange ideas, and seek support. This collaborative environment facilitates knowledge-sharing and contributes to the overall user experience.Overall, Lemmy offers a free personalized AI assistant that integrates with essential apps, allowing users to chat with their data and obtain valuable insights. By harnessing the power of AI, Lemmy aims to enhance productivity and efficiency in the workplace.

name: AutoGPT Nextweb
description: AutoGPT Next Web is an AI tool used for assembling, configuring, and deploying autonomous AI Agents directly within a web browser environment. The tool's provide the ability for users to construct AI agents, by providing a name and a specified goal, and then hitting the deploy button. It offers pause and stop functions for the agent activities, providing substantial control over the AI development process. The use of this tool requires the provision of the user's own API key from OpenAI, optimised through the settings tab, indicating that it integrates with OpenAI's platform to leverage their advanced machine learning algorithms. The tool seems to have community support channels available in Discord and Github, enabling users to troubleshoot, collaborate, and share knowledge. It makes the process of generating AI agents easier, eliminating the need for complex coding and deployment procedures. The platform appears to be designed to be user-friendly, irrespective of the user's technical expertise, thus democratizing access to AI deployment process.

name: Hyperscale
description: Hyperscale is an AI-powered platform designed to automate the sales process by sourcing customer leads and handling personalized email outreach. The system utilizes cutting-edge AI to discover, verify, and generate leads from multiple popular databases. Subsequently, the tool creates and sends high-response personalized messages tailored uniquely to every recipient, thereby boosting engagement rates. Hyperscale also allows users to define their ideal audience, specifying the necessary criteria to gather millions of verified leads precisely tailored to their needs. The features also support personalization at large scale, with messages adapted according to the recipient's role, interests, specific needs, and professional background. Additionally, Hyperscale offers omnichannel campaign management, enabling users to connect to multiple platforms such as Gmail, Outlook, LinkedIn, and even Instagram for wider outreach. It further integrates with any Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system for streamlined operations. The platform also supports scheduling, allowing users to choose follow-up cadence, respectful outreach times optimized for read and response rates, among other parameters. Its versatility extends its application across various sectors such as B2B services, B2B software, and Direct-To-Consumer products, and facilitates integration with the user's existing workflow.

name: Helloii
description: Helloii is a powerful tool designed to enhance the browsing experience for its users. Rather than using the traditional method of typing keywords into a search bar or scrolling through overwhelming pages of search results, users can interact with Helloii in a conversational way. It uses ChatGPT, an advanced conversational bot, to help users navigate and search the internet in a more natural and relaxed manner. Being an extension tool, it seamlessly integrates with the Chrome browser increasing convenience for the user. User reviews suggest it is an informative and engaging tool, greatly enhancing browser interactions.

name: Chat AI by SecurityInfinity
description: Chat AI - Ask Anything is an artificial intelligence powered tool designed to provide immediate answers to user queries on a wide range of topics. The tool uses a chat interface, making it easy and interactive for users to ask questions. It's powered by an advanced language model capable of understanding complex queries and providing accurate and relevant responses. Apart from delivering answers, Chat AI also acts as a personal assistant, aiding in setting reminders, scheduling meetings, and providing suggestions such as restaurant recommendations based on location. It offers a wide array of customization options, allowing users to tailor the tool to meet specific needs and preferences. The app showcases a commitment to data privacy and security, with measures such as encryption of data in transit and the option for users to request data deletion.

name: Faros
description: Faros AI is an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-guided platform developed for Engineering Operations. It serves as an infrastructure tool for these operations, providing an integrated view across multiple performance indicators such as velocity, quality, and goals. The platform utilizes AI technology to enhance the clarity and efficiency of engineering operations and initiatives.Faros AI enables measurement of quality and productivity in fresh ways by creating a unified platform for operational data. This allows for more informed decision-making based on data rather than relying solely on intuition, thus improving resource utilization and effectiveness. It also allows users to connect their engineering data sources to Faros AI for a comprehensive overview of operations. The platform supports data ingestion, transformation, and visualization and is API-driven, making it extendable at each level.For different leaders and stakeholders, Faros AI provides various insights which include: identifying systemic issues affecting software delivery, measuring team health and tech debt, tracking progress towards goals, and spotting dependencies and bottlenecks in processes. Faros AI also allows for the creation of custom charts and dashboards if pre-exisiting modules do not fulfill an organization's needs.Faros AI is compatible with over 70 integrations, enhancing its adaptability and making it a one-stop-shop for engineering operations. These integrations help the platform to function seamlessly within a range of different technological ecosystems.

name: Stellaris
description: Stellaris AI is a key pioneer in the generative AI landscape, offering a cutting-edge solution known as Stellaris GPT (SGPT). The technology designed by Stellaris AI is purposeful in implementing real-time context learning, which allows the AI to understand and adapt to dynamic environments promptly while delivering complex computational tasks efficiently. A distinctive feature is its robust native-safety technology that enhances its error-tolerance and resilience to unanticipated inputs, increasing the system's reliability. Stellaris AI also provides an emphasis on foolproof data protection by allowing full local deployment. The flagship AI, SGPT, stands as a revolutionary achievement that has formed unique intellectual property rights, its performance setting high standards for the industry. Stellaris AI continues to innovate, attracting interest for its upcoming projects like the SGPT-3.0. Communication lines with the platform are kept open via social networks and directly via email for inquiries or joining a waitlist.

name: CodeStack AI
description: CodeStack AI is an AI-driven code learning platform that adopts a hands-on approach to teach coding. It aims to redefine the traditional ways of learning to code by emphasizing active learning instead of passive theory-based learning methods. The platform encourages learners to write code from the initial stages and quickly put theories into practical use. Apart from this, CodeStack AI also offers a highly personalized learning experience powered by AI, enabling learners to master coding on mobile devices. The platform's key features include detailed step-by-step guidance and immediate feedback, fostering a dynamic learning environment that simplifies the understanding of even the most complex coding concepts. Besides this, CodeStack AI also equips learners with logical thinking abilities and problem-solving skills, which are considered vital for coding. It also underscores the promising career prospects and flexible working conditions in programming and development, reinforcing the relevance of acquiring coding skills.

name: A Data Coffee
description: A Data Coffee is a chatbot-powered tool that aims to train teams on data and analytics through interactive mini-courses. The tool integrates directly with Slack, allowing team members to access training courses without leaving their workspace. The interactive mini-courses are designed to be completed in a short span of time, such as the duration of enjoying a cup of coffee.The tool offers learning paths on various themes related to data, including marketing, sales, and product. Team members can choose their preferred learning paths and decide when they want to receive the courses. Learning paths consist of a series of courses that can be assigned to team members, and progress can be tracked through the tool's interface.A Data Coffee eliminates barriers to learning by delivering interactive courses directly in Slack, the tool that teams already use on a daily basis. This ensures that team members can quickly develop their data knowledge without the need for a separate platform. The tool also provides a user-friendly interface to track everyone's progress.In addition to its training features, A Data Coffee offers a robust payments platform and simplified card issuing, aiming to streamline checkout and optimize platforms. The tool provides support 24/7 for any inquiries or issues that users may encounter.The pricing structure includes a free plan that accommodates up to two learners, making it suitable for solo entrepreneurs and small teams. For additional learners, a per-learner monthly fee applies, with the option to save 20% by opting for an annual payment.Overall, A Data Coffee provides a convenient and comprehensive solution for teams to build their data culture and enhance their data expertise.
features: ✅ Pricing for solo and small teams

name: Autory
description: Autory is an automation tool aimed at increasing business productivity by automating repetitive tasks. These tasks are often tedious, time-consuming, and distract employees from more meaningful work. Autory focuses on developing bespoke solutions, tailored to the unique needs of a specific business or workflow. Prioritizing a collaborative approach, the process begins with the customer sharing their workflows and related challenges. After understanding these intricacies, Autory proposes an automation solution crafted to address those specific issues. Upon the customer's confirmation, an account for their business is set up and work commences on creating their bespoke automation solution. A distinctive feature of Autory is the continuous improvement and evolution of its automation methods. As the platform discovers and develops new ways to enhance their automation methods, those updates are shared with clients to improve their solutions. Another aspect of Autory's service provision is its personal support. The company aims to partner automation with a human touch to effectively meet customer needs and queries. Thus, despite its heavy concentration on automation, significant tasks such as customer interaction remain human-led. Their pricing model is focused on the value it provides by saving their customers' time, facilitating easy business scaling.

name: MindMac
description: MindMac is a ChatGPT client designed for macOS. It functions as a seamless and efficient tool to access and interact with AI models like OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and others. In terms of productivity, it offers extensive features such as the 'powerful inline mode', which enables quick content generation or querying in any application without window switching being required. Feature list: - Support multiple AI providers: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, GoogleAI with Gemini, Google Cloud Vertex AI with Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter, MistralAI, TogetherAI, OctoAI, Perplexity, Cohere (Command R & Command R+), Grog, KeyMateAI, Anyscale, DeepSeek - Fully support local LLM via Ollama, LMStudio, GPT4All, llama.cpp, MLX - Support fine-tuned models - Instant Inline mode. Use MindMac directly in any other applications. No windows switching. - File upload (RAG): users can add files and ask something about them - Image generation (DALLE 2 & DALLE 3) & Image vision (GPT-4o, GPT-4-Vision, Google Gemini Pro Vision, Ollama LLaVA, Claude 3 Sonnet/Opus/Haiku) - Support Audio Input (Speech to Text) and Output (Text to Speech) - Support web browsing with Google Search, Brave Search, Kagi Search, You Search, Tavily, Serper & SerpApi - Customizable API parameters (temperature, topP, topK, presence penalty, frequency penalty, max tokens) - Customizable output preferences (language, tone, style, format) - Customizable API endpoint and network proxy (HTTP/SOCKS5) - Conversation style control (More Precise or More Creative) - Context control (Context-free, all messages, some first messages, some last messages) - 150 built-in prompt templates & 25 built-in occupation templates - Highly customizable hotkey and shortcuts - Usage estimation (tokens & cost) - Light/dark mode - Export conversation to PDF/Markdown/ShareGPT - Useful quick actions: Rewrite, Fix grammar, Summarize, Develop, Diagram (generate flow/sequence/chart diagram), Explain - Awesome chat management: nested folder, favorite chats, archive chats, auto generate chat title - Localized in 15 popular languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, European Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Arabic, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese. - And more at https://mindmac.app/#whatmore It's designed to be native and fast, providing a friendly user interface that's optimized for macOS. Already trusted by numerous AI enthusiasts globally, it allows individuals and teams to easily and effectively leverage the power of ChatGPT on a macOS environment.
features: ✅ Optimized for Mac Intel & Apple M1/M2/M3
✅ Upcoming features like iDevices Sync via iCloud

name: Comicai
description: Comicai is an AI tool that enables anyone to create their own comic artworks. With its easy-to-use interface and intuitive features, it offers two modes for users to start their comic creation journey. In the Story Mode, users can either input their story or upload a file, and Comicai's AI generator will bring the story to life by turning it into vibrant comic panels. Alternatively, users can opt for the Freestyle Mode, where they can enjoy a step-by-step DIY process of creating comics.One of the notable features of Comicai is its ability to extract characters from the story and transform them into comic profiles. Users can further refine the character images by revising the prompts provided by the tool. Additionally, Comicai's AI generator can also imagine comic pictures, referred to as Panels, based on the story. Users have the freedom to regenerate and modify each panel as desired, without any time constraints.Once users are satisfied with their comic works, Comicai allows them to conveniently download their creations. The tool also offers seamless integration with social media platforms, enabling users to effortlessly share their comics with their fans and followers. Comicai strives to provide a user-friendly experience, making it accessible for individuals with varying levels of artistic expertise.To stay connected with its user base, Comicai encourages users to join the online communities it has established on platforms like Discord, TikTok, Instagram, and Twitter. By doing so, users can immerse themselves in the world of AI art and engage with other comic enthusiasts.

name: ArtBot
description: ArtBot is a web-based tool that enables users to generate AI-created images and photos using Stable Diffusion. The tool utilizes a distributed computing cluster known as the AI Horde to process the creations. With ArtBot, users can create images without the need for login or any associated costs, as it is free to use.By navigating through the various options provided, users can control the image generation process. They can define prompts, select image models, and set the image's orientation and size. Additionally, users can determine the number of steps and the level of guidance for the AI algorithm. Optional inputs such as seed and CLIP skip can also be specified.ArtBot offers post-processing options to enhance the generated images. Users can utilize GFPGAN and CodeFormers to improve facial features, strip the image's background, or apply upscaling techniques using RealESRGAN_x4plus and RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6BNMKD_Siax4x_AnimeSharp.The web application, designed with care and passion by @davely, is easily accessible and user-friendly. Users can find more information about ArtBot, as well as frequently asked questions and the changelog, on the corresponding website pages. In addition, the project's GitHub repository provides further details and resources.Overall, ArtBot provides a convenient platform for those interested in creating AI-generated images using Stable Diffusion, offering various customization options and leveraging the power of distributed computing through the AI Horde.

name: Outside AI
description: Outside: AI Countdown & Events is an application available on the Apple App Store designed for iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch devices. The application specializes in providing countdown and event alerts customized according to the user's needs. Users can track, set reminders and anticipate vital dates for events using this app. Its core function relies on integrating artificial intelligence technology to enhance user interaction, automate event creation, and trigger reminders. Although some visual aspects of the application such as screenshots have been mentioned, the emphasis is on the functional capabilities and the application's artificial intelligence-driven countdown and event management system. Remember, this is an application focused on enhancing event management and countdown processes using artificial intelligence technology, not a hardware product or accessory.

name: Social Intents
description: The Live Chat Software by Social Intents allows users to communicate with their website visitors through various messaging platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Slack, and ChatGPT. With this tool, users can chat with website visitors directly from these platforms without the need to switch between different applications. The software offers customization options, allowing users to customize chat settings, logos, and office hours. It also provides features like chat transcripts, reporting, and integration with automation tools like Zapier. One notable feature is the integration with ChatGPT AI Chatbots, which users can embed on their websites and train with their own content. This allows for the automation of customer interaction while also providing the option for human escalation when required. The tool is designed to improve customer happiness by providing real-time customer support. Users can engage with customers in their preferred messaging platform, eliminating the need for customers to learn additional software to communicate with the company. Additionally, the Live Chat Software aims to boost revenue by helping users close more sales online. By engaging with potential customers when they need assistance, users can increase conversions and revenue. The tool is easy to set up and can be installed in just a few minutes. Overall, the Live Chat Software by Social Intents offers a convenient and customizable solution for businesses to communicate with their website visitors effectively and efficiently.

name: Circleback
description: Circleback is an AI-powered tool that assists with creating meeting notes and managing workflows in real time. It is compatible with multiple digital platforms including Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Slack. One of its key features is generating notes from both online and in-person meetings, automatically providing detailed post-meeting summaries and action items. The tool allows users to concentrate on their meetings while it takes notes and acts on relevant insights. The generated notes can then be reviewed and shared among attendees, supporting improved communication and action planning. Circleback features a powerful AI-powered search, which allows users to easily retrieve specific conversations. To increase productivity and efficiency, the tool can create workflows to automatically detect and act on insights, integrating with Slack, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, Salesforce, among others. Transcription of meetings in more than 100 languages is provided, with speaker identification included in the service. This feature uses industry-leading AI transcription models, resulting in highly accurate transcripts. Through integrations, Circleback can interact and update data in other platforms such as HubSpot, Attio and Salesforce. The tool is designed to maintain utmost security and privacy, keeping data encrypted both at rest and in transit, ensuring that meetings are only accessible to those who are granted permission.

name: ApplAI
description: applai.me is an AI-powered application designed to aid job seekers in their pursuit of successful employment. The tool greatly simplifies the process of job hunting by providing AI-generated interview questions, personalized based on the specific job a user is applying for. In addition to interview preparation, the application also has a cover letter generator that creates customized and attention-grabbing letters using uploaded CVs and job descriptions. Further, applai.me features a CV Check tool, which aids in optimizing a CV by identifying vital keywords and skills from the job description and ensures they are included in the CV. This helps job seekers enhance their chances of getting screened positively. The platform is also equipped with functionality to match CVs to job descriptions, underscoring relevant skills and experiences further increasing the chances of an applicant getting shortlisted. With its integrated capabilities, applai.me aims to unlock user potential and increase their chances of standing out from the competition in the job market.
features: ✅ CV Check feature for critical keywords

name: Cheshire Cat AI
description: Cheshire Cat AI is a production-ready AI framework that enables the creation of AI agents using Python. It offers extensive functionality for training AI models. The AI models can be trained using various types of documents including pdf, txt, markdown, JSON, and web pages. The tool is designed to easily connect to external APIs and apps, providing a seamless way to integrate the AI agents with other software services. Users have the option to use either commercial or open language models, providing flexibility for different application needs. Cheshire Cat AI framework is dockerized, which simplifies the deployment process ensuring a production-ready agent. An abundance of plugins is available to extend the capabilities of the AI agent, which can be easily installed from the community registry or developed by the user. Moreover, the framework provides smart dialogues functionality that improves the conversation flow with the help of custom events, commands and goal-oriented dialogue. It also provides a platform to create cutting edge conversational skills with hooks, tool functions calling and forms.
features: ✅ Supports diverse document types for training
✅ Offers both commercial and open language models
✅ Use of forms for conversational skills

name: Snappify
description: Snappify is a powerful tool designed to animate code snippets in various ways to create stunning code presentations and videos. It provides first-class support for code snippets used in presentations and allows the creation of interactive slides enabling viewers to easily copy snippets and interact with links. Snappify offers visually engaging infographics for social media, boosting the quality of technical content and engagement levels of followers. Used widely in education, it simplifies the process of creating educational content, aiding students in understanding and retaining complex technical concepts. The tool allows for the embedding of interactive infographics. Users can embed visuals for easy copying of code snippets or texts by viewers. This can revitalize blogs or internal company documentation with rich infographics. The platform also provides support, ensuring your infographics look great across various platforms like Hashnode, Notion, and Medium. Additional features include the capacity to add multiple code windows for comparison, a powerful rich-text editor for placing explanation text and arrows beside snippets, the facility to upload custom images and user avatar branding for code snippets shared on social media platforms such as Twitter, Github, Instagram or LinkedIn.

name: Unlost
description: Unlost is an AI-powered tool designed to enhance memory recall effortlessly. By utilizing natural language processing, it allows users to navigate their "memory palace" and retrieve information quickly and easily. Unlike traditional methods such as bookmarking or note-taking, Unlost eliminates the need for these time-consuming steps. Users can simply search and ask, using related words to connect the dots in their memory. The tool starts capturing information as soon as it is installed, without requiring any integration or setup. With its performant interface, Unlost provides a snappy user experience, eliminating waiting time for responses and clunky chat interfaces. Data privacy is a top priority, as no information ever leaves the user's computer. Unlost optimizes its processing to minimize the amount of data stored and utilizes batch processing for increased efficiency. Additionally, it provides convenient features such as searching Zoom, Meet, and Teams transcripts, extracting text by highlighting an area, and utilizing familiar keyboard shortcuts. The tool offers the flexibility to stop capturing specific apps, websites, or completely halt the capturing process according to user preferences. Unlost supports various platforms and ensures low storage usage. Information regarding CPU/energy consumption is not mentioned. The tool is provided free of charge without specified reasons. For further details on data handling and privacy, users can refer to the Privacy Policy available on their website.

name: Transkribieren
description: Transkribieren (Transcribe in seconds) is an AI tool designed to assist in audio transcription. It boasts of high speed, accuracy and the ability to transcribe different audio file formats. The tool supports files such as mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, or webm, with a maximum size of up to 25MB. Transkribieren is easy to use, and users can upload their audio files and start transcribing in seconds. The tool eliminates the need for manual transcription that is generally slow and time-consuming. It uses Artificial Intelligence technology to convert audio to text and deliver transcriptions within a short time. Transkribieren releases regular updates, and version 0.2 was recently launched. Users can sign up to the website and receive updates on the latest features and news on AI audio transcription. Overall, Transkribieren's objective is to help users save time and improve accuracy in audio transcription. It provides a fast and reliable solution that can be suitable for several industries such as legal, medical, and research.

name: CGDream
description: An AI image-generation tool, CGDream bolsters creators with the ability to generate images from provided textual descriptions. It is versatile in usage, suitable for a range of applications including art generation, social media content creation, advertising, and more. Once provided with a specific mass of text, CGDream uses an AI model to generate a unique image reflecting the instructions given in the prompts. These prompts can also include negative commands, allowing the user to exclude specific elements from the image. The tools capabilities extend to allowing description of image dimensions as well as the quantity of images to be generated. CGDream enables the user to select an AI model which best fits the purpose of the image creation, with each model potentially trained on differing data and thereby offering unique styles and qualities. Furthermore, the tool allows for adjustments in image quality and details, providing the user with as much or as little input as they wish. Additionally, it includes features to adjust the chaos and creativity in the image and select up to five suggested filters to enhance image quality and style, based on the given prompts. Images generated are default set to private, and need to be intentionally shared by the user. CGDream is a robust tool for creative image generation using AI.

name: Generative Press
description: The Generative Press is a unique news platform where all articles are written entirely by Artificial Intelligence (AI) journalists. These AI personalities analyze data from Twitter and other popular news sites, getting live inputs from tweets by verified citizen journalists. After gathering this information, they generate news articles across various genres, from satirical to serious, without any human intervention. Unlike conventional news platforms, The Generative Press operates without an editorial team. It exhibits a diverse array of AI journalists, each with its unique style and perspective, creating varied content for readers. The platform encompasses news sections such as World, United States and India. Note that all content, opinions and motivations expressed are solely that of the AI personalities and do not reflect the views of the creators. The website carries a disclaimer stating that the website's creators are not responsible for any consequences resulting from actions based on information provided on the platform and they cannot be held liable for anything that may arise as a consequence.

name: AI powered content generator
description: Eka Yazılım İçerik Oluşturucu is an AI-powered content generator that allows users to create engaging and unique content to increase conversions and drive sales. The tool offers ready-to-use templates for various types of content creation, including articles, blogs, social media ads, and more. It uses AI technology to create quality content in seconds, including written documents and images that can be used to increase content engagement. The tool is easy to use, with a simple three-step process consisting of selecting a content creation template, adding a detailed description of the content requested by the user, and receiving high-quality content ready to be published. It offers over 50 templates, covering various content needs, making it an efficient way to automate content creation. The tool is accessible via login or registration and has a user-friendly interface. Eka Yazılım İçerik Oluşturucu is suitable for businesses and individuals who need to create engaging content quickly and efficiently. The tool's flexibility and customization options make it a valuable resource for content writing and marketing teams. Additionally, the tool's integration with social media platforms and its ability to generate hashtags, headlines, and call-to-actions, makes it a comprehensive solution for social media content creation.

name: Stable Diffusion API
description: The Playground - Stable Diffusion and Dreambooth API is a tool that allows users to play with stable diffusion models through an easy-to-use user interface (UI). This API provides the ability to generate and finetune dreambooth stable diffusion models. It offers a variety of options and functionalities for users to experiment with stable diffusion and dreambooth features.The tool offers a range of endpoints for different functionalities, including text to image, image to image, inpainting, and fetching queued images. Users can upload and manipulate images, apply prompts and negative prompts to guide the API, and set parameters such as scale, steps, and random seed. The API also supports the use of a webhook URL for notification when image generation is completed.Furthermore, the API offers advanced options such as selecting the scheduler (e.g., DDPMScheduler, LMSDiscreteScheduler) and specifying the number of samples desired in the response. There are also options to upgrade the plan for higher limits and to access additional resources for the stable diffusion API.The tool provides API documentation, pricing information, and a catalogue of other APIs to help users get started. It also offers enterprise plans for users requiring dedicated GPU for faster model execution. The tool is supported by Stable Diffusion API, a company that specializes in stable diffusion models, and additional information about the company, including models, documentation, and testimonials, can be found on their website.
features: ✅ Guided by prompt and negative prompt

name: Subject Line Generator
description: The Subject Line Generator, powered by Newsletter Pilot, is an AI tool designed to assist users in creating catchy email subject lines to improve their email open rates. The tool operates quickly, generating subject lines in seconds. The Subject Line Generator is particularly useful for those involved in email marketing, as it helps create compelling subject lines that capture the attention of recipients and entice them to read the email. The Subject Line Generator is also integrated with Newsletter Pilot's AI technology, which allows users to fully automate their newsletter creation. The tool is expected to launch soon on NewsletterPilot.com and the first 200 users will receive a six-month free subscription. In summary, the Subject Line Generator is a tool that utilizes AI to generate attention-grabbing subject lines quickly, making it useful for individuals and businesses looking to improve the efficacy of their email marketing campaigns. With the anticipated integration to Newsletter Pilot, the Subject Line Generator can also streamline the newsletter creation process for users looking to automate their email marketing efforts.

name: Reemix
description: Reemix.co is an AI-powered short video platform that uses unique Text2Video feature to transform words into personalized and captivating content that cannot be found anywhere else. The platform allows users to express their creativity using prompts such as rolling stone hitting mountain or Angelina Jolie floating on lava. The user-generated content is curated using AI technology to ensure they meet quality standards. Apart from these prompts, users can also create their own videos, and the platform provides a Discord bot that makes it easy to add videos to discord servers. Additionally, Reemix.co offers a mobile app available on Google Play for easy access to the platform's features. Reemix.co offers a unique platform for users to create and share video content without the need for advanced video editing skills. The AI technology powering the platform makes it possible for users to express their creativity in different ways by using various prompts or creating their own themes. The curated content ensures that high-quality videos are available for viewing, providing a satisfying user experience. If you are looking for a platform to create and share unique and personalized video content, Reemix.co could be an ideal choice.

name: Health Harbor
description: Health Harbor is an AI-powered tool designed to automate billing processes for private medical practices. It streamlines the often time-consuming task of working with insurance companies by eliminating the need for manual phone calls and paperwork. Using Health Harbor is a simple and efficient process. Users can submit requests by inputting patient information and specifying whether they need eligibility or claims assistance. This can be done as easily as sending an email. The AI technology behind Health Harbor takes over from there, making the necessary calls to insurance companies on behalf of the practice. It retrieves the information requested and presents it in an easily accessible dashboard. Users can instantly view the status of their requests in real-time.Once a request is completed, Health Harbor allows users to view and print the full eligibility or claim status directly from the platform. This eliminates the need for additional manual steps or transferring of data.In terms of security, Health Harbor places a high priority on the protection of patient and organizational data. It adheres to HIPAA compliance standards and utilizes Vanta, a trusted monitoring system, to ensure the integrity of its technical infrastructure.Overall, Health Harbor offers a convenient and secure solution for automating billing processes in private medical practices, reducing administrative workload and improving efficiency.

name: Dreamcard.ai
description: Dreamcard.ai is an AI tool that allows users to create personalized postcards using their own photos and a list of hand-crafted presets. Using advanced AI technology, the tool automatically processes photos uploaded by a user and generates a list of preset images to choose from. Users can choose from various preset options like astronauts, cyborgs, and scientists to create a unique postcard. Dreamcard.ai automatically selects the appropriate aspect ratio, crops the image, and formats the front and back of the printable postcard depending on the user's region. Once the user completes the order, the postcard is printed and delivered worldwide in just a matter of days.The tool comes with a credit system, where users receive credits to generate images upon registration. Users can also top up their credits for continuing to generate images. The generated images are of high-quality, thanks to the tool's market-leading expertise in AI-generated printable art and state-of-the-art upscaling algorithms. Dreamcard.ai also promises to add more features in the future, such as the ability to draw someone onto the card using uploaded images, support for different types of cards, including greeting and anniversary cards, and even wall posters. Dreamcard.ai is a simple and streamlined tool that provides a fun and creative way to send personalized postcards to loved ones around the world.

name: Review Summarizer
description: Review Summarizer is a tool that provides users with a concise summary of product reviews written by other customers. Specifically designed to analyze and extract key information from customer reviews, it aims to offer a quick and convenient overview of the opinions expressed by different users. To utilize the tool, users must simply paste the URL of the desired product from Amazon into the designated field.By employing natural language processing techniques, Review Summarizer is able to comprehend and evaluate the content of customer reviews. Through this analysis, it generates a summary that highlights the main points and sentiments expressed by reviewers. This allows users to quickly grasp the overall perception of a product, as well as identify recurring themes or concerns mentioned by multiple customers.This tool is particularly useful for individuals seeking a condensed overview of customer reviews, as sifting through large quantities of text can be time-consuming and overwhelming. By providing a succinct summary, Review Summarizer saves users valuable time and effort, enabling them to make informed purchasing decisions more efficiently.It should be noted that Review Summarizer is specifically tailored for Amazon product reviews. It avoids making any claims about the accuracy or completeness of the summaries it produces, as they are based on the information extracted from customer reviews themselves. Users are encouraged to utilize the tool as a supplementary resource when considering product purchases, in order to gain a general understanding of the opinions expressed by other customers.

name: Gita AI
description: Gita GPT Krishna AI Bhagavad is an AI-powered application designed for individuals who want to engage with the profound teachings of the Bhagavad Gita and the insights of Lord Krishna. The app provides access to chapters, verses, and commentary on the Bhagavad Gita, offering a comprehensive understanding of the timeless teachings that transcend generations.Using AI-generated personalized guidance, the app helps individuals analyze their preferences, interests, and stage of life to offer relevant verses, interpretations, and practical advice to enrich their spiritual practices. Users can gain insights and teachings of Lord Krishna, the central figure of the Bhagavad Gita, through AI-generated messages that provide wisdom, compassion, and guidance to navigate life's challenges and seek inner transformation.The app also provides a daily dose of spiritual nourishment with uplifting wisdom and inspirational quotes from the Bhagavad Gita and Lord Krishna, as well as guided meditations to help users connect with their inner self and deepen their spiritual practice. Additionally, the app allows users to bookmark their favorite verses, quotes, and insights for easy access and future reference while enabling personal annotations and reflections to capture their spiritual journey and growth.Gita GPT Krishna AI Bhagavad supports multiple languages, allowing seekers from diverse backgrounds to engage with the timeless wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita and Lord Krishna's teachings. The app provides a transformative spiritual journey guided by the divine wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita and Lord Krishna.

name: ActiveInterview
description: ActiveInterview is an AI-powered tool designed to automate the recruitment process, enhancing efficiency and decision-making in hiring. It provides a platform for conducting automated video interviews, allowing candidates to seamlessly record and submit their responses. This tool helps streamline the candidate evaluation process through AI-assisted job listing creation, thus helping employers ask pertinent questions for each role. Post-interview, team members can collaboratively review and rate responses in real time, making the tool highly suitable for remote and distributed teams. The AI-driven interface also generates interview transcripts, making it easier to refer back to essential candidate information. Additionally, the collaborative review option fosters team-wide involvement in the hiring decision, further enhancing the suitability of the candidate. The application offers coherence and flexibility in interview coordination by enabling organizations to set flexible time frames and bulk invitations. It also allows for a cohesive brand experience by providing personalized 'company branding' features. ActiveInterview integrates seamlessly with other software, including Zapier, improving the overall recruiting experience. It also offers customer support through email assistance, live chat, and zoom, ensuring a steady and reliable user experience. It's noteworthy that the tool safeguards candidate responses and job listings by offering varied data retention periods depending on the chosen plan. In its commitment to improve the hiring process, ActiveInterview serves as a comprehensive, intuitive, and user-friendly AI tool that leverages technology to simplify the recruitment process.

name: BiglyPage
description: Bigly Pages is an AI tool that specializes in the creation of Landing Pages. It offers a user-friendly platform that allows users to access the tool by logging in through a designated link. With a focus on simplicity, Bigly Pages lets users upload their company logo and select an industry from a comprehensive list, which includes sectors such as advertising, agriculture, architecture, artificial intelligence, automotive, banking, and many more.The purpose of this tool is to generate high-quality landing pages for businesses from a wide range of industries. By utilizing artificial intelligence, Bigly Pages aims to streamline the process of page creation, making it quick and efficient. Users are able to add features and services to their landing pages, enhancing their functionality and customization.With an interface that simplifies the process of website generation, Bigly Pages users are presented with a "Please Wait" message while the tool creates their landing page. This emphasizes the tool's commitment to speed and efficiency, providing users with a ready-to-use page in a timely manner.In summary, Bigly Pages is an AI-powered tool that enables businesses to create landing pages without extensive technical knowledge or expertise. Its user-friendly interface and industry-specific options make it an efficient solution for companies across a wide array of sectors.

name: GenAI by Meta
description: Meta AI is a new tool developed by Meta that offers a variety of new AI experiences. With Meta AI, users can engage in 1-on-1 or group chats with AI assistants that can provide recommendations, answer questions, settle debates, and offer unique perspectives on topics like travel, games, and food. In addition, users can generate images by simply describing their ideas, and Meta AI will bring them to life. The tool also allows users to chat with a choice of 28 AI characters, each with their own personality and backstory, some of which are played by recognizable public figures. Meta AI also includes creative tools that enable users to express themselves in new ways. Users can generate customized stickers by typing in a text prompt, providing more options to convey their feelings and express themselves. Additionally, users can apply new visual styles to their photos by describing the desired effect, and Meta AI will restyle the image accordingly. Meta emphasizes responsible AI development, ensuring the safety and responsibility of its AI systems. They incorporate safeguards into their AI features and models and leverage safety and responsibility training, tailored to each specific feature. Users can learn more about Meta's responsible AI approach and their generative AI features on their website.For more information on Meta's new AI experiences and tools, users can visit their newsroom and AI blog to stay up-to-date with the latest news and trends in AI.

name: Botsheets
description: Botsheets is an AI tool designed to automate lead generation and customer interaction processes through the creation of AI chatbots that read and capture data in Google Sheets. This no-code tool enables the generation of personalized responses through querying of user data, along with capturing leads and insights by extracting data from conversations and analyzing through AI. It offers the capability to understand and respond in multiple languages, and integrates easily with external platforms through widgets, embedded chat, or direct links. Users can customize chatbots to match their brand, set engagement rules, and ensure privacy by controlling the data shared with the AI. It keeps AI in sync with any changes to your datasets, providing a dynamic, responsive system for managing and delivering customer interaction. It also offers features such as multilingual compatibility, reading and writing to spreadsheets, auto-sync of data sources, and customizable rules of chatbot engagement. Furthermore, Botsheets allows for seamless integration into a website or standalone application via direct sharing of links, embedding into a page, or connecting with their API.

name: Pieces.app
description: Pieces for Developers is an AI-enabled tool designed to enhance developer productivity. With this tool, developers can efficiently save, search, share, and reuse essential developer resources. It provides a centralized hub where users can store and access code snippets and screenshots, leveraging the power of AI to optimize their workflow.The tool offers a productivity-focused Copilot and a suite of plugins, tailored to enhance efficiency and streamline development tasks. The Copilot feature promotes productivity by offering relevant suggestions, helping developers complete tasks more quickly and accurately. This AI-powered component aims to assist developers in their coding endeavors, offering contextual recommendations based on their specific needs.Moreover, Pieces for Developers emphasizes collaboration by enabling developers to share resources with their team members. By providing a centralized repository, it allows for seamless sharing and reuse among colleagues, reducing redundancy and fostering collaboration.In addition to the aforementioned features, the tool also includes a comprehensive search functionality. This allows developers to swiftly locate and retrieve specific code snippets and screenshots relevant to a particular project, eliminating the need for manual search efforts.Overall, Pieces for Developers is an AI-powered tool that enhances productivity by organizing, sharing, and reusing essential developer resources. With its code snippets and screenshots hub, Copilot assistance, and collaboration capabilities, this tool equips developers with the necessary tools to optimize their coding workflow and streamline their development process.

name: Sheeter
description: Sheeter.ai is an AI-powered tool that enables users to create complex excel formulas quickly and easily. The tool simplifies the otherwise tedious and time-consuming task of remembering or looking up formulas by automating the process. With Sheeter.ai, users enter their queries into the search bar, and the tool generates the corresponding formula. Users can copy the formula and paste it into their Excel sheet or download the Sheeter.ai add-on for easy access to the formula. Sheeter.ai works with both Excel and Google Sheets, which makes it versatile. The tool offers efficiency, transparency, control, and customization to increase productivity and save users time. Sheeter.ai is highly reliable and focused, making it a useful formula generator on the market that is designed to help users create and manage efficient Excel sheets. It is also highly customizable to meet specific user needs, such as generating specific formulas or creating entirely new sheets. In addition, the tool is faster and easier to use, making it more reliable than other formula generators available. Sheeter.ai is user-friendly and accessible for an individual user or a team, making it suitable for anyone looking to streamline their Excel worksheet work. With a catalog of most popular formulas generated by thousands of users worldwide, Sheeter.ai provides a hub of various formula templates readily available for users' convenience. The tool is free to try, and users can contact the team for any support needed.
features: ✅ Compatible with Excel and Google Sheets

name: Malloy
description: Malloy is an AI-powered tool designed for efficient and accurate transcription of videos. It specializes in recognizing and accurately transcribing diverse language nuances, including industry-specific terms and regional slangs. The AI not only transcribes the content but also understands the context of the spoken words, aiming to maintain the true essence of the content. The tool integrates the precision of professional human transcription with the cost-effectiveness of advanced technology. This helps users to focus on what truly matters rather than spending hours reviewing and correcting transcriptions. The process of using Malloy is simple; users upload their video to Malloy, review the errors identified by the system, and then either accept the corrections or fix them manually. Furthermore, Malloy offers collaborative features for team-based projects and prioritizes data security for all uploaded content. While the tool primarily targets content creators, it is also a valuable asset for professionals dealing with transcriptions frequently.

name: Lorai
description: Lorai is an AI tool designed to enable users to train their own LoRAs (Low-Rank Adaptations) without the need for coding. With Lorai, users can extend stable diffusion models to generate customized art. The tool emphasizes the simplicity of its interface, allowing users to create art without having to write any code.Lorai offers the ability to enhance existing art by applying LoRAs, resulting in refined artwork. This is exemplified by a before-and-after comparison, where the base model's artwork is transformed into alternative pop album cover art with a close-up cartoon portrait in focus.One notable feature of Lorai is the use of LoRAs instead of fine-tuning models, which leads to significantly smaller model sizes. Fine-tuned models can be up to 700 times larger than LoRAs. The example given showcases a decrease in model size from 3.84 GB to 4.78 MB. This reduction in size can be beneficial for resource usage and efficiency.Lorai further emphasizes its efficiency by claiming to save users hours of training time. By selecting a base model, the tool expedites the workflow, reducing the training time required from 5 hours to just 10 minutes.Overall, Lorai is a user-friendly AI tool that enables users to create custom AI art by leveraging LoRAs, regardless of their coding knowledge. With its emphasis on efficiency, model size reduction, and ease of use, Lorai offers an accessible solution for creating personalized art.

name: Rubberduck
description: Rubberduck is a Visual Studio Code extension designed to help developers code faster and more accurately. It uses AI to generate code, explain code, generate tests, find bugs, diagnose errors, and even create custom conversation templates. To set up, users will need to sign up for an OpenAI API key, which they can enter with the Rubberduck: Enter OpenAI API key command.The AI Chat feature allows developers to ask questions about their code and software development topics. This can be done through the command palette, editor context menu, keyboard shortcuts, or even the MacOS touch bar (if available). Rubberduck can generate code, edit code, explain code, generate tests, find bugs, diagnose errors, and more. All of these features can be accessed through the command palette, context menu, or keyboard shortcuts.Finally, users can create their own conversation templates in their .rubberduck/template folder. This allows them to craft AI chats that are specific to their conventions and use their own language. Rubberduck is a helpful tool for developers of all skill levels, allowing them to code faster and more accurately.

name: ProductListing
description: ProductListing.AI is an artificial intelligence (AI) software tool designed to facilitate the creation, optimization, and enhancement of product listings for online sellers. It utilizes sophisticated algorithms to analyze data from existing listings and identify target audiences, enabling the production of compelling and captivating content tailored to the preferences of the ideal customer. With ProductListing.AI, users can create a full listing in as little as 30 seconds. The software offers a range of monthly plans to suit a variety of budgets, and the free plan allows users to generate 2 listings per month with limited title and bullet point content. ProductListing.AI is trusted by over 500 brands, and is available in 5 languages.

name: Waanda
description: AI Sound Copilot is an AI-focused tool designed to generate unlimited AI-powered sound effects (SFX) for videos and games. Its core functionality revolves around creating immediate sound effects for user-uploaded videos as well as providing an all-in-one solution for game developers to generate required sound effects. One of the standout features of AI Sound Copilot is its ability to create customized sound effects based on detailed descriptions, offering users a unique and tailored auditory experience. In addition to the AI-generated sounds, a significant feature of AI Sound Copilot is that all its sound effects are royalty-free, designed using advanced AI technology. This ensures users can leverage the sound effects freely without having to worry about any legal concerns or licensing issues. AI Sound Copilot's sound effects are tailored and curated based on information provided by the user about their videos or games, eliminating the need for the user to spend unnecessary time searching the web for perfect, suitable sound effects. It's a tool that offers a comprehensive, efficient, and user-friendly way to source and generate appropriate sound effects for various types of media content.

name: roboMUA
description: Yshade.ai is an innovative tool crafted with create-react-app, leading to a robust and efficient application. It capitalizes on the power of AI to drive various solutions, yet the precise services it offers aren't specified in the provided text.
