LEGOAI aims to govern AI implementation through AI governance, enhance user experience through AI experience design, and deliver AI as a product. The founding team behind LEGOAI consists of individuals with expertise in AI engineering, innovation, data architecture, and product strategy.For more information and to get in touch with LEGOAI, contact details are provided, including phone number, email address, and physical address. The platform also has social media presence on Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

name: QuillAI
description: Quill AI is an AI-powered investor copilot that serves as a personal financial research assistant. This tool is designed to streamline financial research processes and boost productivity for investors. Quill AI has features that allow users to extract key information from investor materials simply by asking questions, reducing the time needed for reading filings and increasing time for investing. Users can also search SEC filings and earnings calls and screen stocks based on specific criteria using natural language, saving time spent on manual filtering. Quill AI can generate investment memos and provide access to datarooms for efficient data management and analysis.This tool has received positive testimonials from users in the financial industry, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency. Users have praised Quill AI for its ability to provide quick and accurate answers to complex questions, surpassing the capabilities of other AI models like ChatGPT. The tool has been used by hedge fund managers, Morgan Stanley traders, and senior analysts to compile updated lists of companies for consideration. Quill AI has gained recognition in the financial sector and has been featured in press releases, including being part of Y Combinator's S23 batch.Overall, Quill AI is a sophisticated AI-powered tool designed to assist investors in conducting financial research, saving time on information extraction, stock screening, and data management. Its intuitive natural language interface and advanced capabilities make it a valuable tool for professionals in the finance industry.

name: Maintain-AI
description: Maintain-AI is an AI tool that automates the inspection, analysis, and reporting of pavement and related infrastructure performance within a road network. This tool helps improve maintenance costs as it offers a faster and more affordable way to aggregate data, allowing for more informed decisions. Maintain-AI uses computer vision and machine learning models to detect different defect types and the severity of distresses as well as identify and assess numerous associated infrastructure elements from collected road network images. Its goal is to work with the industry to help 'keep the good roads good' by delivering a solution that supports more frequent and consistent road inspections, thereby enabling a marked improvement to data collection times, subjectivity, network visualization, and understanding cost impacts when compared to other traditional assessments and approaches. Maintain-AI's philosophy is established on "Good Roads Should Cost Less", and its commitment is to help road asset professionals make more informed and timely decisions from frequently and objectively collected data utilizing an automated road surface inspection approach that identifies how pavement assets are performing. This tool enables users responsible for road network asset management to optimize the use of available funding, better communicate funding needs, more objectively assess, monitor and support the management of the entire pavement network, and improve the efficiency of other useful, more expensive systems. Maintain-AI offers flexible options with or without long-term commitments to partnering and working with like-minded organizations to collectively support the infrastructure and transport sectors to constantly improve how our most important assets are inspected, analyzed, and managed.

name: SayBloom
description: SayBloom provides an immersive and personalized language learning experience leveraging advanced AI. It enables learners to practice real conversations, instantly receive feedback, and achieve fluency more efficiently. The AI tailors its interactions to the learner's skill level while also correcting errors and suggesting improvements. One of the layering features SayBloom offers is real-time pronunciation feedback through sophisticated speech recognition technology. This helps learners sound more like native speakers. The tool also provides in-depth language guides that cover grammar, vocabulary, and cultural insights to further support one's learning journey. Additional features available in the premium version include access to unlimited AI-enabled conversation practice, comprehensive learning guides, priority customer support, and an offline mode for learning on-the-go. Besides, SayBloom caters to learners of all levels, from beginners to advanced, and it offers courses in a range of languages including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and English.

name: Openkoda
description: Openkoda is an AI-powered open-source platform designed for efficient business application development. The platform offers pre-built application templates that aid in the streamlining of development cycles, enabling users to focus on unique functionality rather than building from scratch. These customizable templates are suitable for a range of applications, including but not limited to, insurance policy management and time tracking software. Furthermore, the platform is designed to avoid vendor-lock in, providing developers with full ownership of their code, allowing for considerable flexibility and control. Openkoda also lays the groundwork for quick development of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), offering pre-established core functionalities that can be easily customized to meet specific business needs. The platform also lends itself for application modernization, effectively helping organizations update, migrate, or re-platform their legacy systems. As an added advantage, Openkoda employs Artificial Intelligence (AI) which extends its business logic and user interface capabilities. As a scalable and secure platform, it provides multi-tenancy options and continuous OWASP security scans, ensuring a reliable solution for application development.

name: Magiscan
description: Magiscan is a 3D scanning application designed for iOS and Android platforms. This innovative tool utilizes artificial intelligence to scan objects and environments, allowing users to generate high-quality 3D models with their phone or tablet. It is trusted and used by professionals and ordinary people for its simplicity and performance. The app features multiple export formats, thus enhancing compatibility with other platforms and softwares. Formats supported include USDZ, GTLF, GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX, PLY, among others. Compatible with NVIDIA Omniverse, it is a valuable tool in the field of virtual and augmented reality applications. Magiscan also provides an API feature, which allows external platforms or applications to create 3D models using Magiscan technology. Furthermore, the app is frequently updated and improved based on user feedback and is reputed for its functionality and affordable access to 3D scanning technology. Its utility extends not only to individual users, but also to businesses, especially those in eCommerce. Lastly, developers of Magiscan prioritize erasing the boundary between the real and virtual worlds, thus enhancing the user experience and providing a practical tool in the growing demand for 3D content.

name: Seekho Resume Checker
description: ResumeChecker is an artificial intelligence-powered platform designed to optimize resumes by providing detailed feedback, suggestions and scoring. Users upload their resume to the system, which then analyzes it against a series of industry standards. It provides comprehensive feedback on content, formatting, and optimization, highlighting areas needing improvement. Aside from analyzing industry standards, it also checks grammar and spelling, ensuring the resume is professionally presented. The system is designed to beat Applicant Tracking Systems, helping users' resumes stand out to hiring managers. Further, users receive personalized suggestions based on their particular industry and job role. Once recommendations are implemented, users can re-upload their resume to view their improvements. The ResumeChecker is designed to not only improve resumes but also save time and effort that would otherwise be spent on manual review. While the AI-based rating system provides valuable insights, it is intended to be utilized along with human feedback for an enhanced outcome. It is also significant to note that although the platform is intended to optimize the user's resume, securing a job also relies on numerous factors beyond just the resume.

name: KBaseBot
description: KBaseBot is an AI tool that allows you to transform PDFs, Docx, Notion, and websites into dynamic chatbots. With KBaseBot, you can embed these chatbots on your platform, making your static content interactive and elevating your content into real-time dialogues. The tool offers a range of features to enhance your chatbot experience. KBaseBot can automate conversations with your customers, saving you time. It can also generate leads for your business and help you grow. The chatbot is easily customizable to fit your needs and brand. It can log all conversations, providing you with valuable conversation insights. KBaseBot is GDPR compliant, ensuring the security and privacy of user data. It is easy to use and does not require coding skills. The tool is powered by GPT-4, offering powerful chatbot capabilities. It is also secure and reliable, with 99.99% uptime guaranteed. The tool provides you with insightful analytics to make data-driven decisions.Suitable for various contexts, KBaseBot enables you to create chatbots that engage and support your audience in new ways. Whether it's answering frequently asked questions, providing product recommendations, or guiding users through complex processes, KBaseBot offers a versatile solution. The tool offers various pricing plans, including a free plan with limited features and scalable paid plans. KBaseBot is trusted by companies of all sizes and has received positive feedback for automating support and internal documentation processes. With its user-friendly interface and extensive customization options, KBaseBot is a valuable tool for improving customer experiences and managing knowledge bases efficiently.

name: Instacart ChatGPT plugin
description: The Instacart Plugin for ChatGPT leverages the power of AI technology to make meal planning and grocery shopping easier and more efficient. The plugin is an add-on to ChatGPT, a language model that enables users to express their needs in natural language. With this collaboration between Instacart and OpenAI, ChatGPT can now create Instacart orders based on meal-related conversations and suggestions, adding all the necessary ingredients to the user's Instacart cart in just a few clicks. The Instacart ChatGPT plugin helps users figure out what they need to make a particular meal, considering ingredients they may already have at home or their specific dietary restrictions. It creates an instant shopping list and allows users to get ingredients delivered to their door within an hour. The plugin works best in helping people shop for specific ingredients for a particular recipe and will expand to include new capabilities such as helping users shop for recipes that are on sale or in season.The plugin is designed to ensure safety and integrity while using language model technology. The ChatGPT plugin only responds to relevant food-related queries, and user's cannot use it for unrelated tasks. The Instacart Plugin for ChatGPT is an excellent tool that aims to solve the everyday meal planning struggle that most households face. This collaboration ensures that engineering investments are aligned with the company's long-term business strategy, offering an amazing tool that users can use to receive meal inspiration they can adapt to their liking.

name: Pseudoface
description: Pseudoface is an AI filter app designed specifically for faceless creators. It allows users to substitute their real face with an AI-generated realistic face, acting as a natural evolution of face blur apps. Pseudoface prioritizes privacy, ensuring that users remain anonymous and in control of their own data. The AI-generated pseudofaces are tailored to the shape and features of the user's face and are not real people.Using Pseudoface offers several benefits for creators. Firstly, it allows them to protect their privacy by hiding their identity from both humans and bots. Second, creators who show their face tend to earn more on average, and doing a face reveal often leads to bigger paychecks as faces attract more subscribers and enable creators to charge a premium for custom content. Additionally, showing one's face increases engagement, subscribers, and brand recognition, making it easier to form relationships with subscribers.Pseudoface offers different pricing plans that include various features such as unlimited masks, HD videos, and 4k pictures. The app also provides a free trial for users to test how their pseudofaces would look. Pseudoface emphasizes ethical AI usage and actively discourages the misuse of its tool. It utilizes face detection algorithms to understand the user's face in photos and videos, generating artificial faces using AI that fit the user's facial features.Overall, Pseudoface offers faceless creators the opportunity to grow their fan base, increase their income, and protect their privacy while maintaining engagement and brand recognition.

name: Billy
description: Billy is an AI-powered invoicing tool developed by Ambition Software Inc. It is an effortless solution for creating and managing invoices, targeted towards individuals and small businesses. Billy aims to reduce the labor intensive process of drafting invoices, making the billing mechanism smooth and efficient. The tool allows for flexible payment collection and supports not only major credit cards but also mobile direct-pay services including Apple Pay and Google Pay. Integrated with Stripe, it eases the process of accepting payments. It offers real-time tracking of invoices, so users can monitor interactions and be clear on when customers view or engage with their invoices. Further, Billy automates the delivery of invoices - it creates emails and PDFs which can then be sent with a single click, simplifying the overall invoicing process. Ensuring user's data privacy is a core value of the company, your data is never sold and you have the freedom to discontinue the service anytime. Billy is a cost-effective and user-friendly tool for straightforward and streamlined invoicing.

name: KittensAI
description: KittensAI is an AI-powered tool primarily designed to generate images of kittens based on user's input. By just instructing the AI, users can create images of kittens in specific situations, for example, a kitten playing in a park or sleeping in a bed. Images can also be created with particular themes such as a kitten in a magical forest or laying on a gaming controller. Users can employ it to generate unique kitten images with customizable contexts and backgrounds. This tool can be used in an array of languages, indicating its worldwide usability. Bearing in mind the user's convenience, KittensAI includes an array of features such as a gallery to explore more kitten images, API access, and various language options. The platform's technology stack includes Django for website development and a fork of imaginAIry powering the AI.
features: ✅ Faster image creation for pro users
✅ Highest quality images for pro users

name: Productroadmap
description: ProductRoadmap.ai is an AI-powered roadmapping suite that helps ensure product return on investment (ROI) by aligning roadmaps with sales efforts. The tool enables users to identify and prioritize feature gaps based on their impact on revenue, generate roadmaps, and seamlessly connect with sales teams. One of the key features of ProductRoadmap.ai is its ability to automatically extract deal-blocking feature gaps by analyzing customer relationship management (CRM) data and customer conversations using AI. This information is then categorized and added to the idea backlog for future consideration. The tool also facilitates revenue-based roadmapping, allowing users to quantify the impact of their product on revenue. By mapping CRM deal data to roadmap items, users gain a clear view of potential business impact, user needs, and internal value, enabling them to prioritize effectively.Furthermore, ProductRoadmap.ai streamlines product-sales alignment by automatically notifying sales representatives when features ship. This targeted alert system helps sales teams take prompt action to unblock stalled deals, capture upsell opportunities, and close pipeline.In addition to these core functionalities, ProductRoadmap.ai offers features such as competitive intelligence monitoring, roadmapping with customizable views, GTM planning, feature voting boards, public changelogs, AI feedback summarization, and automation of internal enablement processes.Overall, ProductRoadmap.ai aims to align product, marketing, and sales efforts in one centralized platform, providing users with better adoption rates, increased revenue impact, time savings for stakeholders, and potential cost savings. The tool has received positive feedback from users, highlighting its effectiveness in improving launch effectiveness, organizational efficiency, and process repeatability.

name: StoryScroll
description: StoryScroll is a web application designed and developed using Anvil, a platform known for facilitating the rapid and robust construction of full-stack web applications. Anvil provides users with the ability to create complex, dynamic, and responsive applications using a simplified and intuitive interface that fits in well with both beginner and advanced developers. StoryScroll leverages these capabilities to provide an enriched experience to its users. While the exact functionalities and features of StoryScroll were not specified in the reference text, it is likely to be a moderne web application with features designed to effectively meet the needs of its users. However, mention was made of the app experiencing some sort of error, indicating potential challenges or issues to be addressed by the developers. As with any application built on Anvil, updates and revisions to StoryScroll can be executed swiftly and efficiently, allowing for regular improvement and the quick resolution of issues.

name: Synthesis Youtube
description: Synthesis is an AI-based tool designed specifically for learners. It offers users an interactive and engaging platform to further their learning journey through the use of Artificial Intelligence. The primary function of Synthesis is its integration with YouTube, enabling users to effectively harness the educational content available on the video-sharing platform. To run this application, the user will need to enable JavaScript. Synthesis effectively navigates through YouTube's wide assortment of educational videos and provides a simplified educational experience. The tool's AI algorithms help in finding and organizing relevant study material, making it easier for learners to access useful educational content. In essence, Synthesis acts as a bridge between learners and YouTube, substantially enhancing the learning experience. However, this description does not cover all the functionalities of Synthesis, as updates and improvements could continuously be made to expand and enhance its features.

name: Respaid
description: Respaid is an AI-powered tool designed to help businesses collect small outstanding debts in a respectful and efficient manner. With a focus on friendly resolutions, Respaid aims to recover 50% of outstanding debts within 20 days, ranging from $5 to $5,000.One of Respaid's key features is its accessibility, as it treats all debts, regardless of amount, with fair and upfront pricing. Unlike traditional collection agencies, Respaid enables debtors to pay the business directly, ensuring that the company retains control over the payment process. Through the use of AI and intelligent timing and channel selection, Respaid maximizes the chances of successful debt collection.Getting started with Respaid is quick and easy, with no complex integration required. All that is needed is an Excel file containing the relevant debtor information. To simplify the payment process, Respaid allows customers to pay electronically without friction, ensuring a smooth transaction.Respaid also stands out for its commitment to transparency and customer satisfaction. Each debt collection is accompanied by personalized messages driven by AI, tailored to the debtor's reactions and delivered at the right time. Respaid measures not only the business's satisfaction but also that of the debtors, ensuring a positive experience for all parties involved.Overall, Respaid provides an alternative to traditional collection agencies by offering quick and hassle-free debt collection services with a focus on respect for both the business and the customers.

name: Albus.org
description: Albus is an AI-powered tool that helps users work with knowledge in a different way by allowing them to explore anything, connect different dots and discover new angles. This platform enables users to start with a topic and quickly shape their idea board by mixing, editing, and presenting content. It allows users to add notes and relevant images, control their content while presenting, and show and tell with ease. With Albus, every idea sparks a new one, and users can ask anything to generate new aspects. The platform has a user-friendly interface where users can type any title and begin to discover, wonder and explore. Albus is fueled by AI and mastered by humans, which means that it takes advantage of the power of AI to support and enhance human creativity rather than replace it. The platform is designed to help users organize their ideas in a visually compelling and intuitive way while leveraging AI's insights to improve the process of idea generation. Albus is suitable for anyone looking to explore and organize information and turn it into actionable insights.

name: Divi AI
description: Divi AI is an artificial intelligence tool designed to facilitate the creation of WordPress websites through the Divi builder. Integrated into Divi, this tool offers the functionality to generate written content, code, and images inside the builder. Because it has knowledge of each Divi element, Divi AI can provide contextually relevant content tailored to a website's specifics. Divi AI is able to generate new content, provide recommendations for next additions based on existing content and website details, and can automatically generate images that are relevant to the page and its context. Divi AI also provides the ability to customize existing images as needed, offering the flexibility to retain or alter composition and style aspects. One of the key features of Divi AI is its capacity to write code, generate custom CSS, and modify the website's design within the Visual Builder. This tool is trained on the Divi codebase, granting it an advantage over other language models. As it learns from the website's name, description, and the content of the current page, Divi AI consistently delivers relevant content. With unlimited text, code, and image requests, Divi AI empowers its users to work without interruptions while accelerating the website creation process.

name: Steno.com
description: Steno is an innovative tool that utilizes artificial intelligence to convert spoken words into text, thus facilitating expeditious typing. The application automatically transcribes voice into text without the need for activation. To enhance accuracy, Steno employs ChatGPT technology which negates the need for monotonous re-writes. The tool is capable of managing fast speech patterns in real-time, ensuring no words get missed, thereby transforming verbal communication into a seamless writing experience. It integrates smoothly with other applications, assuring uninterrupted operation across different platforms. Steno therefore effectively increases productivity by considerably reducing the time taken to type, enabling users to generate textual content far more rapidly than through traditional typing. Additionally, it offers a typing-free method for sending messages by merely speaking. Steno has both a free and premium version. The free version allows 20 messages without watermarks but subsequent text will get a watermark. The premium version offers text without watermarks. The software is available predominantly on Macbooks with Apple Silicon M-Chip with plans for future availability across all computing platforms. Despite its advanced AI capabilities, Steno maintains high standards of user privacy and safety.

name: Surmount
description: Surmount AI is a trading software that enables users to trade smarter and manage their investments using data-driven strategies. With Surmount AI, users can easily connect all of their investment accounts, including equities, crypto, and forex, in one place for convenient viewing, management, and automation. The platform allows users to automate their investments by finding and evaluating pre-built investment strategies with genuine track records. Users can access historical data for performance, holdings, and risk level, and seamlessly deploy strategies into their existing accounts with just a few clicks.Additionally, Surmount AI empowers users to turn their investment ideas into potential profit by building genuine automated investing strategies. The platform provides options for both no-code strategies and AI-generated text-to-code strategies, along with a web-based Python IDE for ease of use.Surmount AI aims to democratize access to passive trading by making it available to individuals and institutions alike. By offering a marketplace for users to create and share trading strategies, Surmount AI allows users to contribute to and benefit from a community-driven approach to investing.The platform has garnered praise from industry experts, including former quants and executives, who have commended Surmount AI for its ability to bring the power of hedge funds and family offices to everyday investors, introduce retail trading strategies using AI technology, and provide a transparent and customizable trading experience.Overall, Surmount AI provides modern-day investors with robust tools and resources to make informed investment decisions and optimize their trading strategies.

name: Truffle
description: Truffle is an AI-powered Slack app designed to automate the process of answering questions and building a knowledge base from Slack conversations. Aimed at teams struggling to find answers to recurring questions, Truffle utilizes AI technology to generate documentation from past conversations, making it easily accessible for the entire team. With Truffle, team members can ask questions and receive immediate answers, eliminating the need for time-consuming search and copy/paste routines. One of Truffle's key features is the automatic summarization and searchability of important conversations, ensuring that valuable information is readily available whenever needed. The tool also offers a free trial for teams interested in exploring its capabilities further. Truffle integrates smoothly into Slack, allowing users to add it to their workspace effortlessly. By leveraging AI and team conversations, Truffle aims to streamline the process of knowledge sharing and improve efficiency within organizations. It's important to note that Truffle is available in a subscription-based pricing model, starting at $50 per month. However, for specific pricing details and to accommodate different team needs, users are encouraged to reach out for a personalized discussion. Overall, Truffle offers a solution for teams seeking to reduce time spent on repetitive questions and enhance knowledge sharing within Slack, thanks to its intelligent automation capabilities.

name: Speechson
description: Text to Sound is an online tool that converts text into natural, human-like speech. With this tool, users can simply input text and quickly generate high-quality audio files in MP3 and WAV formats. The tool boasts an extensive collection of over 900 AI voices, representing 144+ languages. The user interface is straightforward, allowing users to easily navigate through the various features and options. Upon accessing the tool, users can choose from a wide range of languages, including popular languages such as English, Spanish, Chinese, and Arabic, as well as less common languages like Estonian, Swahili, and Welsh. The generated audio is designed to sound remarkably realistic, mimicking human speech patterns and intonations. This feature enhances the overall user experience and makes the output more suitable for various applications, such as voiceovers, virtual assistants, audiobooks, and language learning tools. In addition to its text-to-speech capabilities, Text to Sound also provides several other sections, including pricing information, a comprehensive voice library, and a frequently asked questions section. The tool offers a free trial feature, enabling users to explore its functionality before committing to a subscription or payment plans. Overall, Text to Sound is a powerful and versatile tool that empowers users to transform written content into high-quality audio output, incorporating a vast array of languages and delivering natural, human-like speech.

name: AutoApply
description: AutoApply is an AI-driven tool designed to streamline the job search process for job seekers. The platform uses advanced AI technology to automate job applications, customize CVs, and create personalized cover letters, aiming to save users significant time and energy during the job-hunting process. AutoApply uses a feature called JOB GPT, which automates job applications by using the user's personal data to target applications most suited for the job seeker. The tool also includes an AI-powered cover letter generator that crafts individualized letters for each application based on the job description provided.An additional feature of AutoApply is its AI CV Builder which allows users to create uniquely tailored CVs quickly for each application. This includes leveraging AI technology to refine, add skills, and enhance the job responsibilities section. This feature aims to highlight users' best qualities, making the resume stand out to potential employers.Aside from these core capabilities, AutoApply also offers job search management tools. These include the Dashboard, where users can easily track every application they have submitted. The tool allows users to define their job preferences like desired salary, locations, and job rights to fine-tune their job search. Furthermore, there are plans to include interview preparation and career coaching services. Lastly, a user can maximize their job hunting potential by subscribing to the Professional Package. It allows a user to define multiple job roles simultaneously, thus opening wider opportunities in the job market. All of these functions make the job search process faster, more efficient, and more tailored to the individual's career goals.

name: Copula AI
description: Copula AI is a platform designed to create AI-powered Q&A websites, harnessing articulated language model (LLM) technology. The service enables users to create a ChatGPT-style interface, where the AI can answer questions using provided documents as its knowledge base. It requires the user to provide these reference texts, usually stored in a Google Drive folder, which the AI then uses as the source of information for answering queries. This AI is engineered to cite the source from which it derived its response, to ensure accountability in the system. Copula AI also provides a free version of this service, where users can execute Q&A on a single chosen document or webpage. With this version, users also receive a shareable link and a bookmarklet, meant for quick submission of the current webpage to the AI, for subsequent Q&A. Feedback is provided in the form of the sections utilized in the document to generate responses. Copula AI caters to a wide range of sectors, with user-generated websites covering areas such as law, healthcare, religion, and gender studies.
features: ✅ Allows Google Drive integration for reference texts
✅ Enables feedback through sections used for response
✅ Offers services for single document/webpage Q&A

name: Hey Octopus
description: HeyOctopus is an AI-powered tool that specializes in learning path creation. It allows users to generate paper-based learning paths that facilitate quick entry into new fields of science. Additionally, users can share their learning journeys with others. The tool provides a feed feature that curates and presents relevant content for users to explore. Users can also share the content they find useful with others. One of the key features of HeyOctopus is its ability to generate learning paths based on user preferences and specific areas of interest. These paths are designed to guide users through the necessary learning materials and resources for gaining knowledge in new fields. Users can add content they come across to a path or mark it as completed, which helps improve the tool's recommendations. They can also bookmark content for later reference and mark it as helpful. Overall, HeyOctopus is a comprehensive tool that leverages AI to simplify the process of learning and acquiring knowledge in various scientific fields. It offers an efficient way for users to create, customize, and share learning paths, ensuring a streamlined learning experience.
features: ✅ Quick entry into new scientific fields
✅ Facility to mark content as completed

name: Bizway
description: Bizway is an AI-powered business planning tool that helps users go from idea to fully-fledged business plan in just minutes. The app generates tailored roadmaps, tasks, and GPT-4-powered responses to users' business research questions, making it easy for them to build and execute their business plans. With Bizway, users can create custom roadmaps in seconds that break down their ideas, goals, and plans into manageable steps. They can also execute a wide range of tasks with one click, including competitor analysis, brainstorming, and financial forecasting. Bizway makes it easy to save and curate every brilliant idea, research item, insight, and plan in one place. Users can explore every branch of their plan and go down the rabbit hole, then save their insights to the relevant business section as they go. Bizway walks users step-by-step through key areas of business, including market analysis, legal admin, product development, content creation, marketing, and financial analysis. The tool is ideal for anyone who wants to start a new business but doesn't know where to begin. Whether users want to launch a podcast, virtual event planning consultancy, or any other business, Bizway can help them get their plan in order and start something today.

name: FireCut
description: FireCut is an AI video editing tool designed to enhance productivity and streamline the editing workflow. Compatible with Adobe Premiere Pro 2022+ on both Windows and MacOS, FireCut integrates seamlessly with the software to accelerate repetitive tasks involved in video editing.With FireCut, users can efficiently clean up footage by removing silences, saving hours of manual editing. The tool also automates the process of switching cameras based on content, making podcast editing effortless. Additionally, FireCut employs AI to detect chapters in videos, allowing users to generate intro slides and create a more professional and organized viewing experience.One of FireCut's standout features is its ability to create zoom cuts at optimal moments, adding depth and visual interest to videos. This automation saves time and ensures high-quality results.Users have spoken highly of FireCut, praising its speed and efficiency. It has been described as a gamechanger, making editing jobs easier and saving significant amounts of time. The tool has received appreciation for its accuracy in creating chapters and its overall performance.To get started with FireCut, users can take advantage of a 14-day free trial. However, it should be noted that Adobe Premiere Pro 2022+ is required to utilize the tool effectively.

name: ChatGuru
description: ChatGuru AI Chat Bot & Search is an app available on the App Store for iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, and Mac OS X 12.0 or later. The app allows users to engage in chat conversations with an artificial intelligence-powered chatbot. Users can download the app for free and enjoy the convenience of interacting with the chatbot on their preferred Apple device.The app includes several features such as the ability to read reviews, compare customer ratings, and view screenshots. These features help users make informed decisions before downloading and using the ChatGuru AI Chat Bot.The chatbot functionality of ChatGuru is designed to provide a conversational experience, allowing users to ask questions, seek information, and engage in dialogue. The AI-powered technology behind the chatbot enables it to understand and respond to user queries in a human-like manner.Overall, ChatGuru AI Chat Bot & Search aims to provide users with an interactive and intelligent chatbot experience. It offers a convenient platform for engaging in chat conversations and accessing information on a range of topics. Whether users are seeking assistance, looking for information, or simply enjoying a chat with an intelligent bot, ChatGuru AI Chat Bot & Search can be a valuable tool to have on their Apple devices.

name: Angles
description: Angles is an AI tool designed to enhance your reading experience by offering personalized book summaries tailored to your individual preferences. By setting your preferences through a brief input about yourself, interests, and preferences, Angles leverages artificial intelligence (AI) to curate book summaries specifically aligned with your character. The process is simple: after providing information about yourself, the AI system learns from your input to generate personalized book summaries. This customization ensures that the summaries are highly relevant to your unique profile, allowing for faster and more efficient learning and personal growth. Whether you're interested in trending topics, new books, career and success, psychology, learning, or communication, Angles aims to elevate your reading journey. The tool distinguishes itself by focusing on individualized content, avoiding generic summaries and providing users with insights that resonate with their distinct preferences. Upgrade your reading experience with Angles, where AI technology tailors book summaries to your character, offering a valuable resource for those seeking to learn faster and make the most out of their reading endeavors. Explore the world of personalized knowledge and growth with Angles in a straightforward and user-centric manner.

name: Futurefinder
description: FutureFinder AI is an AI-powered educational consultancy platform, aimed at assisting students in discovering optimal study abroad opportunities. Its main function is to combine machine learning elements with the expertise of real education advisors. The tool is designed to offer personalized recommendations for schools and courses based on the user inputs, needs and requirements. It generates artificial intelligence-driven insights into different academic fields which gives students comprehensive information about various opportunities they could exploit. Moreover, FutureFinder AI provides connections to experienced education consultants who can provide custom support tailored to individual's academic goals. The platform also aims to simplify the application process by providing an intuitive interface that guides users step-by-step, aiding them in striving towards academic excellence. Its ultimate goal is to help students unlock their academic potential and carve out a successful pathway for studying overseas. Key features of FutureFinder AI include personalization, advisor interactions, AI-driven recommendations, and a user-friendly interface.

name: Faith Forward
description: Faith Forward is a mobile app designed to provide personalized Christian devotionals for daily inspiration. The app offers a tailored approach to devotionals, allowing users to receive personalized devotions based on what is on their mind. In addition to devotionals, the app provides full Bible passages, in-depth verse analysis, and daily sermons to help users in their journey of spiritual growth. The app also includes features such as the ability to save favorite sermons, explore the Bible, and study Scripture. Faith Forward aims to provide a more personal connection with one's faith through a church inside a phone. User testimonials suggest a positive experience using the app, with users finding it easy to access specific information pertaining to their emotions in the moment. Faith Forward is available for download on the iOS app store. Overall, Faith Forward offers a unique and tailored approach to Christian devotionals, providing a comprehensive suite of features designed to inspire and uplift its users.

name: Research Goat
description: Research Goat is a generative AI-powered platform primarily designed for in-depth qualitative research. It enables users to transform their unanswered questions into a deep understanding, focusing on aiding them to understand their customer base better. It operates at high speeds, completing field research within minutes and yielding results in a matter of hours. The platforms primary functionality revolves around the AI moderators that facilitate multilingual conversations across various geographies. These AI moderators conduct interviews based on the questions and participant types defined by the users, making the process more efficient and comprehensive without the need for human interference during the interviews. The AI-powered platform not only simplifies the research process but also reduces the cost significantly compared to traditional consumer research. Moreover, Research Goat's Gen-AI conducts dynamic, revelatory interviews with human research participants providing deeper insights and comprehensive analysis.Research Goat is flexible, catering to all types of teams, and provides a trial for users interested in exploring its capabilities. Users can also stay updated with Research Goat's insights and news. Its website presents additional details about the platform, plans, contact information, and free scheduling for a demonstration.

name: TLDWAI
description: TL;DW AI, also known as Too Long; Didn't Watch AI, is an AI tool that helps users summarize any video into concise and easily digestible content. It aims to free users from information overload by providing them with the key points and highlights of a video without having to watch the entire content. The tool allows users to summarize videos either by uploading the video file directly or by entering the video URL. It supports various languages, including English, and provides the option to generate summaries in multiple languages. TL;DW AI is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, with a simple interface that allows users to input their video of choice and obtain a summary in return. The tool has a limit on the number of video conversions per hour, but offers a pro version with additional benefits such as no summary limit, unrestricted functions, and the ability to request additional conversion tools. The website also includes sections for exploring summaries made by the tool, pricing information, and an API for developers. It is worth noting that TL;DW AI is developed using Django, a popular web framework. The website provides links to the privacy policy, terms of service, and a contact page for any inquiries.
features: ✅ Pro version supports additional conversion tools

name: Competely
description: Unlock powerful insights with Competely, your AI-powered competitive analysis partner Are you tired of wasting days on competitive analysis, only to find out you missed crucial insights? We've been there, too. Competitive analysis is often seen as a tedious and time-consuming chore, but skipping it can lead to costly mistakes. Meet Competely, your AI ally to help you magically generate a competitive analysis with ease and within minutes! Here’s how it works: Choose a base product - Just type in a URL. Alternatively, you can describe the product in a few sentences Choose competitors - You can choose competitors from our AI suggestions, or add competitors manually Analysis is generated - Within minutes, our AI will generate a competitive analysis that you can browse, share, or download. With Competely, you'll enjoy and have access to: → A comprehensive analysis of your competitors, including strengths and weaknesses → Insights into market positioning and customer sentiment → Pricing strategies and audience targeting → In-depth SWOT analysis for strategic planning → Real-time intelligence on your industry landscape Competitive analysis doesn't have to be a time-consuming and soul-sucking chore. Competely is here to simplify the process and save you precious hours. Say goodbye to days of manual research and get a full competitive analysis in minutes. Try it out and stay ahead of the competition, price starts at only $9/mo!

name: iMocha
description: iMocha is an AI-driven platform designed to streamline skill assessments and talent management processes. Its range of solutions is intended to augment workforce productivity, underpinning a data-driven, skills-first approach. The platform provides a wealth of utilities, including Skills Intelligence Cloud, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Campus Hiring tools. With what is claimed to be the world's largest skills assessment library, the platform offers a holistic view of an organization's skills inventory and allows for skill-gap analysis and skills matching in order to anticipate future requirements and address skill gaps. iMocha also provides resources for recruitment and career development, boasting features designed to support remote hiring, diversity hiring, campus hiring, and workforce agility. The software is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing HR systems, offering comprehensive, data-driven talent decisions for a strategic approach to talent acquisition and management. Additionally, iMocha delivers skills benchmarking tools to gain actionable insights into workforce proficiency, enabling recruiters and HR professionals to make informed talent decisions.
features: ✅ Resources for diversity and remote hiring
✅ Seamless integration with existing HR systems
✅ Skills benchmarking tools for actionable insights

name: categorAIze
description: CategorAIze.io is an AI-driven system that enables the organization of texts, URLs, images, and documents into categories based on their content. The tool employs advanced AI technology that understands and classifies information, making it easier to manage and access. Users can designate fixed categories or opt for automatic generation of new ones as data are added. The interaction with this AI system can be through a Graphical User Interface (GUI), an API for integration into other systems, or import/export of data via CSV files. CategorAIze.io incorporates functionalities such as custom category definition, automatic category generation and multi-level hierarchical categorization. The tool works on a pay-as-you-go model, with a fee charged for item storage and credits used for AI categorization events. Besides the cloud solution, tailored deployment options are available, including on-premises and dedicated cloud servers. Users can also benefit from dedicated AI models for specific needs, backed by a comprehensive Service Level Agreement (SLA) for guaranteed uptime and service quality. CategorAIze.io also offers an option for custom prompts to enhance user experiences.

name: Moonhub
description: Moonhub is an AI-powered recruiter that offers sourcing and recruiting services for startups and growing businesses. It serves as a recruiting partner, providing human-centric AI solutions to optimize the hiring process. With Moonhub, users can analyze market data and design effective strategies to maximize the quality and speed of their hires. One of the key features of Moonhub is its conversational AI that allows users to iterate in real-time on their search using natural language, eliminating the need for complex booleans or filters. This AI-powered tool is designed to empower teams by providing them with the knowledge and insights of the best recruiters in the world.Moonhub also offers the option to work with Moonhub Experts, who utilize the latest AI technology to assist with sourcing, screening, and managing the hiring process. This can be particularly useful for users who are pressed for time and need additional support.Furthermore, Moonhub's pricing structure is based on a low success fee, meaning users only pay when they successfully make a hire, thus ensuring cost efficiency. In summary, Moonhub is a purpose-built, human-centric AI tool that streamlines the hiring process for growing teams. It eliminates guesswork, saves time, and offers expert assistance through its AI-powered features and the option to work with Moonhub Experts.

name: AI Emoji Generator
description: AI Emoji Generator is a tool that leverages the prowess of Stable Diffusion AI to transform text inputs into unique emojis. This innovative resource, which is freely accessible, facilitates rapid creation of original emojis from any written content. The tool is a congruous fusion of technology and creativity, offering a streamlined process for producing distinct emojis with a single click. AI Emoji Generator can greatly enhance digital communication by providing artistic and personalized elements. In addition, this tool offers an exciting avenue for exploring the art of emojis and augmenting creative expression. The AI Emoji Generator is also designed with an easy-to-use interface, ensuring a pleasant and user-friendly experience. It makes high-quality emojis in a short span of time by just inputting a text prompt and clicking 'Generate'. This tool is GPU-enabled and focused on prompt generation, ideal for swiftly processing a brief sentence through the model and receiving quick results. Additionally, the AI Emoji Generator comes with an impressive database, allowing for the exploration of numerous AI-generated emojis.

name: Trypromptly
description: Promptly is an AI tool primarily designed for building and customizing AI applications and chatbots without the need for coding. It encompasses a digital store known as the Promptly AI App Store where users can explore a diverse selection of AI agents and applications. This platform elevates AI usage by enabling users, regardless of their technical expertise, to create AI-based solutions themselves, thus bypassing traditional coding obstacles. Additionally, Promptly supports saving and sharing of the created AI apps and chatbots, fostering collaboration and ease of use. The platform runs on JavaScript, thus requiring its enablement for full functioning. While it offers an array of pre-existing AI agents, a significant part of Promptly's approach lies in its user-friendly interface that is tailored to accommodate the creation of personalized applications to meet individual or business-specific requirements.

name: Xploro
description: Xploro AI Travel Audio Guide is an innovative travel companion aimed at enriching the exploration experience for both seasoned travelers and local enthusiasts. The app leverages advanced geolocation technology to accurately identify the user's location, providing curated information about nearby tourist attractions, hidden gems, and historical sites. A distinctive feature of Xploro AI is its AI-powered audio guide, which immerses users in the history and culture of their chosen destination. Acting as a storyteller, the app delivers engaging narratives and interesting facts, enhancing the significance of every moment during exploration. For those inclined towards reading, Xploro AI offers a complementary text guide, providing in-depth details, historical context, and practical information about visited places. The app ensures a multifaceted approach to content delivery, catering to diverse user preferences.

name: Parsio
description: Parsio is an AI-powered tool designed to facilitate structured data extraction from various document types including emails, PDFs, business cards, and ID documents. It uses OCR technology to parse invoices, receipts, and other transactional documents. Primarily used for eliminating manual data entry, it automates the extraction process to export data into platforms like Google Sheets, databases, CRMs, webhooks and numerous other applications. One of its key features is Airparser, a GPT-powered parser that transforms unstructured, human-written documents into structured data. Parsio also includes built-in templates to parse emails from platforms like Airbnb, LinkedIn, et al. Beyond parsing, Parsio also offers integrations with various online tools and applications, enabling users to export extracted data directly to these platforms. It is usable across industries, including real estate and automotive, and is utilized for diverse use cases such as lead capturing and table extraction. Moreover, Parsio supports multiple languages and provides an option for custom data formatting.

name: Fantoons
description: Fantoons is an artificial intelligence-enabled tool designed to facilitate the creation of fan comics, catering specifically to Harry Potter and BTS fan communities. The tool aims to assist people in generating fan comics, even when they don't possess art skills. It serves as a solution for users looking to craft their unique stories into visual content centered around these specific fandoms. The application employs AI technology to help render ideas into comic form, allowing for individual creativity with less emphasis on the technical aspects of comic design. To make the full use of its features, users are reminded that JavaScript must be enabled. Please note that while a major attraction is its AI-driven functionalities, user imagination and storytelling remain integral components for a successful output.
features: ✅ Caters to Harry Potter and BTS fandom

name: EasySplitter
description: EasySplitter is an artificial intelligence-based tool designed to split and remove vocals from songs, offering separate versions for vocals, instrumentals, bass, and drums. Developed as a platform to assist various individuals in the music industry, EasySplitter finds relevance among DJs, singers, music producers, composers, music arrangers, and music enthusiasts who focus on mixing and mastering music. Primarily, DJs can use this tool as an instrumental maker, while singers can use it to refine their vocal skills by singing to the instrumental version of songs. It also serves as a learning tool for music educators and students, as well as a karaoke maker for developers, enabling them to remove vocals from songs and add lyrics. The EasySplitter mobile application synchronises with the web version, allowing users to process and split songs on either platform seamlessly. Moreover, it provides fast processing speed and a user-friendly interface for efficient song separation. This tool is available for free download on both iOS and Android platforms.
features: ✅ Free download on iOS and Android
✅ Aids in music mixing and mastering

name: MindStudio
description: MindStudio by YouAi is a powerful AI tool that allows users to create personalized and context-aware AI applications in a matter of minutes, without the need for coding. This tool enables users to easily generate monthly revenue by charging people for using their AI applications through a monthly subscription model. Users have control over the pricing, and once users exhaust their free trial of the AI application, they will be prompted to pay to continue using it.With MindStudio, users can access a variety of AI functionalities such as content generators, utilities, enterprise apps, agents, characters, bots, and more. name: CodeMate
description: CodeMate is positioned as an AI Pair Programmer designed to solve coding problems primarily by streamlining the coding process, enhancing productivity, and minimizing human errors. Also, it ensures the privacy and security of your code with industry-standard encryption and security protocols. name: Sparksocial
description: Sparksocial is an AI-powered tool designed to enhance social listening and lead generation. The software provides the ability to monitor keywords across various social media platforms with a view to convert leads through AI-generated auto-replies. Among its key features are real-time tracking, advanced sentiment analysis, and comprehensive reporting, all aimed at understanding and harnessing online chatter. Sparksocial tool also offers a service of audience discovery which helps in identifying your brand's ambassadors and prospective customers. The AI capabilities of the tool enable automatic crafting of personalized responses to online engagements, saving users substantial time. Other significant functions of Sparksocial include: conducting competitive analysis which aids in understanding consumer views on competitors and identifying industry gaps, executing mass cold outreach with personalized messages to widen your network and engagement, tracking social mentions for your brand, and providing access to insightful analytic reports. As a lead generation tool, it enables discovery and connection with potential leads through auto-engagement and targeted cold outreach tools. With a focus on aiding brand building, it uses the power of social listening to generate insights, engage audiences and aid in the precision and creativity of marketing strategies.

name: Slack GPT
description: Slack GPT is an AI tool that is built natively in Slack to bring the power of generative AI into the platform. It aims to help individuals and organizations work smarter, learn faster, and communicate better. Slack GPT provides an AI-ready platform that allows users to integrate and automate their language model of choice, including partner-built apps like OpenAI's ChatGPT or Anthropic's Claude, or custom-built integrations. It also includes AI features built directly in Slack, such as AI-powered conversation summaries and writing assistance. Additionally, Slack GPT features a new Einstein GPT app that allows users to surface AI-powered customer insights from trusted Salesforce Customer 360 data and Data Cloud. Slack GPT is built on a foundation of trust, ensuring that users know what data is being used and that the outputs are relevant to their business. With the newly available next-generation platform for developers, it is also easy to build custom integrations with a range of AI models. Slack GPT allows for flexibility in how users choose to integrate AI into their workflows, whether through clicks, code, or a combination of both. The tool promises to redefine how work is done and to enable AI to act on valuable data from a company's most trusted resource- its own internal knowledge.

name: GoWhisper
description: GoWhisper is a cross-platform desktop application that helps users transcribe audio files in a seamless and secure manner. It prioritizes user privacy by allowing transcription to be done locally on the user's machine, eliminating the need for cloud-based services and monthly fees.The tool offers advanced features such as support for up to 99 languages, intuitive editing capabilities, and versatile export options including SRT, TXT, VTT, and CSV formats. This allows users to easily customize the output according to their needs.GoWhisper is ideal for various professionals and content creators. Researchers can transcribe interviews and audio recordings for analysis and study, while podcasters can transcribe their episodes to create blog posts or captions for their audience. Content creators can transcribe video content for accessibility or SEO purposes, and journalists can transcribe interviews or press briefings for accurate reporting. Additionally, small business owners can transcribe meetings or webinars for reference and documentation, while legal professionals can transcribe depositions, court hearings, or other legal proceedings.With a one-time payment model, users can enjoy unlimited transcription without the need for ongoing subscriptions. The tool has received positive feedback from users, highlighting its offline functionality, privacy and security, and seamless audio-to-text conversion.GoWhisper offers a free version with unlimited transcription and basic features, as well as a pro version with additional AI models, advanced functionalities like find and replace, API transcription integration, and priority support.

name: Moonvalley
description: Moonvalley is a groundbreaking AI tool that uses machine learning to generate visually stunning and high-definition videos and animations from simple text prompts. With seamless account creation and uninterrupted access, users can easily create cinematic and animated videos with Moonvalley. The tool allows users to control the motion of intricate objects in scenes using trajectory arrows and text guidance, providing a high level of customization. Moonvalley supports any style or medium, ranging from photorealistic to cartoons, making it versatile for various creative projects. Additionally, Moonvalley offers the ability to upload custom images and transform them into rich and high-definition animated videos. The tool is designed to enhance productivity with its easy-to-use visual editor, built-in CMS, and authentication features, making web project creation more efficient. Furthermore, Moonvalley provides forecasting analysis and analytics for proactive decision-making and offers different pricing plans to meet the evolving needs of businesses. The tool also showcases a gallery of trending videos created by its community of creators, allowing users to find inspiration and see the capabilities of Moonvalley. It has gained recognition and support by being backed by Y-Combinator and Khosla Ventures. With its mission to turn words into worlds, Moonvalley aims to empower users with smarter marketing strategies and offers helpful resources such as a help center for customer support.

name: GPT for work
description: ChatGPT is an AI tool that can be used in Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Excel to perform various tasks. It works with several OpenAI language models, including GPT-3.5, GPT-3.5-16K, GPT-4, Claude 1, and Claude 2.With ChatGPT, users can clean and normalize data, extract entities, and standardize formats in bulk operations within Sheets and Excel. It also offers the ability to analyze data by summarizing, classifying, and categorizing information.The tool is particularly useful for generating content. It can write and edit copy, translate text, and create product tags, ad copy, taglines, titles, and high-quality, compelling product descriptions. It can even help generate outlines for blog posts, emails, speeches, and provide summaries of meetings or notes.ChatGPT's functionality is integrated directly into Google Sheets and Google Docs, making it convenient for users to access its features. The tool has garnered popularity with over three million installations and carries a rating of 4.5/5.It is important to note that ChatGPT is built on top of the GPT-3.5-turbo and GPT-4 models, specifically trained for conversational use. The GPT-3.5 models have been made available via API and offer a cost-effective solution compared to previous models. Additionally, the latest GPT-4 model provides better reasoning capabilities and an increased word context limit.Overall, ChatGPT provides users with a powerful AI toolset for performing various text-based operations and generating high-quality content within the Google Sheets, Docs, and Excel environments.

name: Diffusion Logo Studio
description: Diffusion Logo Studio is a tool that allows small businesses and solopreneurs to generate unique and professional logos quickly and affordably. This AI-powered logo generator aims to help users create a memorable brand identity by offering a range of customization options.The logo creation process begins by sharing information about the company or project, including its name, industry, and vision. Users can also provide adjectives and a brief description to further define their brand. Diffusion Logo Studio then utilizes advanced AI models to craft exclusive logos from scratch, avoiding the use of pre-made symbols or templates. Each logo is meticulously designed to suit the unique identity of the brand.With an intuitive UI, users can effortlessly personalize their selected logo by removing elements, adjusting shapes, and fine-tuning details. The tool also allows for easy transformation of the logo into vector format, ensuring clarity at any size. Colors can be tweaked to harmonize with the brand's style.Diffusion Logo Studio offers the ability to add the company or project name, as well as a slogan, to the logo, seamlessly integrating the text with the design. The tool also provides a preview feature, allowing users to visualize their logo in real-world scenarios such as shop storefronts, business cards, and packages.Overall, Diffusion Logo Studio aims to empower users to create a logo that truly reflects their vision and sets their brand apart. It is praised by customers for its affordability, customization options, and unique and standout logo designs.

name: Draw My UI
description: The "draw my ui" tool offered by tldraw enables users to create user interface (UI) designs through drawing. Accessed via the tldraw website, the tool allows users to visually sketch UI elements, providing a straightforward and intuitive way to convey UI ideas. This tool prioritizes simplicity and visual representation over complex design tools or coding. By leveraging the drawing capabilities, users can quickly and easily visualize their desired UI layouts and components.The tool's emphasis on real-time productivity empowers users to generate UI designs efficiently and effectively. With a focus on the creative process, this tool enables users to develop UI prototypes with greater speed and fluidity.Through its accessible interface, draw my ui caters to both beginners and professionals in UI design. The absence of technical jargon and complex tools makes it user-friendly for individuals with minimal design experience, helping them create functional and visually appealing UI designs.Moreover, the tldraw platform ensures seamless collaboration by allowing users to share their designs with team members or clients, fostering constructive feedback and enabling efficient workflows. By facilitating discussion and iteration on UI designs, this tool promotes effective teamwork and enhances the overall design process.In summary, the draw my ui tool by tldraw provides a straightforward and accessible platform for users to create UI designs through visual sketching. Its focus on real-time productivity, user-friendly interface, and collaborative features contribute to a more efficient and effective UI design process.

name: Memable
description: Memable is an AI native bookmark and recall engine that aims to enhance your memory and prevent you from forgetting important information. With Memable, users can create a personal AI-powered second brain, which serves as a digital repository for storing and retrieving valuable insights, ideas, and references. By leveraging artificial intelligence technology, Memable assists users in effortlessly organizing and remembering vast amounts of information. The tool provides a convenient platform for capturing and categorizing essential data, enabling users to quickly find and recall specific details whenever needed. Memable's interface is user-friendly and intuitive, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience for users. With its AI capabilities, the tool is designed to adapt to individual preferences and behavior patterns, further enhancing its efficiency over time. Privacy is prioritized, as the tool maintains a comprehensive privacy policy to ensure the confidentiality and security of user data. Additionally, Memable offers a sign-in feature for existing members, allowing for personalized access and convenient retrieval of saved information. Overall, Memable is a valuable tool for individuals seeking to improve their memory and knowledge retention. It manages to combine the power of AI with user-friendly features, enabling users to conveniently store and retrieve information critical to their work, studies, or personal life.

name: ToneShift
description: ToneShift is a versatile AI tool that offers voice cloning, music separation, and a collaborative community platform. The Voice Conversion feature allows users to transform recordings into adaptable voices suitable for applications like voiceovers, podcasts, and video games. With Music Separation, users can extract vocals and instrumentals from existing songs, facilitating the creation of personalized remixes and mashups. The Voice Cloning feature sets ToneShift apart, enabling users to replicate any voice and craft distinctive characters and narratives. This functionality adds a creative dimension to content creation by offering a unique voice customization tool. ToneShift encourages collaboration through its community platform, where users can explore diverse voices, contribute their creations, and engage in collaborative projects with fellow users. With an emphasis on user creativity, ToneShift provides a Mixer tool that facilitates voice conversion and music separation. Users can easily experiment with different tones, fostering a dynamic and interactive environment for content creators. ToneShift's user-friendly interface and innovative features make it a valuable resource for individuals seeking AI-powered solutions for voice-related projects and music customization.

name: Encord
description: Encord Active is a tool for machine learning and computer vision developers. It primarily focuses on model evaluation, data curation and active learning. This tool allows users to effectively test, validate, and fine-tune AI models against their data sets to significantly enhance model performance. With Encord Active, the users are able to run robustness checks on their AI models before deploying them into production. It provides advanced analytics, allowing users to spot and fix model weak spots, thus maintaining accurate and adaptable models even as data landscapes change. Furthermore, they can uncover model failure modes, export explainability reports, and quickly rectify issues, thus surpassing their AI benchmarks. The tool is also engineered for data and label validation, assisting developers to safeguard the quality of their training data. Encord Active's advanced label validation features boost the accuracy and reliability of the training data. It supports creation of balanced, comprehensive datasets tailored to the model's needs and automatically detects label errors through AI-assisted quality metrics. The system also allows developers to inspect model predictions, surface common issues, and efficiently communicate errors back to the labeling team. As a result, Encord Active helps facilitate quicker and more efficient deployment of high-quality AI applications in production.

name: Zapt
description: ZAPT is an AI tool designed to simplify the creation and discovery of ChatGPT apps. With ZAPT, users can effortlessly build their own ChatGPT apps and conveniently access a variety of apps shared by other creators. Each app created through ZAPT is a standalone Progressive Web App (PWA) which can be installed directly on the user's home screen for instant access, eliminating the need to go through the ZAPT platform repeatedly.One of the standout features of ZAPT is its monetization capability. App creators can generate income by charging a monthly subscription fee to their app users, allowing them to monetize the apps they build.ZAPT has received positive feedback from users, with testimonials highlighting its usefulness for both businesses and consumers. Business owners appreciate the ease of finding and utilizing ChatGPT apps for their businesses, while everyday users find AI-powered chatbots on the ChatGPT AppStore helpful in making their daily lives more convenient and enjoyable.ZAPT is a user-friendly tool that aims to streamline the process of developing and accessing AI-powered chat interfaces. By providing an easy-to-use platform, a wide range of available apps, and the ability to monetize one's creations, ZAPT offers users the opportunity to leverage the power of AI and enhance their experiences.

name: FreeWilly2
description: FreeWilly2 is an open-source AI model developed by Stability AI and fine-tuned with the Llama2 70B dataset. It is a language model that uses auto-regressive techniques to generate text. The model is trained using supervised fine-tuning on an internal Orca-style dataset.Users can interact with FreeWilly2 by starting a conversation using a specific prompt format, which includes a system prompt, a user prompt, and an assistant response. The model can generate responses based on the given prompts.FreeWilly2 is implemented using the HuggingFace Transformers library and is available under the Non-Commercial Creative Commons license (CC BY-NC-4.0). It is intended for research purposes only.However, it's important to note that while the Llama2 dataset helps mitigate biases and toxicity in the generated text, not all biases can be eliminated through fine-tuning. Users should be aware of potential issues and not treat the model outputs as a substitute for human judgment or a source of truth. Responsible usage is strongly encouraged.For further information or inquiries about the model, users can contact Stability AI via email at [email protected] . Citations for the Llama2 dataset and the Orca-style training methodology are provided for academic references.

Included in the tools are AI chatbots trained with industry and conversion experts' knowledge, ready to answer questions and provide needed information. Users also have the ability to train their own AI assistant. The AI Code Generator allows users to generate complex algorithms by simply explaining their intent in natural language. UberCreate supports multiple programming languages, including Python, Flutter, PHP, Javascript, and Ruby. The AI Image Generator can produce artworks and images using models such as DALL-E and Stable Diffusion. Other tools, such as AI Vision, give a detailed analysis of images by recognizing objects, landmarks, and people, and categorizing the content with remarkable accuracy. UberCreate also has tools that can analyze web pages, PDF, and CSV files to provide summaries or extract specific information. In addition, it can also convert images into realistic and high-quality videos. In summary, UberCreate is a versatile tool that designs, analyzes, and simplifies various forms of content creation.

Additionally, ClipBuddy's AI identifies key moments and adds dynamic, viewer-catching captions to enhance engagement. The tool also auto-adjusts videos to the ideal 9:16 ratio, guaranteeing a perfect fit across all devices. It also emphasizes the protection of user content, ensuring that videos are not shared, sold, or distributed to any third parties. ClipBuddy is developed in Denmark.

It utilizes the advanced GPT-3.5 model, focusing on the creation of clear, on-target emails in a short period without straining the user's mental capacity. With Hiwriter, users can quickly draft appropriate emails and responses, taking into account specific details that help to make the email contextually appropriate and concise.The tool provides several noteworthy features, starting with automatic email generation using OpenAI's GPT-3.5. It enables personalization of emails based on input details about the sender, the recipient and the subject of discussion. Further, it offers an email reply generator that uses the ongoing email thread's context to craft appropriate responses.Moreover, it equips users with a style and tone selector to create emails that emulate the user's unique writing style. name: Cardamore
description: Cardamore.ai is a high-performance e-commerce store developed with Next.js, Vercel, and Shopify. It uses advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technology to instantly generate hyper-personalized greeting cards. The platform draws from a variety of passions and occasions to create unique, customizable cards. name: Raizer
description: Raizer is an AI-powered platform dedicated to connecting startup founders and investors. It enhances the funding process by providing startup founders with a tool to raise capital effectively, while granting investors access to select startup deals. Users have the ability to set up a verified startup page for showcasing their business to over 70,000 investors. There are several subscription levels available such as Basic which gives access to all investors, a Pro-level providing AI email assistant service and increased limits, and an Ultimate-level where startups are featured and promoted in front of investors.

name: Chapterize
description: Chapterize.ai is an AI-powered tool designed to help users keep up with the influx of information by summarizing various types of content such as books, videos, papers, and articles. By leveraging AI technology, Chapterize.ai condenses lengthy content into bite-sized summaries, extracting the core essence and eliminating unnecessary fluff. name: Humanlike
