It is accessible across different platforms, including web, Android, and iOS. Notably, Axsar PDF also features an AI-driven chat attribute that allows for deeper interaction with the contents of the PDFs. The tool also supports subscription sharing with team members for collaborative PDF work, contributing further to improved productivity and efficiency.

name: Katonic
description: The Katonic Generative AI Platform is a no-code tool that enables users to build, train, and deploy custom AI applications and chatbots without the need for coding. The platform offers a selection of 75 large language models (LLMs) to choose from, allowing users to leverage the power of Generative AI.With the Katonic Generative AI Platform, businesses can improve employee productivity, decision-making processes, and customer experience. The platform ensures enterprise-grade security, minimizing any risks to data.This tool offers a range of functionalities, including the ability to build AI-powered chatbots and digital assistants that can access and process information from various sources. The platform also allows users to identify and extract essential information from unstructured text and generate personalized executive summaries.Additionally, users can read and classify written input without the need for extensive examples, generate content for specific purposes with expert-level accuracy, and build content moderation systems.The Katonic Generative AI Platform also provides future capabilities that are currently under development, such as code assistance, semantic search, recommendation systems, and customizable models.The tool stands out for its choice of multiple LLMs, ensuring highly accurate results. It also offers enterprise-grade security, enabling it to be installed on-premises for enhanced data protection. The platform is scalable, allowing users to train and deploy even the most powerful LLMs.Overall, the Katonic Generative AI Platform empowers businesses to harness the potential of Generative AI without the need for coding expertise, while delivering accurate results and ensuring data security.

name: Testimonial Questions Generator
description: The Testimonial Questions Generator is a free tool offered by Famewall that helps businesses collect valuable testimonials from their customers. By generating a set of 10 carefully curated questions, this tool simplifies the process of gathering testimonials and case studies that can increase conversions and boost sales. All users need to do is enter their website's landing page URL and click on "Generate Questions". Within 1-2 minutes, they will receive a set of the best testimonial questions specific to their business.Testimonial Questions Generator streamlines the testimonial collection process by asking the right questions that make it easier for customers to provide meaningful feedback. This tool is designed to elicit detailed responses, allowing businesses to highlight the most important points and share them in their marketing materials for maximum effectiveness. By ensuring clarity in the question prompts, the Testimonial Questions Generator also increases the likelihood of receiving video testimonials.In addition to generating questions, Famewall offers personalized collection pages where businesses can gather testimonials from customers. These collection pages can be customized and shared with customers, who can then submit their testimonials through video or text formats. Famewall provides fully customizable testimonial widgets that allow businesses to showcase these collected testimonials on their websites, emails, and other platforms.Overall, the Testimonial Questions Generator and accompanying features offered by Famewall aim to simplify and improve the process of collecting and displaying testimonials, helping businesses leverage social proof to attract and convert more customers.

name: blubi.ai
description: Blubi.ai is an Artificial Intelligence-driven writing tool designed specifically for content creators. It operates by studying the user's style of writing on social media platforms, then recommends topics, and supplies ready-to-post content based on this analysis. Initially, the tool supports Twitter, but it has plan to expand to accommodate other platforms like LinkedIn and Medium. While primarily focused on text-based content, there are plans to include support for images and videos. Blubi.ai positions itself as a solution to writer's block and a facilitator for content creation, enabling creators to focus more on the craft of their content. It also acts as a permanent repository for users' social media content, giving them the option to remix and repurpose this content using its AI capabilities. Joining the tool's waitlist gives creators early access to the platform when launched.

name: TrueGradient
description: TrueGradient AI is an AI tool designed to unlock revenue growth by optimizing supply chain operations. The platform allows users to combine their business intuition with advanced AI capabilities in a self-serve manner. It offers several solutions tailored to specific business needs.One of the key features of TrueGradient AI is its demand forecasting capability. By analyzing historical data and relevant factors such as demographics and seasonality, the tool can predict future product demand accurately. This helps businesses plan their inventory levels and ensure that products are available when and where they are needed.Another solution provided by TrueGradient AI is pricing and promotions optimization. The tool enables businesses to determine the right price and promotional strategy for a given timeframe by predicting the net impact on sales. This can help maximize revenue while maintaining competitive pricing.Additionally, TrueGradient AI offers inventory optimization capabilities. By analyzing predicted demand, the tool helps businesses optimize inventory levels, ensuring that products are not overstocked or out of stock. This helps businesses meet customer demand efficiently while reducing costs associated with excess inventory.Lastly, the assortment optimization feature of TrueGradient AI allows businesses to optimize product assortments in stores based on various attributes, including product and store characteristics. It also takes into account the halo and cannibalization effects of products, ensuring an effective product mix that maximizes sales.Overall, TrueGradient AI provides businesses with valuable insights to enhance supply chain operations, optimize pricing and promotions, and improve inventory management, ultimately unlocking revenue growth opportunities.

name: Applicado
description: Applicado is an AI-powered platform designed to effectively prepare job-seekers for interviews. Its primary features include tailored mock interviews, which can be accessed and performed unlimitedly at any time. The platform aims to eliminate the need for scheduling meetings, hence offering convenience to its users. The questions presented during these mock interviews are specifically tailored according to the jobs users are applying for and their respective professional journey, providing a highly personalized preparation experience. Furthermore, Applicado offers real-time questions and answers and the ability to record responses, providing users with a realistic interview experience to build confidence. Immediate, comprehensive feedback is provided to enable continuous improvement. In addition, users have the option to review their recorded responses, analyze speaking styles through transcript reviews, and receive suggestions on response formulation. Applicado also provides actionable advice to help refine user's answers. The AI platform offers a practical solution for job-seekers to master essential interview skills, impress potential employers, and ultimately secure their dream job.

name: GreetsApp
description: GreetsApp is an AI-enabled platform designed to transform ordinary messages into personalized eCards, suitable for various occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and more. The tool stands out by offering users the ability to design and send their own eCards in less than a minute, producing customized heartwarming messages that embody the sender's unique flair. Unlike traditional eCards, GreetsApp leverages AI to aid in content creation, helping users overcome writer's block and enabling them to craft meaningful and heartfelt messages effortlessly. More than a quick and easy creation tool, GreetsApp also serves as a memory saver, keeping every sent eCard preserved, thereby preventing the loss of heartfelt messages that could occur with conventional eCards. At its heart, GreetsApp promotes more profound, meaningful, and authentic digital connections in a fast-paced digital world. It offers a breath of fresh air by allowing users to slow down, savor the moment, and make every message worth remembering. GreetsApp provides an opportunity for anyone to send personalized greetings, fostering deeper connections with their loved ones.
features: ✅ Can be delivered via text or email

name: GramBotPlus
description: GramBot+ is an AI-powered SaaS tool designed to help automate Instagram growth using Gary Vee's 1.80 and 502 strategies. Its main feature is the use of the ChatGPT model family, specifically the GPT-3.5 Turbo technology, which provides faster and more accurate personalized insights for user's Instagram accounts and goals. With GramBot+, users can automate both growth strategies, engage with their niche and followers, save time and focus on creating content. The platform enables users to extract top or recent posts by searching for specific hashtags or locations or posts on their explore page. Furthermore, it allows users to engage with their target audience daily through its automated Likes and comments feature, extract Instagram user account details from top, recent, and explore page posts, grow their Instagram audience on autopilot through automation of repetitive tasks such as liking, commenting, and following potential followers. GramBot+ also saves users' time and resources by automating the customer acquisition process and prospecting for new customers by extracting data from Instagram and doing outreach. It has a user-friendly interface, and users can export extracted data into CSV or Google Sheet.

name: Please Don't Code
description: Please Don't Code is an efficient and utility-rich tool developed to streamline the process of coding for embedded systems by offering an AI-powered code generator for Arduino. Targeted at users seeking easier coding and time conservation, this tool helps in hastening the process of code generation by leveraging the power of algorithms and machine learning. It is primarily effective for Arduino programmers who wish to simplify their coding tasks. An engaging feature of this tool is its ability to generate code configurations for varied Arduino boards such as Arduino Uno, Arduino Mega, and Arduino Nano, further enhancing its utility. Please Don't Code helps in setting up digital input and output pins for buttons and LED strips, reading and displaying sensor data like temperature, humidity, distance, water volume, and flow rate. It even allows the user to organize and control devices like relays and buzzers according to the sensor values, thereby providing a holistic development environment.

name: Outfindo
description: Outfindo is an AI-driven tool that enhances the shopping experience on a website by guiding and assisting customers in product selection. Unlike traditional filter-based systems, Outfindo implements an intuitive, conversation-like approach to understand the customer's needs and suggests products accordingly, significantly improving website engagement. The tool comprises two major features the Outfindo Product Guide and Outfindo Product Content. The former replicates the experience of a brick-and-mortar store by probing predefined customer-centric questions in a natural human-like conversation, whereas the latter standardizes product information, outlining key features with extended details to assist customers in their decision-making. Furthermore, it seamlessly integrates real-time data directly from the manufacturers. The tool maintains its relevance across various products, making it product agnostic. Outfindo also includes data analytics in its robust technology, scrutinizing digital footprints of customers to identify patterns and formulate optimized guidance paths for the buyer's journey. This eliminates the need for manual data management and ensures up-to-date, enhanced product descriptions.

name: LLaMa2 Perplexity
description: Perplexity Labs Playground pplx-api is developed by Perplexity Labs. It is an application programming interface that reacts interactively to user input, thus creating an immersive AI experience. It hosts a variety of AI models including 'llama' series (with variations like sonar-large, sonar-small, 8b-instruct, and 70b-instruct) and 'mixtral'. These AI models each have unique features and perform different tasks, likely addressing a wide range of user needs. Given the 'chat' and 'instruct' features mentioned in several models' names, it is plausible these models could be used to drive chatbot functionality or provide automated instructions to users. Regardless of the exact task, the Perplexity Labs Playground pplx-api seems primed to deliver advanced AI services in real-time and at scale. Although not explicitly stated, models like llama-3-sonar-large and llama-3-sonar-small might differ in capacity, possibly offering scalability options to cater for different levels of computational burden. The '32k-online' tagged on the end of some of the model names could be indicative of the model's complexity or size, thereby providing an insight into the capabilities of the AI.

name: AI to Human
description: The AI to Human Text Converter is a free online tool provided by AItoHuman.org that offers a revolutionary solution for converting AI-generated text into high-quality, human-written content. Through advanced AI technology, the tool is able to detect and analyze AI-generated text and transform it into human-readable content that is indistinguishable from text written by a human. This tool is particularly useful for converting technical jargon, scientific reports, or any other type of AI-generated text into clear, concise, and engaging content.The AI to Human Text Converter is designed to help users produce content that impresses their audience. Whether users need to convert AI-generated text for technical documentation, blog articles, or any other purpose, this tool can save time and effort by automating the process of converting AI-generated text into human-written content. By utilizing this tool, users can streamline their workflow and improve productivity.The AI to Human Text Converter is part of a collection of innovative and user-friendly AI tools offered by AItoHuman.org. These tools are powered by advanced artificial intelligence technology and are accessible to everyone for free. With intuitive interfaces and powerful capabilities, these AI tools are the ideal solution for anyone seeking to streamline their writing, editing, or research tasks.Overall, the AI to Human Text Converter is a valuable tool that effectively bridges the gap between AI-generated text and human-written content, enabling users to generate high-quality content that meets the needs of their audience.

name: Onvo
description: Onvo AI's Dashboard and Report Builder SDK is designed to offer simplified data visualization construction and integration. Leveraging artificial intelligence functionality, users can build custom dashboards and visualizations for data derived from various sources including SQL and NoSQL databases, and custom API endpoints. Onvo AI promotes a seamless integration process allowing for smooth assimilation with both internal and customer-facing products. It provides the capability to connect multiple data sources, enabling a more comprehensive analysis and visualization. In addition, the software ensures a strong focus on data privacy by keeping the users' data within their own systems. Furthermore, Onvo AI provides a no-code widget for effortless integration of data dashboards and visualizations. Among its features is an expanding library of native integrations designed to seamlessly connect with a diverse array of data sources. Lastly, Onvo AI provides dev-friendly Software Development Kits (SDKs) for users who prefer to do their development directly on the platform.

name: Ace
description: Ace is an AI co-pilot tool designed for engineering leadership. It aims to benefit both engineering managers and developers by saving them from monotonous routines, stagnation, and burnout. Ace automates mentorship, growth, and feedback in dev teams, making it easier for managers to constantly develop people skills and motivate their team. The tool offers features such as skill matrix, OKRs, meetings, test and surveys, blog, webinars, and community. Ace identifies strengths and areas for improvement, giving actionable insights on how to develop required skills with mentor and material recommendations. The tool also notifies managers about potential burnouts and automatically creates a meeting agenda for them to address it with their team.Ace helps identify the best candidates for promotion and high potential performers based on their career paths and the objectives set. It also tracks how much time developers are spending in meetings versus coding and provides recommendations for optimizing the balance.Ace offers insights and advice on how to improve productivity in developers, such as adding mentor sessions or courses and generating agendas. It also regularly updates growth plans based on reviews, feedback, working activity, and business goals with the latest materials and resources from a curated knowledge base. Overall, Ace is a valuable tool for engineering leaders looking to automate people growth and improve their team's performance and skills while retaining top performers.

name: Clarify AI
description: Clarify AI is a tool designed to help users transform vague ideas into structured insights in a matter of minutes. It aims to assist individuals facing challenges in articulating their thoughts and is tailored for those who navigate ambiguity daily in the workplace. The tool works in the following steps:1. Starting with an ambiguous idea: Users provide a vague idea, and Clarify AI refines and articulates it to ensure a shared vision of the problem.2. Effortless structuring: The tool automatically creates an organized issue tree, complete with questions and examples, empowering users to focus on refining and crystallizing the problem.3. Relevant context: With guidance and insights from the user, Clarify AI generates context that is specific and relevant to the problem at hand.4. Actionable output: Users provide their insights, and together with Clarify AI, they create outputs that go beyond generic boilerplate, offering both structure and relevance.The benefits of using Clarify AI include the ability to achieve clarity in minutes, effortless structuring of ideas, and a solid foundation for further research or providing context for other AI tools. It aims to address the pain point of generating good output without sufficient context and offers a solution by co-creating relevant context with the user. Overall, Clarify AI aims to help users refine their ideas and generate actionable insights efficiently and effectively.

name: Klarity
description: Klarity is an audio journaling app that provides a convenient way to record your thoughts and ideas using their intuitive web or mobile app. The app leverages artificial intelligence (AI) to summarize and transform your voice notes into clear, structured text in seconds. These transcriptions are then seamlessly integrated with Notion, a workspace and task management tool, ensuring that no thought or idea is lost.With Klarity, users can effectively organize their thoughts by streamlining the countless ideas and tasks that often overwhelm us. Instead of using separate task apps, users can simply voice out their tasks, which are then summarized and added directly to their Notion workspace for effortless task management.Additionally, Klarity empowers users to elevate their brainstorming sessions. By voicing out innovative ideas and collaborating on Notion, users can engage in productive brainstorming sessions for their projects.Klarity offers a free plan that allows for recordings of up to 5 minutes without requiring a credit card. For users who require more recording time, they can opt for the premium plan, which includes 15 minutes per recording and unlimited recordings, as well as the integration with Notion for $5 per month.Overall, Klarity provides a user-friendly solution for audio journaling, transforming voice notes into text, and integrating them seamlessly with Notion for efficient organization, task management, and brainstorming.

name: AdminAI
description: The Auto-complete next steps, Salesforce & emails tool is a Sales AI assistant designed to streamline and enhance the sales process. It automates various tasks such as completing Salesforce updates, follow-up emails, and pitch decks, saving users a significant amount of time.With no setup required, users can quickly send pre-drafted emails for efficient follow-ups. The tool also generates accurate notes that focus on the key aspects that matter to sellers, helping users stay organized. Additionally, it updates CRMs automatically, eliminating the need for manual data entry and preventing users from being chased by their managers for outdated information.The tool offers the ability to auto-generate accurate follow-ups based on recorded calls, sparing users the hassle of re-listening to them. Users can define the sections, and the tool's AI generates the content, ready to be reviewed, edited, and sent once the call ends.Call notes are fine-tuned for sales purposes, capturing important details such as the three Whys, MEDDPICC, and business impact. The tool's Smart Summary feature identifies the customer's main points and themes, ensuring nothing crucial is missed. Notes can be saved to the user's CRM or any preferred location.The pricing model includes two months free for new users, followed by a monthly fee of $15. All features are included in one package, with new features being added regularly. Payment is requested at the end of the free months.Overall, the Auto-complete next steps, Salesforce & emails tool offers an efficient and convenient solution for sales professionals, helping them save time, stay organized, and improve their follow-up processes.

name: Reverse Dropshipping
description: Findcheap is a Chrome extension powered by ChatGPT that helps users save money on Amazon by detecting dropshipped products and finding their original source. When you click on the extension icon, the AI analyzes the text and images on the product page and searches the web to find where you can get the product for a lower price.The extension tackles the issue of reverse dropshipping, which occurs when sellers find cheap products on platforms like Aliexpress and resell them on Amazon at a significantly higher price. By using Generative AI, Findcheap breaks down the product page to identify the original source, ensuring that users never overpay again.For brand name products, the extension also provides information on whether they are likely to be dropshipped and offers alternative options at cheaper prices.Users can request additional features for the extension, and the developers are focused on constantly improving the algorithm for better accuracy and faster run times. The extension is now globally supported, allowing users from anywhere in the world to utilize its features.Findcheap is a powerful tool for cost-conscious shoppers on Amazon, leveraging AI technology to help them find the best deals and avoid overpaying for dropshipped products.

name: Raya
description: Raya is an AI-powered job assistant tool called by Waivly that helps job seekers in their job search process. It offers a range of features and functionalities that aim to enhance the job hunting experience. Users can use Raya to create professional resumes that stand out to employers, and the tool can also assist in composing personalized cover letters that make strong impressions. Raya provides customized tips and practice questions to help users prepare for job interviews effectively. Additionally, it offers networking strategies to help users connect with professionals in their desired field.The tool also offers job search help by crafting a job search strategy based on the user's skills and experience, making the process more efficient and targeted. Raya can guide users on skill enhancement by suggesting learning resources for acquiring new skills. It can also provide guidance on salary negotiation, aiding users to negotiate competitive offers.Raya assists in gathering insights about companies of interest to help users make informed decisions. Additionally, it provides guidance on sending follow-up messages after interviews for proper interview etiquette.Overall, Raya aims to streamline the job search process through its AI-powered capabilities, providing users with personalized support, and enhancing their chances of success in finding meaningful employment.

name: Giftit
description: Giftit is an AI tool designed to help users choose suitable gifts by engaging their contacts in anonymous, automated conversations. The tool uses a persona named 'Sherlock' who can communicate with your friends through popular messaging platforms like WhatsApp and iMessage. Based on these interactions, it helps identify potential gift items. The application is built for various occasions, such as birthdays, graduations or spontaneous gifting moments. Users start by selecting a contact, after which Sherlock interacts with the chosen friend. This interaction is completely anonymous, allowing users to stay behind the scenes. Subsequently, users can view the results from the discussion between Sherlock and their friend, aiding them to select the perfect gift. The outcome can be viewed either as a full conversation transcript or as a summary generated by the software. The tool has been positively reviewed by users for its human-like interaction and its ability to help think of unique gift ideas. According to the available information, Giftit has a user-friendly interface and is created and managed in Europe.

name: Immplify
description: immplify is an advanced document management system and platform designed specifically for immigrants. It offers a range of features to simplify the immigration process and streamline document organization. With immplify, users can easily upload and manage their immigration documents. The platform utilizes AI technology to analyze each document and extract important information, which is then presented in a user-friendly dashboard. This dashboard allows users to view, track, and share all their important immigration details in one place.The platform offers several features designed to cater to the specific needs of immigrants. These features include consolidated travel history, which allows users to view and sort their entire travel history in an interactive model. The system also automatically organizes all immigration documents into logical folders, making it easy for users to find what they need. Additionally, immplify provides customizable dashboards for efficient tracking of immigration details and one-click sharing of documents.immplify also offers valuable services to immigrants, such as visa form assistance, personalized cheatsheets for visa forms, and on-demand legal advice at an affordable price. The platform prioritizes security and ensures the protection of sensitive information through 2-factor authentication, AES 256-bit encryption, and data redaction.Testimonials from satisfied users highlight the benefits of immplify, including improved organization, ease of access, time savings, and peace of mind.Overall, immplify is a comprehensive platform that simplifies the immigration process by providing advanced document management, personalized assistance, and a supportive immigrant community.

name: Wild Moose
description: Wild Moose is an AI tool designed to assist on-call developers in quickly identifying the source of production incidents. It offers a conversational AI interface that is trained on the developers' environment, allowing them to delegate the search through logs and metrics to the AI. By processing hours' worth of observability data in seconds, Wild Moose provides developers with rapid issue resolution.The tool offers actionable insights and fix suggestions, allowing developers to quickly troubleshoot and resolve issues. It also enables seamless collaboration among team members, facilitating effective real-time collaboration through integration with Slack. Features such as incidents kickoff, status updates, and incident summaries are available within the Slack environment.Wild Moose can untangle complex logs, making it easier for developers to navigate and understand relevant information. The conversational AI interface is trained specifically on the user's environment, ensuring that it can provide direct, relevant answers to queries about the system.In terms of security, customer data is not retained outside of the user's network, and end-to-end encryption of user data is ensured at all times. For added security, there is an option for on-premise deployment, limiting access to data within the user's network.The pricing of Wild Moose varies based on different plans, ranging from a starter plan for small teams to enterprise plans for organizations with custom needs. The tool integrates with popular platforms such as Slack and Datadog, with additional integrations available for higher-tier plans. The tool can handle unstructured data, requiring no preparation of data or monitoring tools prior to use.

name: Design2code
description: Design 2 Code is an AI-powered tool that enables users to effortlessly convert their design into clean and functional code. Without the need for manual coding, this tool simplifies the process of translating design elements into useable code. It supports a variety of design formats, allowing users to upload their design files or simply drag and drop them onto the platform.To use Design 2 Code, users must have an OpenAI account and provide their API key (specifically GPT4 vision access) in the settings dialog. It is worth noting that this tool does not store API keys, enhancing data privacy and security.The conversion process is automated, applying advanced AI algorithms to accurately interpret the design elements and generate corresponding code. By removing the manual coding aspect, Design 2 Code streamlines and speeds up the development workflow, saving both time and effort for designers and developers.Overall, Design 2 Code offers a convenient solution for transforming designs into functional code. Its user-friendly interface and support for various design formats make it accessible to a wide range of users. Whether you are a professional designer seeking to expedite the coding process or an aspiring developer with limited coding skills, this tool provides an efficient method to convert your design concepts into code seamlessly.

name: StoryBird
description: Story.com is an AI-powered tool designed to empower digital storytellers, authors, writers, and influencers with the ability to generate engaging stories and videos. The tool emphasizes creativity, giving users the capability to produce mini-stories and AI-generated videos with enhanced narrative coherence in real time. The platform allows for active user involvement, offering a robust editing toolkit that enables users to rewrite plotlines, reshape characters, and restyle scenes according to their creative needs and vision. Story.com ensures a story-centric focus by modelling a storyboard progression to achieve coherent plots that form story arcs, which span from introduction to climax and resolution. It caters to a wide array of users including animators, influencers, video professionals, and storytellers. For animators, it facilitates the creation of vivid 60-second shorts that bring animated characters to life with rich backstories. Influencers can utilize the platform to create short viral videos, jokes, stunts, and cliffhangers tailored to their brand. Video professionals can amplify their capabilities with the help of AI-generated 60-second rough cuts for ads, trailers, and promos. For storytellers eager to share their narratives, the platform's AI handles the heavy lifting, enabling their stories to shine. Story.com is designed for creators needing an efficient and effective tool for generating compelling narratives.

name: Maskmyprompt
description: MaskMyPrompt is an AI tool that allows users to anonymize their prompts before sending them to ChatGPT. This tool is designed for users who want to protect their confidential data by changing the names of people, organizations, and locations in their prompts to made-up ones. With MaskMyPrompt, users can highlight the names that need to be masked, and the tool will replace them with fictional counterparts automatically.To ensure data privacy, all prompt data stays private in the user's browser window and is never saved or sent to any server. MaskMyPrompt is written with amazing Transformers.js and jointly programmed by Mike Ushakov and ChatGPT. To report bugs, to request features or to share use cases, users can contact MaskMyPrompt via email or Twitter.Overall, MaskMyPrompt is an AI tool that enables users to control their data and ensure their privacy when interacting with ChatGPT. By automating the anonymization process, this tool makes it easier for users to protect sensitive information in their prompts.

name: ProtestGPT
description: ProtestGPT is an AI tool designed to aid activists in raising awareness about the potential dangers of uncontrolled artificial intelligence (AI) development. It offers over 200 innovative protests that highlight the existential perils posed by AI. The tool provides several initiatives such as guerrilla campaigns, virtual and physical rallies, marches, educational and artistic campaigns, and legal-focused initiatives that aim to influence international organizations and promote alternative governance systems.The campaigns are designed to address several important considerations such as throttling AI growth, unplugging GPTs, promoting alternative governance, fighting for AI safety, advocating for ethical AI policies and legislation, and alerting the public about the dangers of AI advancements. ProtestGPT also highlights the role of social media, financial institutions, and the entertainment industry in shaping AI governance systems and urges them to act responsibly to mitigate AI-driven existential threats.ProtestGPT is an effective platform for activism that empowers people to raise awareness of the potential risks of AI to humanity. It provides several creative campaigns and initiatives that are designed to raise awareness about AI-driven existential threats in a compelling, efficient, and engaging way. With over 200 innovative protests, ProtestGPT is an essential tool that enables activists to engage in pressure tactics that can influence organizations and governments to take responsible actions regarding AI governance systems.

name: AskBooks
description: AskBooks is an AI-powered book summary website that enables users to gain insights from over 2,000 books and authors. Users can "talk" to the book or authors to reveal hidden insights and ask questions on their favorite books or authors. The website covers a variety of themes that include entrepreneurship and startup, expecting and parenting, finance and investing, travel and lifestyle, personalities, dating and relationship, health and fitness, cooking and recipes, religion and spirituality, as well as fiction. The website provides a search function for specific book titles or author names. Additionally, it displays a list of popular books and authors that users can interact with. For users who cannot find their favorite books, the website invites them to submit their titles along with the author's name and ISBN. While the website uses AI to generate answers from books and authors, it cautions visitors that these responses should not be taken at face value as they may contain inaccuracies and should be considered parodies. Overall, AskBooks provides a tool for people who prefer a summary of a book or insights from an author that differs from traditional book reviews or the author's intended message.
features: ✅ Search function for books or authors
✅ Displays answers made public by users

name: Productivity Pet
description: Productivity Pets is a software platform powered by artificial intelligence that provides users with endless possibilities to increase their productivity. It is designed to help users manage their daily tasks, prioritize their workload, and stay focused on their goals. With its intuitive and simple user interface, users can easily set up their productivity goals and track their progress. The AI-powered assistant helps users understand trends in their performance, allowing them to identify areas that need improvement and take corrective action. The platform also offers a range of advanced features, such as the ability to integrate with other productivity tools, customize data analysis and reporting, and set up reminders to ensure that tasks are completed on time. Productivity Pets is available on both Android and iOS devices and provides users with an easy way to take control of their productivity.

name: Blockadelabs
description: Blockade Labs offers an AI-powered solution for generating 360° skybox experiences through their platform, Skybox Lab. With a focus on breaking down barriers between technology and creativity, Blockade Labs empowers users to create immersive virtual spaces in seconds by simply inputting text prompts. The platform requires no coding experience, making it accessible for any creative wizard to bring their ideas to life in the form of an infinite 360° world. Skybox Lab's AI technology allows for the creation of unique skyboxes that can be easily integrated into virtual reality experiences, games, or visual media projects. The platform features an API access option for more advanced users to take advantage of the technology in their own projects. Blockade Labs is committed to fostering a community of visionaries and scientific spellcrafters, encouraging users to share their experiences and discover what's possible in the world of world-building technology. Interested users can easily access the Skybox Lab platform and try it out for themselves through the provided link. Overall, Blockade Labs and Skybox Lab are powerful tools for any creative individual looking to easily and seamlessly integrate AI-powered skyboxes into their virtual projects.

name: Askyoutube
description: Ask Youtube is a tool that leverages artificial intelligence to help users obtain specific information from YouTube videos without having to watch them entirely. Users can input a query of their choice and the tool will provide the most precise and accurate answers. Its aim is to make knowledge found in videos more accessible, eliminating the need to watch extensive footage to acquire desired knowledge. Example queries could range from 'What is the best way to grow plants indoors?' to 'What are the health benefits of green tea?'. Not only does this save time, but it also allows for easy acquisition of essential information. The tool uses advanced AI technology to summarise video content and provide a response that best matches the user's query. It is an excellent resource for anyone looking to extract specific data from YouTube swiftly and efficiently.

name: MAIVE
description: MAIVE: Music AI Video Exporter is an application designed for iOS devices that allows users to create and export music videos using artificial intelligence technology. Users can select a song from their device's library, choose a video style from the provided templates or upload their own custom video, and let the app automatically generate a music video using AI technology. The app also allows users to customize elements of their video such as filters, text overlays, and transitions. name: AI to Human Converter
description: AI to Human Text Converter is a tool designed to convert ChatGPT content into human-like content by removing AI signatures without altering any of the original text. With Prompter, users can easily make quick adjustments to their prompts, iterate through different variations, and intuitively compare and label the results. name: StableCode
description: StableCode is an LLM generative AI product for coding developed by Stability AI. It aims to assist programmers in their daily work and serve as a learning tool for new developers. The tool offers three different models to enhance coding efficiency. The base model is trained on a diverse set of programming languages from the stack-dataset, including popular languages like Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, C, Markdown, and C++. It has been further trained on 560B tokens of code. The instruction model is specifically tuned to solve complex programming tasks and is trained on around 120,000 code instruction/response pairs. StableCode's long-context window model allows for single and multiple-line autocomplete suggestions, making it an ideal assistant for reviewing or editing large amounts of code simultaneously. Compared to previous open models, StableCode can handle 2-4 times more code at once, equivalent to editing up to five average-sized Python files. This feature makes it an excellent learning tool for beginners who want to tackle more significant coding challenges. Stability AI aims to make technology more accessible, and StableCode is a significant step in realizing this vision. The tool empowers people of all backgrounds to create code to solve everyday problems using AI. It also seeks to provide fairer access to technology worldwide. StableCode is designed to help the next generation of software developers learn to code and contribute to a more inclusive tech ecosystem.

To ensure effective results, users are advised to utilize clear, specific phrases in their questions. In case of unsatisfactory results or query generation failures, users are encouraged to refine their queries or check the network and request limits. GitHub Data Explorer relies on a number of technologies including the GH Archive and GitHub event API for data sourcing, and the TiDB Cloud for handling large-volume data.
