name: Neexa AI
description: Neexa AI is an artificial intelligence-powered sales assistant application designed to assist businesses by handling a variety of sales-related activities. It operates on a 24/7 basis, engaging prospects with human-like text chat with the objective to convert them into customers. After creating an account, businesses can upload their product and service information onto the Neexa dashboard. Following this, the AI agent is available to be integrated as a widget on a user's website, a full-page link, or in tandem with a user's WhatsApp Business. As a tool, it ensures prospective customers are engaged and responded to strategically and in a timely manner. Furthermore, the platform includes negotiation skills, industry-specific knowledge, and human-like responses to assist users. Neexa comes with an in-built AI-powered dashboard that allows users to oversee and intervene in chats, update business and product details, and customize the tone and voice of the AI agent. It also provides real-time AI-generated reports and briefs, with the capacity to teach the AI agent about a user's process. Lastly, users have the option of upgrading their package and adding on several features and capabilities.

name: Huxli
description: Huxli.ai is a student-focused AI tool that helps with various writing assignments. The tool is designed to help students enhance their writing quality and productivity, while also providing assistance in a user-friendly manner.Huxli.ai offers several powerful features such as the AI Humanizer, which detects AI-generated content and offers corrections to make it undetectable. The AI Freewrite feature helps writers who are stuck in their writing flow by suggesting the next sentence. Long Format Essays feature is also available, which helps writers to structure and generate up to 10 pages of cohesive and detailed essays.Additionally, Huxli.ai has versatile writing utilities such as Summarize, Paraphraser, Answer Discussion, Quote Finder, and Speech Maker, which simplify the writing process. By providing specialized and focused tools, Huxli.ai enables students to write efficiently and with detailed analysis on any given topic.The tool has been highly praised by students from various universities, who confirm Huxli.ai's ability to transform deadline anxiety into good grades and fun weekends while also bringing valuable time for extracurricular activities. The tool is suitable for students who want to write long and detailed essays and for those who need assistance in summarizing and paraphrasing texts. Overall, Huxli.ai is a highly recommended tool for students looking to enhance their writing productivity, efficiency and quality.

name: Sticker Prompt Generator
description: The Sticker Prompt Generator is a feature provided by How to Leverage AI, aimed at enabling users to easily and efficiently generate multiple art styling options. It is designed to eliminate the need for lengthy decision-making processes and to facilitate learning new design styles. The user inputs what they want to draw, and the tool provides varied stylistic interpretations. This tool is versatile, proving beneficial for diverse design endeavours such as creating stickers for t-shirts, emojis, character design, Non-fungible Tokens (NFTs), comics, and social media content. It uses artificial intelligence to generate unique combinations of art styles, assisting users in exploring and finding their own creative design style. An additional support feature of this tool gives users the opportunity to learn how to transform stickers into characters and tips on selling art online. It is part of a suite of AI tools provided to catalyse creativity and generate income through AI technology.

name: Kurby
description: Kurby is an AI-powered app designed for the real estate industry. It utilizes location data to estimate property values more accurately than before. With Kurby, users can access comprehensive information about any property and its surroundings, including market trends, demographics, and location-specific details. This data helps homebuyers and investors make informed decisions when it comes to property investments.The app offers several features aimed at simplifying the home-buying process. Firstly, Kurby analyzes location data in a unique way to identify the best places for users to live. This helps individuals find areas that suit their preferences and needs. Additionally, Kurby provides a proprietary location score, making it easier for users to evaluate the comfort, convenience, and livability of different properties.Kurby also offers information about specific neighborhoods, allowing users to gain insights into the local area before spending valuable time evaluating it further. With Kurby's home value estimator tools, users can even find the most livable home in a neighborhood, saving time and effort during the home-buying process.Overall, Kurby aims to empower users with real estate intelligence by leveraging AI technology. By providing access to accurate and up-to-date property data, market trends, and location-specific information, Kurby helps users make more informed decisions when it comes to buying or investing in real estate.

name: Clickup
description: ClickUp AI Writing Assistant is an AI-powered tool designed to increase efficiency and productivity in various professional roles. With a wide range of handcrafted and research-backed AI prompts, the tool offers tailored assistance for specific fields such as marketing, product and engineering, project management, customer support, and sales.The main features of ClickUp AI include the ability to generate creative ideas, summarize lengthy text, and kick-start the writing process. By automating these tasks, users can save a significant amount of time and streamline their workflow.The tool excels in its summarization capabilities, allowing users to generate concise summaries of comment threads, meeting notes, and other lengthy content. Additionally, it can quickly extract action items and insights from documents and tasks, enabling users to focus on essential tasks and decision-making.Testimonials from users highlight the significant time saved after implementing ClickUp AI, with tasks that previously took minutes now being completed in seconds. The tool not only enhances productivity but also ignites creativity, providing users with valuable assistance in their professional endeavors.Overall, ClickUp AI Writing Assistant is a purpose-built tool that leverages AI technology to support professionals in various roles. With its ability to generate ideas, summarize text, and facilitate the writing process, it offers an efficient solution for saving time and increasing productivity.

name: Voyager minedojo
description: Voyager is an open-ended embodied agent powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) that continuously explores, acquires new abilities, and makes novel discoveries in the Minecraft environment without human intervention. The Voyager system is primarily made up of three components. First, an 'automatic curriculum' guides the system's exploration. This curriculum is determined based on the system's progress and state, with an overarching goal of discovering a diverse array of objects and features. Second, a 'skill library' stores and retrieves complex behaviors. Each acquired skill is indexed by the embedding of its description, which is later used to retrieve that skill when faced with similar situations, and the development of such skills is also vital in minimizing catastrophic forgetting. Third, an 'iterative prompting mechanism' generates executable code for control using the environment's feedback, execution errors, and self verification. Voyager interacts primarily through blackbox queries with a Large Language Model (LLMs). For its action space, the system uses code rather than low-level motor commands since the former can easily represent temporally extended actions and compositional tasks, which are necessary for numerous long-term tasks in Minecraft. Generally, Voyager can establish unique tasks based on its current skill level and state of the world, improve skills based on environmental feedback, commit skills to memory for future similar tasks and explore the world in a self-sufficient way, continually seeking new tasks to complete.

name: Controlla Voice
description: Controlla Voice is an AI tool that allows users to train their own AI singing voice. By uploading as little as 3 minutes or up to an hour of vocals, users can create a model of their own singing voice. The tool also allows users to blend unlimited voices in any proportion, enhancing the tone of their singing voice and creating unique voices. Users can transform vocals into their own voice, generating cover songs or hiring real singers to sing in different styles and languages.Controlla Voice offers several features, including the ability to train your singing voice, blend unlimited voices, and convert singing vocals. With a Creator Plan, users can convert unlimited vocals into their voice. The tool supports multiple languages, allowing users to create multilingual songs.Security and privacy are emphasized, as voices are accessible only to the user by default. However, users can grant access to their voice to collaborators, producers, songwriters, and engineers as desired.Controlla Voice offers pricing plans for early access, providing access to high-quality AI singing voices. The tool is designed to help cover compute costs and support real singers.Overall, Controlla Voice provides users with the ability to train their own AI singing voice and explore endless possibilities in vocal mixing, sound design, producing, and songwriting in multiple languages.

name: FaceAiSwap
description: FaceAiSwap is an AI-powered tool designed to switch faces between two uploaded images. Users of this tool can swap faces with any person, including celebrities, friends, sports stars, or characters from images. The user interface is straightforward and easy to use. To initiate a face-swap, users first need to upload a clear picture of their own face. Secondly, users upload the image into which they want their face to be inserted. After hitting the 'Swap' button, the tool applies the face-swap. It targets the facial area in the second introduced picture and replaces it with the face from the first image. As the output, users will get a photo with their face swapped into the second image, making it appear as if they are the person in the new image. The tool offers unlimited swaps for users who opt for a one-time payment. Apart from the face swapping service, it also offers email support. This tool is particularly appealing for those who enjoy creating personalized, fun, or humor-based content.

name: AskMyDocs
description: AskMyDocs.ai is an AI-powered tool that revolutionizes documentation processes. It is designed to enhance knowledge management and customer support by providing efficient, accurate, and accessible documentation. With AskMyDocs, users can receive precise and instant answers directly from their own documents.The tool offers various integrations to enhance its functionality. It can integrate with platforms such as Zendesk, Gitbook, Sitemap, PDF, Slack, and Chatbot. By linking, training, and asking, users can transform their knowledge bases, repositories, websites, and PDF files into intelligent resources that provide instant and intelligent responses.AskMyDocs aims to be platform-agnostic, ensuring that documentation is easily accessible regardless of the platform being used. It provides simple pricing plans suitable for businesses of all sizes, with options for free and paid plans. The tool also offers customization options for embedded chatbots and features based on specific needs.Getting started with AskMyDocs is straightforward. Users can create a free account or opt for a complimentary 30-minute white-glove service to facilitate the setup process. The tool allows users to ask questions and receive accurate answers without interrupting their workflow or requiring additional logins.AskMyDocs encourages user feedback through its feedback button on every page, aiming to continuously improve the tool with each update. Although currently integrated with Zendesk and Gitbook, AskMyDocs also plans to integrate with ReadMe, Docusaurus, and other platforms in the future.

name: Meetslay
description: Meetslay is an AI tool mainly designed to enhance the efficiency and productivity of meetings. Leveraging AI technology, the tool transcribes meetings in real time, supporting numerous languages including English, Spanish, Japanese, Russian, and more. It offers reminders, helping users articulate their points in an efficient manner without omitting crucial details. Through its Chrome extension, users can access the tool during meetings on Google Meet. Meetslay is thoughtfully built to help individuals manage unexpected meetings comfortably. It aids in reducing anxiety and stress associated with public speaking and spontaneous meetings by facilitating effective information delivery and addressing key points. The tool does not provide ready-made answers but reminds the user of the key issues to discuss. As an essential feature pertaining to privacy and data security, the tool does not store meeting transcripts or audio recordings. The transcripts are converted to text in real time and are the sole property of the user. Additionally, the use of Meetslay during meetings should be communicated to all participants as it is not inherently visible to them. Furthermore, unlike many AI tools, Meetslay does not utilize ChatGPT, but instead uses enterprise APIs. Besides, the tool offers support and assistance for user inquiries, providing solutions for any potential challenges.

name: Ranked
description: Ranked is an AI supported SEO service designed to deliver measurable results by working in conjunction with a creative team. The service is implemented in a top-to-bottom approach which includes blog content writing, optimization, backlink creation, and the utilization of leading SEO software. Ranked emphasizes producing high-quality content written by humans, optimizing without spammy techniques, establishing genuine backlinks via active content and leveraging AI-powered SEO software. The AI component primarily enhances content research, optimization and outreach workflows, promoting effective data-driven work and internal productivity. The service appears to be an effective solution for businesses and agencies looking to improve their organic presence on search engines. It offers a comprehensive SEO solution that caters to both the SEO needs of businesses and agencies, including a white label program for agencies to utilize. Although it uses AI technology, Ranked does not use AI to write content, ensuring that the content can consistently index on Google.

name: Talk to Merlin
description: Merlin AI is an AI-led user interview tool that conducts qualitative research, analyzes the responses, and provides insightful and actionable reports. The tool enables in-depth conversations with users and follows up on their responses, creating a human-like dialogue experience. Merlin's AI voice mode ensures zero-delay conversations, making it feel like talking to another human.The tool automatically groups responses into themes, providing summaries and supporting quotes. This allows users to easily identify recurring patterns and themes in the feedback. Sentiment analysis helps users analyze the bigger picture and discover trends across topics. Merlin also automatically segments users into personas, allowing for data slicing and analysis according to these segments.Merlin integrates seamlessly with popular tools like Zendesk, Snowflake, Zapier, and Slack, enabling users to sync data and conduct interviews within their preferred platforms.Additionally, Merlin complies with SOC 2 Type II and GDPR standards (certification pending), making it enterprise-ready and ensuring data security.With Merlin, users can save hours of work each week as the tool automatically generates digestible summaries, assigns tags to recurring themes, and provides actionable reports. It also allows users to ask custom questions and obtain specific insights.Overall, Merlin AI offers a comprehensive and user-friendly solution for conducting qualitative research, analyzing responses, and generating reports, making it an invaluable tool for enhancing product development and user engagement.

name: DotsPal
description: DotsLive is an AI-powered tool that automates talent recruitment by integrating generative AI into career development, professional networking, and job searching. It offers a suite of features aimed at enhancing the user's networking experience and facilitating meaningful connections with industry professionals.One of the main components of DotsLive is its Personalized Career Assistant called DotsPal, which provides users with guidance for networking and job-related preparation, accessible on mobile devices. By leveraging generative AI technology, DotsPal helps users with everyday networking preparation and job searching needs.DotsLive also offers live networking events, where users can engage with experts and build relationships with professionals with industry experience. These events are designed to facilitate connections and foster networking opportunities. Additionally, DotsLive provides regular notifications about guest speakers, making it convenient for users to invite peers to join the platform and participate in relevant discussions.The platform has been used and supported by various communities, including organizations like Waterloo, GoLead, Tsinghua, IBM, Harvard, Schulich, AC, and SAS. Users have praised DotsLive for its ability to improve networking experiences and enable connections with like-minded peers and industry professionals. It has been particularly helpful for students in various fields of study, such as Engineering, Management Analytics, and Business Administration.Overall, DotsLive's AI-powered features aim to streamline talent recruitment processes by providing users with personalized career assistance, networking opportunities, and job search support.

name: Insightai.dev
description: Insight: AI-Powered Medical Research Studio is a tool that enables users to conduct medical research quickly and efficiently. With the power of artificial intelligence, this research studio allows users to input their medical research objectives or topics, generating tasks that gather relevant information about the objective. Users can review the output generated by Insight and run further tasks based on the information found. The tool analyzes the input and generates outputs based on the data gathered, helping users gain insights into their research topic. To maximize results, users are encouraged to input specific objectives. The tool also offers the option to create an account, allowing users to save their objectives for future reference.Insight: AI-Powered Medical Research Studio is designed to assist researchers and medical professionals in conducting research in seconds rather than spending hours manually collecting and analyzing data. By automating the research process using AI, this tool aims to streamline and expedite medical research, potentially enhancing productivity and accelerating discoveries in the field.The tool guarantees privacy, with clearly stated terms of usage and a privacy policy. Additionally, users can easily seek support or provide feedback through the available contact channels, including a Twitter account.

name: ZeroGPT.CC
description: ZeroGPT is a free AI content detection tool that accurately detects AI-generated text through the use of sophisticated algorithms, machine learning algorithms and natural language processing techniques. The AI detector has been trained with a large dataset containing content generated by both AI and humans, allowing it to learn and identify the unique patterns and features present in each type of writing, enabling it to easily differentiate between the two. Users can simply enter their text into the box and ZeroGPT will analyze the text and provide accurate results, showing the percentage (ratio) of human-written and AI/GPT-generated text. ZeroGPT is fast with results appearing almost instantly and supports multiple languages for accurate text detection results. The tool is versatile and can detect outputs from a wide range of AI language models, including GPT-4, GPT-3, GPT-2, LLaMA, Google Bard or any other AI services based on those models. Also, ZeroGPT does not store any user data, ensuring privacy and data security.ZeroGPT is suitable for anyone who wants to detect AI-generated text, including professional writers, students, educators, freelancers, and copywriters. The tool has been trusted by millions of users for its reliable accuracy rate of 98% or higher.

name: CandyAI
description: Candy.ai is a platform that offers users the opportunity to engage with virtual companions through immersive and personalized chats. The tool aims to provide users with a unique and interactive experience by allowing them to dive deep into intricate dialogues and unleash their imagination. The platform features a variety of AI-driven characters, each with their own distinct personalities and backgrounds. Users can explore and choose from a selection of characters, including Naomi Carter, a materialistic daddy's princess seeking to meet new people, and Bianca Moretti, a lifestyle influencer recently returning from her travels. Other characters include Asuna Saito, a 19-year-old Japanese waitress who is a manga lover and gamer, and Anastasia Petrova, an open-minded yoga teacher known for her extroverted nature.Additionally, Candy.ai provides a gallery of AI characters, allowing users to browse and discover different models. It also offers the ability to create and design dialogue scenarios for the companions, enabling users to have more control over their interactions.Overall, Candy.ai offers a platform where users can engage in adaptive role-plays and have immersive conversations with AI companions. The tool aims to provide users with a unique and personalized experience, offering a diverse range of characters to engage with.

name: Book of Art History
description: A nonfiction book about art history, featuring twelve ai portraits of your kid. A unique use of ai to make a physical product. It offers parents a fun and meaningful activity to share with their children while promoting artistic and cultural literacy.

name: 5StarEssays AI Essay Writer
description: 5StarEssays AI Essay Writer is an AI-powered tool designed to assist with essay writing tasks by generating high-quality, customized essays, largely aimed at assisting students. Apart from generating essays, the tool also offers topic ideas and essay samples, based on the user-inputted topic. Users can select their academic level to adjust the complexity level of the essay. The tool ensures that the generated content matches the required word count. Additionally, there is an option to modify the output by adding more paragraphs, citations, or other customized requirements. The tool is equipped to improve user's writing skills by generating instant references, enhancing understanding of essay formatting, refining thesis statements, and improving grammar and style. description: This application is a transcription tool that converts voice memos into text, utilizing advanced AI technology. It is designed to work efficiently with large audio files, providing accurate transcriptions directly on the device. This ensures a high level of privacy and security, as no audio data is transmitted off the device for processing. The app offers both free and Pro versions, with the free version including features such as offline functionality, immediate transcription results, multiple language support with an auto-detect option, and a user-friendly interface. Users can record audio even while using other apps, thanks to the background recording capability, and share their transcriptions via email or other applications. The Pro version offers unlimited transcription generations, appealing to users with higher volume transcription needs. Subscriptions are managed through the iTunes account, with automatic renewal ensuring uninterrupted access to the Pro features unless manually cancelled in the account settings. The emphasis on device-based processing for both recording and transcription tasks highlights the app's focus on convenience and data security, making it suitable for a wide range of users from professionals requiring quick transcription services to individuals looking to document personal notes or meetings.

name: CollectivAI
description: Collectiv AI is a browser-based tool that allows users to search and understand any codebase quickly and easily. It eliminates the need for installation and enables users to navigate and comprehend unfamiliar codebases up to 100 times faster. With Collectiv AI, users can contribute to open-source codebases and enhance their coding skills.The tool offers the ability to search and comprehend codebases of any size without the requirement of going through lengthy documentation. It allows users to integrate libraries effortlessly by providing instant answers and skipping the tedious process of studying extensive documentation. Collectiv AI supports multiple programming languages such as JavaScript and Python.Developers can use Collectiv AI to participate in open-source projects, with thousands of developers already utilizing the tool to search, understand, and contribute to over 1500 open-source codebases. It also offers a waitlist for those interested in joining the community, scheduling meetings, and connecting with the creators.Collectiv AI provides additional resources through its blog and social media platforms like Discord, LinkedIn, and Twitter. The tool emphasizes privacy protection and outlines its policies, including privacy, username, and terms of service, on its website.In summary, Collectiv AI streamlines the process of searching, comprehending, and contributing to codebases without the need for installation or extensive documentation. It offers a convenient and efficient solution for developers, helping them navigate unfamiliar codebases quickly and improving their coding skills.
features: ✅ Provides opportunities to enhance coding skills

name: TensorPix
description: TensorPix is an online AI-powered tool designed to enhance and upscale videos and images. It provides users with professional quality enhancement capabilities for videos and images, and the process can be completed entirely within a web browser, requiring no installation. Users can upload videos from any device, choose AI filters to improve video quality, and then download the enhanced output. The platform is recognized for its ability to accomplish this process in minimal time. In addition to video enhancement, TensorPix also offers image enhancements and has processed countless videos, images, and pixels. It's used and trusted by a diverse range of users, from freelancers to studios, with use cases across enhancing old films, improving web graphics, upscaling family photos, and reworking animation renders, among others. The service is appreciated for its level of quality, user-friendliness, speed, and computational efficiency compared to other services, making it a popular choice among many in the digital content creation sphere.

name: Promptxart
description: PromptxArt is an AI-powered tool that helps generate creative prompts for art projects. It has a library of 5 different prompts, which can be used in applications such as Midjourney, Dall-E, Dream Studio (Stable Diffusion), Craiyon, and NightCafe. The tool also offers advanced options, allowing users to select specific genres of art, such as Pixel Art, Da Vinci Painting, Low-Poly, Ukiyo-e, Oil Painting, Digital Art, Comic-Strip, Hyperrealistic, Claymation, Futuristic Gothic Pencil Sketch, Renaissance Painting, Baroque Painting, Studio Photography, Mythological, Digital Games, Stained Glass, Egyptian Architecture, Warm Lighting, Editorial Fashion, Action Sports, Avant-Garde, Studio Ghibli, CGI Animation, Comix Wave Films, Shōnen, Seinen, Realistic Animation and more. PromptxArt is easy to use, with users only needing to type in a phrase and the AI will generate a detailed prompt for them. The tool also has a log-in feature for registered users.
features: ✅ Prompt generation for Da Vinci Painting

name: ThinkDiffusion
description: ThinkDiffusion is a cloud-based AI art platform that offers a workspace for 'Stable Diffusion'. The platform allows the user to launch and operate bleeding-edge open-source AI art tools that aid in exploring and expanding the limits of AI-powered creativity. The platform is available in different formats to accommodate users of varying experience levels, and specific UIs are designed to provide the best user experience. The FOOOCUS UI is recommended for those new to AI art, offering a simple yet insightful introduction to the Stable Diffusion ecosystem. On the other hand, AUTOMATIC1111, also known as A1111, is the platform's flagship UI, offering the most comprehensive feature set and a vast extension/plugin ecosystem. For users interested in model creation, the platform offers KOHYA UI that focuses on quick model training and fine-tuning. The COMFYUI is centered around designing and executing intricate workflows, allowing users to create, save, share and gather workflows created by the platform's user community. Users utilize ThinkDiffusion in various domains, from advertising and education to fashion and filmmaking, as seen in the creative applications executed by global brands, universities, and other users.

name: WhatsGPT
description: WhatsGPT is an AI-driven chatbot that employs the advanced capabilities of the GPT model to facilitate seamless conversations over popular messaging platforms such as WhatsApp, Telegram, and Facebook Messenger. This tool aspires to revolutionize messaging with its potential to deliver AI-driven conversation at any location and across all platforms. It provides the added power of not only text but also voice messages and images, enriching the user's communication experience. The tool's core feature is its integration into the user's favorite messaging app, providing a unified messaging solution that retains conversation history across various platforms. It lends itself to diverse applications such as responding to customer inquiries, generating reports, and drafting contracts, potentially resulting in significant time savings. The tool also has a premium subscription offering, enabling access to advanced features such as unlimited access, voice messaging, image sending, and handling multiple chats concurrently. The principle behind WhatsGPT is to bridge the communication gap between humans and AI in a way that both can contribute to superior performance and decision-making, moving away from the view of AI as a substitute and more towards being a beneficial technology.

name: Flipped
description: Flipped.ai is a smart talent acquisition tool powered by AI technology. It is designed to streamline the hiring process and make it more efficient for HR professionals, recruiters, and hiring managers. The AI platform offers various tools to power different aspects of talent acquisition such as job creation, talent sourcing, talent screening, and talent assessments. Firstly, the platform has AI-powered tools that help in creating detailed job descriptions and advanced screening questions. It gives users the ability to publish jobs in their own branded job portal.Secondly, it has an advanced candidate matching and ranking system. This helps in sourcing top talent instantaneously from the platform's candidate database as well as external sources. Thirdly, it offers an AI-powered candidate screening tool which helps in evaluation of a large volume of job applications in a short span of time. It provides intelligent CV parsing features together with candidate matching & ranking, and AI-powered candidate notes. In addition, it provides a Hiring Co-Pilot that acts as a virtual assistant, offering intelligent insights and support at every stage of the hiring process. There is also a feature for video-based interviews that help in better understanding the candidates. Finally, Flipped.ai offers seamless integration with the top job boards and ATSs on the market. By connecting an ATS to Flipped.ai, the platform can use its AI algorithms to further enhance the hiring process. Overall, Flipped.ai aims to provide a comprehensive, AI-powered solution to simplify and optimize talent acquisition.

name: Ioni AI
description: ioni.ai is an AI tool that provides a ChatGPT (Generative Pretrained Transformer) solution for customer support teams. It offers an automated system to help customer support teams resolve tickets faster while reducing costs, and providing more efficient responses to inquiries. It improves productivity by using auto-responding to increase the number of solved tickets while simultaneously reducing the time customers wait for a response. This system integrates with many popular CXM (Customer Experience Management) systems with just one click. This tool also includes a suggested auto-reply feature, which automates routine inquiries with just one click. Using natural language processing, it generates suggested replies that are grammatically correct and aligned with the brand voice. Additionally, Guide AI instructs the AI system to understand the problem, describe tone and style of response to provide extended answers. With the latest technology, using ChatGPT-4, customers can communicate in a human-like manner with the AI solution. The tool offers self-learning capabilities, i.e. if an agent independently responds to a request, an answer is automatically added to the Knowledge Base. ioni.ai also offers an early access program for users to become early adopters and get access to the latest features and benefits, such as immediate responses, resolving and close up to 80% of common tickets with just one click and increase in response speed even on complex inquiries up to 3x times.
features: ✅ Style and tone of response considered

name: Writebot
description: Writebot is an AI content writing tool that utilizes machine learning and natural language processing to generate written content. The system is designed to maintain consistency with a brand's voice and message. In addition to content creation, Writebot also aids in translating texts, summarizing information, and generating creative content. The technology offers various use cases including generating ideas and outlines for blogs, creating sections of blog posts, providing business ideas, writing professional cover letters, composing social media ads for Facebook and Twitter, generating post and caption ideas, producing SEO-friendly meta descriptions and titles, and crafting descriptions for products and videos. The AI's capability simplifies the content creation process, reduces potential human errors, saves time, and delivers the necessary output for each task at hand. Writebot has an easy-to-use interface where users input details, and the AI then generates the content. Once delivered, users can further edit and refine the content as needed. The efficiency of Writebot not only accelerates the content creation process but also assures the production of high-quality, engaging, and relevant content.

name: AI-Sprinter
description: AI-Sprinter is a sophisticated AI tool that capably mimics the writing style of a brand or an individual. Its core functionality involves the generation of text for social media posts, which are written as if by the brand or person themselves. To accompany the text, the tool creates attractive images tailored to the content of the posts. A feature intended for brands without a distinct style exists too, with AI-Sprinter being able to evolve a unique voice specifically characteristic of a company from nothing. The tool also flexes its language generation abilities by creating posts in up to 43 languages, maintaining the unique voice of the brand across different languages. AI-Sprinter can transform raw product photography into images that suit the context of a paticular post. The software also extracts vital information from web articles and crafts posts in your brand style. In terms of its workflow, AI-Sprinter takes into account the relevance of trending topics and the seasonality of your brand's products/services. By pasting your website link, AI-Sprinter comprehends the specifics of your business and, based on that, creates a distinct writing style. Overall, this tool is a powerful solution that could centralize the process of creating impactful and engaging social media posts, while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

name: AI Health Mind
description: AI Health Mind was a service provided as a digital healthcare tool designed to answer medical queries. It predominantly catered to answering questions related to physical health. The website was developed as a medium to strengthen the existing relationship between a patient or site visitor and their doctor by supplementing the health information without replacing professional medical advice or treatment. The AI Health Mind site was structured to provide general information on physical health issues, aiming primarily for educational purposes rather than actual treatment or diagnosis. The tool was capable of launching new areas of focus such as providing AI driven answers to vets queries and legal advice through 'Ask AI Lawyer'. Although the service has now been discontinued, during its operational period, AI Health Mind served as a resourceful tool not only for individuals seeking health insights but also for those looking for AI-driven responses to diverse sectors, such as law and pet care.

name: MeGPT
description: MeGPT is an AI tool that allows creators, brands, artists, publishers, agencies, and businesses to create a shareable AI clone of themselves, enhancing their online presence and interaction. With MeGPT, users can generate an AI version of themselves by providing a brief description, and the tool takes care of the complex process of cloning. The created AI clone, known as the user's "Digital Twin," replicates their mannerisms, language, and interests, providing an experience where conversations with the AI clone feel like talking to oneself. This feature adds interactivity and a personal touch to online interactions. The tool also offers a simple and convenient way to share the AI clone with others through a short megpt.xyz link. This makes it effortless for people to engage with the AI clone at any time. Though specific details are not provided, MeGPT promises to provide analytics for the clones, including location and prompts, in the near future. These analytics can help users understand how their AI clone is being interacted with and provide insights on user engagement. MeGPT seems to be a versatile tool that can be utilized by various individuals and businesses to create an AI representation of themselves that is highly interactive and discoverable online.

name: Camb
description: Camb.ai is an AI-powered platform designed to localize video content for content creators and media producers. It enables automatic dubbing of videos into over 100 languages while preserving the original speaker's voice through AI voice cloning. The platform's sophisticated AI models not only translate content colloquially but also maintain the nuances of accents and dialects. Beyond these key features, Camb.ai also supports a variety of content, from sports and e-learning materials to TV and cinema, thus catering to a broad spectrum of creators and industries. Another noteworthy feature is the platform's multi-layer Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities, which streamline localization workflows and deliver near human-perfect dubbed videos. Camb.ai was built in partnership with leading localization companies, offering an intuitive platform to simplify the dubbing process for producers. Combined with the advanced AI capable of capturing emotion-rich dubbing, Camb.ai aims to ensure the production of authentic, culturally resonant translations and open up global audiences for content creators.
features: ✅ Built in partnership with localization companies
✅ Universal localization regardless of content length

name: Kua.ai
description: Kua.ai is an AI-powered content generation tool designed specifically for ecommerce businesses. It offers a range of applications to assist with tasks such as Amazon listing creation, SEO content generation, AI image creation, and more. The tool aims to accelerate content production by generating on-brand and search-optimized ecommerce content across multiple channels at a faster rate, leading to increased traffic, conversion rates, and sales.With Kua.ai, users can follow three simple steps to achieve content mastery. They select the tasks they want to be done from a list of over 200 ready-to-use applications, provide the necessary context by entering product names or keywords along with desired output language and tone, and then confirm the preferred results generated by Kua.ai.The tool also includes features like Infobase, which allows users to incorporate brand information, product details, and brand voice into their content generation process, ensuring distinctiveness and accuracy. Additionally, Kua.ai offers AI image creation capabilities, enabling users to describe desired images in their own words, generate similar-style images, and change backgrounds easily.Kua.ai's AI Chat feature functions as an AI assistant tailored for ecommerce, offering the flexibility to switch between different AI models like GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 based on specific use cases and cost efficiency. It provides real-time web and data access, allowing users to make data-driven decisions. The AI assistant can also refine prompts with one click, eliminating the complexity of crafting professional-grade prompts.Overall, Kua.ai aims to empower ecommerce businesses by streamlining and enhancing their content generation processes, ultimately contributing to their success in a competitive landscape.

name: Write Brain
description: Write Brain is a writing helper and grammar checker tool that assists with creating well-written content by providing one-click corrections and writing improvements. It works seamlessly across various web platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Gmail. This tool allows users to quickly and easily fix grammar mistakes, eliminating the need to manually correct them one by one. By enhancing the quality of writing, Write Brain helps users leave a better impression by ensuring their messages are error-free.In addition, Write Brain helps improve writing clarity by removing verbose, unnecessary words commonly found in corporate jargon. With just one click, users can remove the fluff from their writing and express their thoughts more concisely.Moreover, the tool assists users in adding color and descriptive language to their sentences, enhancing the overall quality of their writing. It also offers suggestions when users struggle to find the right words or phrases, saving time and improving the overall flow of the content.Furthermore, Write Brain allows for easy translation of text, making it convenient for users to communicate with people who speak different languages. It automatically suggests relevant emojis to punctuate paragraphs and offers emoji bullets for lists, adding a touch of fun and visual appeal to the written content.Overall, Write Brain facilitates error-free writing, clarity, improved language use, and multilingual communication, making it a valuable tool for anyone who wants to enhance their writing skills.

name: PokeAI
description: PokeAI is an AI-driven mobile application designed for virtual human chat experiences. Users can engage in conversations with virtual humans of their choice, each with unique personalities and interests. The application promises endless conversation possibilities that are always innovative and avoid being repetitive. Privacy and safety of conversations are ensured by the platform. There are plans with premium features available for users who want more from their experience. The virtual humans on PokeAI receive regular updates to provide fresh conversational content for users. Currently, the application is available for Android and iOS devices. The app's website offers a newsletter subscription option to stay updated with new features, updates, and special promotions. In summary, PokeAI offers an AI-driven chat platform where users can interact with virtual humans, explore conversations with different personalities, and enjoy a continuous supply of innovative dialogues, ensuring user privacy and offering premium features for an enhanced experience.

name: Talklab
description: Talklab is an AI-powered chat analytics tool that helps businesses convert their chat history into actionable insights. It utilizes natural language models to analyze and classify conversation history based on subjects, sentiments, and more. By doing so, it can generate insightful reports that are delivered in a simple and convenient manner.One of the key features of Talklab is its ability to deeply understand customer support and team chat data through the power of AI. It allows businesses to import their chats and tickets from Zendesk, a popular customer support platform, and analyze client sentiments and behaviors. This capability provides valuable information for businesses to improve their customer support processes and enhance the overall customer experience.Talklab also offers the flexibility of integrating with other platforms, with more integrations being added in the future. This enables businesses to leverage their existing systems and further enhance the analysis and insights generated by Talklab.Developed by SOFACODING in Brazil, Talklab offers a user-friendly interface and aims to provide businesses with the tools they need to make data-driven decisions based on their chat history. By utilizing AI technology, businesses can gain valuable insights and improve their operations and customer interactions.

name: DevRev AgentOS
description: DevRev AgentOS is a cloud-based platform designed to help in improving the efficiency and coordination among customer support and software development functions. The tool uses artificial intelligence technology to analyze and cluster customer feedback, helping product managers gain valuable insights. DevRev AgentOS features an in-app search function and 'nudges' - both AI-powered - to enhance the customer experience without compromising the self-service aspect. It also supports live chatting and fine-tuning for continuous learning. The tool is designed to help align technical support with product engineering, streamline tier 2 support processes, and decrease debugging and root cause analysis time. Its AI agents can reduce time taken in customer problem-solving by optimizing priority setting. DevRev AgentOS also includes analytics capabilities that offer a 360 view of customer and product analytics and help in making informed decisions, tracking team performance, and standardizing business processes. It has a serverless workflow engine to define business processes guiding agents and prompt objectives to automate tasks. Various connectors allow actions to be specified for agents to complete across systems. An advanced AI-powered knowledge graph connects your work to its impacts on the customer. DevRev AgentOS also simplifies data exploration and maintains data access permissions across different sources. Altogether, it aims to provide an intuitive and social experience for its users through its beautifully designed apps and enhanced engagement with seamless in-app and portal interactions.
features: ✅ Supports customer support and software development
✅ Aligns technical support with product engineering
✅ Reduces debugging and root cause analysis time

name: Social Plans
description: Astroship is an AI-powered tool designed to enhance social media management. It provides personalized social media post ideas and plans, tailored to your specific needs and area of interest. By incorporating your unique style and preferences, Astroship adds a personal touch to every plan, ensuring that the content resonates with your audience. With Astroship, you can elevate your social media presence and build a stronger connection with your followers. The tool generates weekly plans that consist of engaging and relevant content, allowing you to consistently post valuable updates and keep your social media profiles active and buzzing with activity. These plans are delivered directly to your email inbox, eliminating the need for constant checking and ensuring convenience.The AI-powered plans provided by Astroship are compatible with all social media platforms, allowing you to optimize your strategy across various channels. By utilizing Astroship, you can say goodbye to generic posts and hello to content that truly clicks with your followers.To benefit from this innovative social media management tool, you can join the waitlist and be one of the first to experience the power of intelligent and customized post planning. Astroship offers an opportunity to revolutionize your social media strategy and take your online presence to new heights.

name: Mememes
description: The MeMemes app is an AI-powered tool that enables users to transform themselves or their friends into memes. Through the application of advanced AI technologies, users can create unique and personalized meme avatars effortlessly. By leveraging the power of artificial intelligence, MeMemes offers a novel way of engaging with and expressing oneself through memes. The app opens up creative possibilities for users to generate viral content that reflects their personality or that of their friends. The tool's AI capabilities enable it to recognize facial features and expressions accurately, allowing for the creation of high-quality and realistic meme avatars. Users can easily upload photos or select images from their gallery to begin the meme-making process. MeMemes utilizes advanced algorithms to automatically identify and extract specific features, enhancing the overall humorous and entertaining effect of the memes. This AI technology also enables the app to swiftly generate meme avatars, eliminating the need for time-consuming manual adjustments. With its user-friendly interface and intuitive design, MeMemes makes the meme creation process accessible to users of all skill levels. Whether users want to have a good laugh, entertain their friends, or simply explore the endless possibilities of meme culture, the MeMemes app offers a convenient and enjoyable platform to do so.

name: JustComment
description: Personal Comment Assistant by JustComment is an AI-powered tool that helps users write engaging and personalized comments for social media. Its functionality is currently available as a beta extension on the Chrome Web Store, free of charge and without requiring a credit card. The tool currently works with Twitter and provides a 1-click solution for generating thoughtful and relevant comments for increased audience engagement. In addition, the Personal Comment Assistant allows users to customize their reactions with custom emojis and instructions, reflecting their unique style and personality. The AI system powering the tool generates comments using ChatGPT and responds to specific instructions provided through slash commands. This allows users to easily tailor their comments to fit the context of a post and generate more inclusive and diverse comments.JustComment describes Personal Comment Assistant as a means of increasing audience growth on Twitter, and is currently expanding its functionality to other social media platforms like LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Hacker News, and Product Hunt. However, no exact numbers are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the tool yet. Overall, Personal Comment Assistant is a useful AI tool that simplifies the process of generating engaging and personalized comments for social media and can potentially boost audience engagement and growth for businesses and individuals alike. Full terms of service, privacy, and cookie policies, as well as a contact page, are provided on the JustComment website.

name: Flapper
description: Flapper.ai is an AI-powered content platform designed to streamline the marketing and sales content production process. It provides over 30 proven AI-powered templates that can help users create amazing content 10 times faster, saving countless hours of manual labor. The platform offers more than 50 AI prompt templates for various marketing and sales content needs such as sales copies, social posts, ad copies, and article creation. Users can transform their marketing and sales strategies within seconds by using these easy-to-use templates. The platform uses the best available frameworks to provide great templates that boost user productivity. Flapper.ai offers a one-stop-shop for managing all kinds of written content, from Ad copies to email subject lines and video scripts manager, among others. Users can manage their content creation, track their spending, and view and manage their bills. The platform enables users to track their expenses in real-time, record insights and manage budgets and expense categories. It is trusted by over 14,000 creators and provides options for small, medium and large businesses. The platform offers a free plan with 3,000 words per month, followed by paid plans with 15,000 and 50,000 words per month, respectively. It is fast, produces high-quality content, and offers great value for money. Flapper.ai is an excellent option for professionals searching for an AI-powered content platform that can deliver high-quality content easily and efficiently.

name: Nova App
description: Nova is an AI chatbot, utilizing the capabilities of ChatGPT. It is designed to generate highly human-like responses, fostering a conversational flow akin to chatting with a friendly acquaintance. Functioning as an AI assistant, Nova can offer recommendations or answer both open-ended and precise queries, available to assist users anytime, around the clock. Another prominent aspect of Nova's functionality is its application in educational contexts where it can provide help with homework, from essay writing to mathematical queries. Nova's features extend to functioning as a writing assistant, offering personalized assistance with any writing project. It is able to proofread and analyze text, suggesting improvements and changes to enhance the quality and professionalism of the user's written work. The versatility of Nova's use cases is also demonstrated in its capability to serve as a makeshift travel agent. Nova's functions are not only limited to web platforms but are accessible on various devices including iPhones, Apple Watches, macOS, and Android systems.

name: IconifyAI
description: IconifyAI is a powerful AI-based app icon generator that enables users to create professional icons for their apps or websites in a matter of seconds. It boasts a wide selection of styles, shapes, colors and objects to choose from, allowing users to customize their icons to perfectly represent their brand. With IconifyAI, users can generate up to 80 icons for just $17, 160 icons for $27, or 400 icons for $37. The generated icons are high-resolution (1024x1024) PNG images, and users have full ownership of the icon, including selling rights and copyright. IconifyAI is loved by customers for its fast, automated design process and ability to generate icons that perfectly fit their brand. Additionally, if users are not completely satisfied with the generated icon, they can get in touch with the IconifyAI team to adjust it to their needs.

name: DreamDrop
description: Dreamdrop is an AI-powered platform that allows users to discover and explore artwork created using artificial intelligence. The platform offers a range of features, including the ability to sign in or create an account, view personalized content on the home page, access account information, create and upload artwork, and search for specific pieces. Users can also engage with the artwork by liking and following their favorite artists. Dreamdrop enables users to explore a variety of artistic genres, including abstract, portrait, landscape, and geometric art. Each artwork is associated with an artist, allowing users to easily discover and follow their preferred creators. The platform also provides social features, such as likes and comments, to facilitate engagement and interaction among users.Additionally, Dreamdrop offers a feature called "Dreamwall," where users can view a curated selection of artwork from the artists they are currently following. This personalized view allows users to easily keep up with the latest creations from their favorite artists.Overall, Dreamdrop provides a user-friendly platform for discovering and appreciating artwork made with artificial intelligence. It offers a variety of features to enhance the user experience and promote interaction within the community.

name: vGPT
description: vGPT is an AI-powered video creation platform available on Google Play. The platform offers a range of powerful functions to help users easily create stunning videos. With vGPT's advanced AI video generation technology, users can create high-quality videos in just minutes. The platform's algorithms can generate videos on various topics including education, advertising, and business promotion. Whether you're a marketer looking to create compelling advertisements or an entrepreneur promoting your business through new content, vGPT's AI video generator can help.Additionally, vGPT offers a text-to-video function that allows users to convert any text to speech. This feature is perfect for marketers, educators, and content creators looking to bring their ideas to life. The text-to-video function enables the creation of marketing content, social media posts, and educational videos that truly stand out. Users can add a personal touch to their content, build their own brand, and connect with their audience using vGPT's text-to-speech generator.vGPT also includes a smart video editor with different modes for video display effects, including text, illustration, and smart modes. The smart mode can generate background images according to the text content of each paragraph, enhancing the visual appeal of videos.Furthermore, vGPT provides different choices for broadcast avatars, including virtual humans, AI face animators, and new digital humans. This feature allows users to customize their videos and enhance their creativity.Overall, vGPT offers an intuitive and efficient AI video generation and editing platform, empowering users to create high-quality videos for various purposes and reach a wider audience by optimizing and uploading the videos to popular platforms like YouTube, TikTok, Kwai, Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram.

name: Emailbind
description: Email Bind is an innovative service that allows users to access AI models such as ChatGPT and Google Bard through email. With this tool, you can initiate an intelligent conversation by merely sending an email. To begin, users verify their email by sending a mail to [email protected] . Once verified, they can start a conversation with the AI models by sending an email to the same address. It creates an unprecedented level of convenience by making AI accessible through a familiar platform: email. The system functions on the GPT-3.5/4 model, providing a experience similar to the official website's web version. It also supports Google Bard, which has internet connectivity and can fetch the latest information from the web, including support for Chinese language. By default, users start in a free trial mode. Advanced features and full settings can be unlocked by downloading the 'Email Bind' App from the App Store or upgrading to the Pro version for complete functionality. Options for customization include prompt templates, enabling the GPT-4 model, max tokens, and temperature settings.

name: PDF Coach
description: PDF Coach is an AI tool designed to assist users in refining their thoughts and ideas. This tool enables users to enhance their productivity and efficiency when working with PDF documents. With PDF Coach, users can expect streamlined workflows and improved document organization.By leveraging artificial intelligence, PDF Coach offers a range of features to enhance document processing. Users can annotate PDFs, extract and summarize key information, and efficiently manage their documents. PDF Coach can also automatically extract text from scanned documents using optical character recognition (OCR) technology, making it easier to search and manipulate content.Additionally, PDF Coach provides users with advanced editing capabilities. Users can merge multiple PDFs, split large files into smaller ones, and reorder pages with ease. The tool also offers options for converting PDFs to various file formats, such as Word or Excel, and vice versa.Furthermore, PDF Coach offers a user-friendly interface with intuitive navigation, ensuring that users can quickly adapt to the tool and maximize their productivity. The AI-powered suggestions and recommendations provided by PDF Coach enable users to improve their writing and communication skills.Overall, PDF Coach is a valuable tool for individuals looking to refine their thoughts and ideas through streamlined document management, annotation, extraction, editing, and conversion capabilities.

name: ResuLLMe
description: ResuLLMe is an AI tool hosted on Streamlit's platform. Streamlit is an open-source Python library that allows developers to create custom web applications for machine learning and data science. The ResuLLMe tool presumably takes advantage of these capabilities. As its function isn't explicitly stated, it could be used for a variety of tasks such as data visualization, experimentation, or deploying AI models, consistent with the possibilities offered by the Streamlit platform. However, precise functionality, application areas, strengths and limitations, and the specific problem this tool solves are to be determined when further information is provided. It's worth mentioning that being hosted on Streamlit offers potential benefits including quick prototyping, ease of use, and interactivity features, though these could vary for 'ResuLLMe' depending on how it's developed.

name: Gorgias
description: Gorgias is a helpdesk tool designed specifically for e-commerce stores. The tool provides an all-in-one support inbox that allows businesses to easily centralize and manage customer interactions across various channels, including email, social media, live chat, voice, and SMS. With its automation features, businesses can provide instant resolutions to common customer service enquiries. Utilizing AI, Gorgias is able to automate tasks such as prioritizing, assigning, and tagging support tickets, thus improving efficiency and productivity. Another key feature is the ability to automatically process returns, send tracking information, generate discount codes, update subscriptions, and more, without the need to open Shopify or other e-commerce platforms. Gorgias also offers customer insights, giving customer service teams access to each customers order history, loyalty status, subscriptions, reviews, and more. This information can be used to provide more personalized and helpful responses. The tool is compatible with popular e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, and WooCommerce.

name: ResolveEasy by Cloobot
description: ResolveEasy is a ticket management tool that streamlines the process of tracking, managing, collaborating, and resolving tickets. It is designed to improve both external customer support and internal team issue resolution.For customer support teams, ResolveEasy offers multi-channel communication capabilities, allowing users to effortlessly resolve external tickets and deliver exceptional customer service. Real-time performance reporting provides valuable insights into ticket resolution, enabling teams to provide faster and more personalized support. The tool also includes features for collecting customer feedback and ratings, which helps improve overall customer satisfaction and brand reputation.For internal teams, ResolveEasy offers a shared inbox for efficient collaboration and task management. Real-time reporting of performance allows for seamless resolution of tickets within the organization. These features enhance employee satisfaction and optimize ticket resolution.ResolveEasy stands out with its streamlined help desk management, enabling users to manage and track all support requests in a centralized location. It also maximizes team productivity by automating routine tasks and streamlining workflows. The tool is easily customizable, allowing users to tailor it to their unique business needs.Integrations with existing tools and systems ensure a seamless support experience, while the integration with platforms like WhatsApp enables direct communication with customers. Real-time performance reporting keeps users updated on the status of their disputes.Overall, ResolveEasy empowers teams to optimize operations, provide efficient customer support, and make informed decisions based on up-to-date data.

name: HomestylerAI
description: HomeStyler AI is an innovative tool that allows users to easily and creatively design their interior spaces. With just a clean picture of their space, users can explore and experiment with up to 14 different styles to visualize their dream home. The tool offers inspiration from the community and helps users discover their room's true potential. Users can sign up and receive four free renders without the need for a credit card. Additionally, they can share their results and explore other users' creations. The tool allows for the creation of multiple decor styles with just one picture, providing endless possibilities for users to imagine and design their ideal space. HomeStyler AI has already generated over 2100 renders, showcasing its popularity and success in helping users transform their living spaces. The tool offers subscription plans with different pricing options, including monthly and yearly plans, catering to users with varying rendering needs. Each plan includes the ability to keep originals and renders private, as well as a commercial usage license for those looking to utilize the designs for commercial purposes. HomeStyler AI is designed to be user-friendly, eliminating the need for decoration or architecture knowledge. It uses state-of-the-art artificial intelligence technology to generate photo-like renders of spaces in seconds, making it accessible to a wide range of users. The platform prioritizes security and uses Stripe, a leading payment processor, to ensure secure transactions and protect user information. Overall, HomeStyler AI is a powerful and intuitive tool that allows users to transform their living spaces and make their house into a personalized home.

name: Voiceflow
description: Voiceflow is an AI agent building platform designed for team collaborations. This tool assists teams in designing, developing, and launching chat and voice experiences at scale. It offers a flexible platform for building AI agents that can adapt to various use cases. The Voiceflow platform features a Workflow Builder for constructing multi-step tasks, and a Knowledge Base option to create a repository of curated data for AI agent interactions. With built-in Data Management System, it aids in managing agents at a larger scale by providing centrally managed data across prompts, responses, workflows and more. For those seeking customisation, it offers Developer Tools & APIs that allow you to build custom responses, interfaces, functions, integrations, as well as train your AI agent on your data for more accurate responses and tasks performance. Voiceflows robust developer toolkit enables teams to use, build and share reusable integrations. These integrations can connect with existing tech stacks to deliver customised end-user experiences. The tool also provides a developer platform to add custom features, integrations, interfaces, and more. Voiceflow customers range from automating customer support to managing various business necessities. For secure building, testing, launching and managing of conversational AI agents at scale, Voiceflow provides the Enterprise Cloud, meant for enterprise product teams.

name: Seaml.es
description: Seamless is an AI-driven tool designed to facilitate and accelerate the process of drafting literature reviews for scientific research purposes. By using advanced AI technology, it assists users in finding relevant literature, enabling them to construct comprehensive literature reviews rapidly and efficiently from excerpts of their work. This tool is applicable across various fields including but not limited to Engineering, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biology, Law, Medicine, Pharma, and Business. The platform operates on a credit-based system, where each credit allows the user to generate a new literature review. Moreover, Seamless provides access to different quality models; the Pro plan gives users access to the highest-quality model, which aims to deliver a publication-ready literature review. This tool represents a powerful and time-saving resource for researchers, simplifying the literature review process and focusing on the relevance and quality to meet the publication standards across various scientific domains.

name: Godmode
description: Godmode.space is a tool that allows users to explore the power of generative agents, which are AI algorithms that can create new and unique outputs based on input data. The tool was developed by FOLLGAD and requires users to have JavaScript enabled in their browser to run.The primary function of Godmode.space is to assist users in generating unique and creative outputs in various contexts, such as determining the best market to launch a product, writing a resignation letter, or exploring hypothetical scenarios, such as an advanced pre-ice age civilization. The tool achieves this by utilizing generative agents to analyze input data and generate new and unique outputs based on that data.Godmode.space does not require users to have any programming or technical skills, as it has a user-friendly interface that allows them to input their data and receive the generated outputs in real-time. The tool's outputs are designed to be creative and potentially innovative, providing users with new perspectives on their input data that they may not have considered otherwise.In summary, Godmode.space is a powerful tool for generating unique and creative outputs using generative agents. It is designed for users who want to explore new possibilities, gain new insights, and think outside the box.

name: Presentory
description: AI Presentation Maker, also known as Wondershare Presentory, is a fast AI-powered tool designed to simplify the creation of dynamic and engaging presentations. With this tool, users can effortlessly generate presentations using AI technology. One notable feature of AI Presentation Maker is the ability to customize the presentation by editing the canvas and arranging scenes. This enables users to enhance their presentations and create a more impactful performance.Additionally, AI Presentation Maker offers the convenience of recording and streaming presentations in just one click. It also provides a built-in teleprompter, which helps ensure a polished delivery.Another key feature of AI Presentation Maker is the option to create and share presentations online. Users can store, access, and share their videos from anywhere and at any time, providing flexibility and accessibility.Overall, AI Presentation Maker is a powerful tool that leverages AI technology to simplify the presentation creation process. It offers features such as AI-powered presentation generation, canvas editing and scene arranging, recording and streaming capabilities, and the ability to create and share presentations online. With this tool, users can create impactful virtual presentations that are easier to remember.

name: Podsqueeze
description: PodSqueeze is an AI-powered tool that helps podcast creators generate content quickly and easily. With a few clicks, users can select an episode from their RSS feed and allow AI to generate show notes, timestamps, newsletters and more. PodSqueeze can also generate three SEO-friendly blog post options for users to pick the best fit, allowing them to reach a wider audience. This tool is designed to help podcast creators make the most of their content and drive more website visitors and inbound links. The founders are available to answer any questions or provide feedback and can be contacted via email or direct message.

name: Typing Mind
description: TypingMind is an AI tool that enhances the functionality of ChatGPT, an AI chatbot designed to assist users with various tasks. With TypingMind, users can enjoy faster response times, access to integrated research tools, a prompt library, and more. Unlike some AI chatbots that require users to log in, TypingMind allows users to run the software locally on their browser without requiring any login credentials. One notable feature of TypingMind is its ability to search chat history, which makes it easy for users to quickly retrieve information from previous conversations. The tool also features a prompt library that provides users with pre-determined prompts that can help guide the conversation and improve the effectiveness of the chatbot's responses.To start using TypingMind, users must enter their OpenAI API key in the appropriate field. This allows the tool to connect to the GPT-3.5-turbo model and begin processing user queries. Overall, TypingMind appears to be a valuable addition to the ChatGPT ecosystem and may be useful for individuals or businesses who need a more powerful AI chatbot solution.

name: Rewriteit
description: ReWrite It.AI is an AI-powered tool dedicated to upgrading your writing skills while also providing educational insights. The core functionality of this tool is its proficiency in refining any written content, essentially rewriting text to produce superior quality pieces. Its design promotes a deep understanding of writing nuances, enabling users to learn and improve their writing abilities. The innovative and user-friendly platform allows for a swift and effortless content transformation. The key benefit of using ReWrite It.AI is its ability to synthesize the distinct voice and style of a writer, injecting that uniqueness into the remodeled content. This avoids the creation of sterility or uniformity in the output, which can often be a shortcoming of automated writing tools. By leveraging advanced AI technology, it assists users in enhancing their writing capabilities, reinforcing individuality in their content, and fostering a compelling written expression.

name: OptiMonk
description: OptiMonk is a comprehensive toolset for conversion optimization, primarily designed for marketers. The tool focuses on enhancing sales by means of website personalization, popups, and A/B testing. With OptiMonk, users can grow their lists, drive sales and successfully conduct upselling and cross-selling. Specifically designed to enhance the user experience, the tool allows for website personalization, enabling tailored messaging, offers, and landing pages to be delivered to each visitor. It also provides A/B testing capabilities, enabling users to determine the most effective headlines, offers or message combinations for their audience. OptiMonk also introduces an AI-powered conversion optimization feature that simplifies the process of creating effective headlines, personalized popups, and product descriptions, and enables parallel testing for numerous product pages. The tool is also bestowed with a library of Playbooks that provide strategies to build user lists, boost sales, increase average order value, maximize pay-per-click ads, and prevent shopping cart abandonment.

name: MakeLanding
description: MakeLanding is an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered landing page generator that allows users to create beautiful landing pages quickly and easily. With MakeLanding, users can write about their business or project and get an entire landing page generated in seconds. The tool provides users with copy that sells, unique logos and illustrations, and beautiful icons. It eliminates the need for designers or developers, making it easy for anyone to create a landing page without any technical knowledge.The landing pages generated by MakeLanding are highly customizable, with the option to upload personal pictures, change the copy, and edit buttons. The AI technology used by the tool generates copy that speaks over 50 languages and uses millions of converting headlines, making it suitable for a wide range of businesses and needs.MakeLanding offers users a variety of pre-made templates for portfolios, mobile apps, SaaS, communities, courses, and more. Additionally, it provides easy website editing, simple analytics, and is responsive, fast, and SEO-friendly.The tool has received positive reviews from users, who appreciate its convenience, time-saving capabilities, ease of use, and high-quality outputs. MakeLanding has two pricing plans - basic and pro, with the latter offering more features such as a custom domain and analytics.

name: AI Toolbar
description: AI Toolbar is a virtual assistant that integrates tooling directly into your web browser, designed to boost productivity and streamline tasks. This tool comes with a range of features. The Copilot feature allows users to draft emails with minimal input with the AI understanding the context and shaping the message accordingly. AI Toolbar is also equipped with a Chatbot, which communicates with the user and produces relevant responses that can be downloaded as Word or PDF documents. Voice Activation is another key feature that enables users to interact with their personal assistant directly on their PC. In addition, users can select text on any page and instruct the AI to perform various tasks such as summarizing, translating, paraphrasing, or extracting data. The premium version includes AI functionality on any page, ChatGPT integration, Voice Activation, Translation and Summarization, Chatbot, Export to PDF and Word, Custom Prompts, and Unlimited Usage. The free version offers similar features except for Custom Prompts and Unlimited Usage. AI Toolbar aims to democratize AI, keeping it accessible to a wider audience.

name: Rizz! Keyboard
description: Rizz! Keyboard is an AI-powered tool designed specifically to enhance the typing experience on your iPhone. Leveraging advanced AI models, the tool aims to transform the way users interact with their keyboard by allowing them to generate customized and creative responses. Instead of relying on generic suggestions, Rizz! Keyboard understands the user's context and aids in producing personalized compositions. Note that JavaScript needs to be enabled to run this app effectively. It's more than just predictive typing; it's about infusing AI to make mobile communication more dynamic and personalized.
