PhotoDel periodically updates to address any bugs, enhancing the app's overall functionality and user experience. In summary, PhotoDel is a valuable tool for individuals seeking to efficiently manage their phone's storage by eliminating duplicate and similar images. Its AI technology and user-friendly interface make it a convenient solution for anyone looking to organize and optimize their photo collections.

name: Your perfect presents
description: Your Perfect Presents - Genius Gift Ideas Generator is an AI-based tool designed to help users quickly and easily find unique and customized gift ideas for any occasion. The tool uses AI to generate personalized gift recommendations based on users' preferred price range, interests, and the recipient's age and gender. With just a few clicks, users can find the right gift and save time and stress.The website offers a wide range of gift categories for users to select from, including holidays, birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, teacher appreciation, and many more. Users can also customize their budget and select their preferred price range to ensure that they find gifts that fit their budget.Once users have found the perfect gift, they can purchase it directly through Amazon using the link provided on the website. The streamlined process ensures that gifts are delivered quickly and efficiently so that users can focus on making their loved ones feel special.Overall, Your Perfect Presents - Genius Gift Ideas Generator is a useful and convenient tool for anyone looking to find unique and personalized gift ideas without the hassle of browsing through countless options. With its AI-based algorithm and user-friendly interface, users can easily find the perfect gift for any occasion.

name: RapportBuilder
description: RapportBuilder is software designed to enhance conversationally focused interactions such as meetings, consulting, or interviews. It works by gathering information from publicly accessible sources on social media and news platforms about a person, their company, and their industry. This might include details like company updates, industry trends, personal interests, and others. After data compilation, this tool then processes the details into an easily digestible report that can guide the user in their discussions. The report also comes with suggested questions and icebreakers to help users make a strong impression and build trust swiftly. To ensure data accuracy, RapportBuilder employs sophisticated algorithms, corroborates details with multiple sources, and only extracts current, pertinent and publicly available data. It also limits data usage per user through a credit system where each lookup costs 1 credit. The service offers exhaustive user-support, assuring a response to all inquiries within 24 hours. The company prioritises data privacy and security, utilising industry-standard encryption methods and rigorous data handling strategies. While currently a web-based platform, there are ongoing considerations for a mobile application to enhance user experience.

name: SEO App
description: SEO.app is an AI-driven SEO plugin that is available on the ChatGPT store. It provides a personal SEO assistant within ChatGPT, helping users to anticipate SEO trends and achieve unprecedented business growth. The plugin applies the power of patented AI technology to generate highly optimized content that stays ahead of the evolving algorithms of search engines. It offers precision and performance like never before, while also empowering users to create highly targeted SEO content on a localized level. SEO.app enables easy content generation and semantic relevancy editing, ensuring accuracy and effectiveness. The plugin requires a ChatGPT Plus subscription to use. The tool's innovation is based on two ground-breaking patents that push the boundaries of what's possible in SEO. These patents are a reflection of the tool's relentless pursuit of innovation, making it a trailblazer in the world of SEO. SEO.app takes users beyond being competitive and makes them exponential, providing actionable insights to optimise content for better search engine rankings. The tool is highly recommended by professionals in industries such as blogging, video making, and AI engineering. SEO.app is committed to customer satisfaction, providing social media and community platforms for feedback and engagement. With SEO.app, users can enjoy a revolution in SEO that goes beyond the traditional approach of keyword integration and on-page optimization.

name: ChippyAI
description: ChippyAI is a browser extension called Chippy that allows users to access ChatGPT, an AI model, while browsing the internet. With Chippy, users can leverage AI capabilities to summarize text, conduct research, translate languages, and answer questions, all without the need to switch between tabs. The tool is compatible with Google Chrome and Chromium-based browsers. Chippy simplifies the input process by allowing users to directly type their questions or select specific text for analysis, eliminating the need for tedious copy-pasting. Users can also benefit from suggested prompts to kickstart their interactions with the AI and delve deeper into the generated responses using relevant follow-up queries. Chippy enhances the search capabilities of ChatGPT by enabling users to focus the AI's search on the current webpage, thus obtaining information beyond the model's knowledge cutoff, which is set in 2021. Moreover, the tool can assist users in drafting quick email responses. Chippy provides a free tier that permits users to make twenty GPT-3.5 queries per day. Additional queries or accessing the more advanced GPT-4 model requires users to provide their OpenAI API key. Users' conversations and API key are stored locally in their browser, allowing them to delete this data at any time. Chippy does not track browser history and does not require users to create an account. Installation involves a simple process of adding the extension from the Chrome store, after which users can customize their theme and begin using Chippy. Upgrades are available through the tool's settings menu.

name: Template Prompts
description: Template Prompts is a tool designed to enhance efficiency and organization in generating AI-based prompts. It enables the storage, customization, and reuse of machine learning prompts across user-defined templates for various contexts or AI tools. Template Prompts offers a functionality that turns complex, one-off prompts into replicable templates by incorporating user-defined variables, enabling easy modification of prompts to suit different data.Users can showcase favorite prompts, sort their prompts library by tools and tags, and at the click of a button, copy any customized prompts into their preferred AI tool, adjusting values to suit other use cases. This feature permits quick and precise integration of AI prompts with different applications.The platform keeps all prompts in a private, easily accessible library, encouraging prompt organization for better productivity. The prompts are stored separately, canned in templates for easy retrieval and reproduction - thus making prompt engineering simple, and organized. This way, users can create, store, and reuse AI prompts flexibly, facilitating the creation of specialized AI tools like copywriting assistants amongst others.

name: Hisanta.ai
description: Hisanta.ai is an interactive AI-powered tool that offers users a unique and engaging way to communicate with Santa Claus and his friends. This tool provides a virtual chat experience where users can express their Christmas wishes directly to Santa. The technology behind this platform utilizes artificial intelligence to emulate the charisma of Santa, giving users an amusing and novel way to celebrate the holiday season. Hisanta.ai is an innovative way of blending tradition with technology to create a fun and entertaining experience. This tool is part of a Holiday Experiment by Fixie. Future applications of this platform could extend beyond holiday festivities to special events and interactive storytelling platforms. Hisanta.ai marks a significant step in voice technology by showing users how AI can imitate endearing characteristics and how engaging and versatile it can be.

name: Biscuits.ai
description: The Biscuits.ai Cookie Policy Generator is an AI-powered tool that automatically scans your website for third-party cookies and generates a complete cookie policy. With this tool, you can quickly and effortlessly create a comprehensive and customized cookie policy for your website.By providing the URL of your website, the AI technology of Biscuits.ai analyzes the site's content and identifies all third-party cookies that are present. The generated cookie policy is tailored to your specific website, ensuring that it accurately reflects the cookies used on your site.The tool aims to simplify the process of creating a cookie policy by utilizing advanced AI algorithms. This saves you time and effort that would otherwise be spent manually identifying and documenting the cookies. The generated policy can be easily integrated into your website to comply with the relevant legal requirements and inform your users about the cookies utilized.In summary, the Biscuits.ai Cookie Policy Generator is an efficient and intelligent solution for website owners who need to create a clear and compliant cookie policy. Through automated scanning and AI technology, this tool generates a customized policy that accurately reflects the cookies on your website.

name: Instantapply
description: InstantApply is a comprehensive AI tool designed to streamline the job application process and increase your chances of landing your dream job. With a range of features, InstantApply offers a complete system for job applicants.One of the key features of this tool is the Resume Analyzer. It allows you to analyze job descriptions and identify keywords that may be missing from your resume. By optimizing your resume to match the job requirements, you can increase your chances of getting noticed by employers.Additionally, InstantApply's AI-driven cover letter generator crafts personalized and captivating cover letters that are tailored to speak directly to hiring managers. This feature saves you time and ensures that your cover letter stands out among other applicants.Another time-saving feature is the Job Autofill, which allows you to easily complete job application forms. By automating this tedious process, you can focus more on showcasing your skills and qualifications to employers.InstantApply also offers Job Tracking, which allows you to effortlessly track the progress of your applications. This feature provides you with a clear view of your job hunt's trajectory, eliminating uncertainty and helping you take advantage of all relevant opportunities.Furthermore, InstantApply provides insightful analytics to track your job search progress. This feature allows you to monitor your performance and make data-driven decisions to improve your job search strategy.Overall, InstantApply is a powerful AI tool that enhances your job application process by optimizing your resume, generating personalized cover letters, automating form filling, and providing valuable tracking and analytics.

name: Nomadspot
description: Nomadspot is an AI-powered application designed to facilitate travel planning and organization. It enables users to easily plan trips with friends, create calendars, and follow daily travel itineraries directly from their phones. Nomadspot also enhances the travel experience by allowing users to pin their travels on a personal map and share their experiences with friends and the larger community. One of its key features is the AI-powered planner that suggests travel ideas tailored to the individual user's needs. Instead of wasting time researching what to visit, users can rely on the AI tool for personalized suggestions. Moreover, Nomadspot encourages a culture of sharing and community among its users, promoting the sharing of experiences for an enriched and informative platform. Note that this tool is for prospective users who want a simplified and organized approach to travel planning and are looking for an application that does more than just provide itinerary suggestions.

name: Taste Bud
description: Taste Bud is an AI-powered cooking companion that helps users invent recipes based on the ingredients they have in their kitchen. It functions as a bot that users can interact with naturally, allowing them to communicate their preferences and constraints just as they would with a person. Users can inform Taste Bud about the ingredients they want to use in their dish, such as items in their fridge, pantry, or leftovers that need to be used up. They can also specify if they don't have a suggested ingredient, and the tool will provide alternatives. Additionally, users can inquire about specific cooking tools or make requests for vegan or dairy-free recipes, and Taste Bud will provide suitable recommendations. Taste Bud serves as a collaborative partner in the cooking process, assisting users in creating something tasty. However, being a bot, it can be easily tricked and does not award points for unrealistic requests. The tool offers a feature called "Saved Buds" where users can store recipes they like. These recipes are saved in the browser's cache, eliminating the need for creating a separate account. However, it's worth noting that clearing cookies will also remove saved recipes. Taste Bud was developed by Sarah Lawrence and Ryan Splitlog, two home cooks based in Atlanta, Georgia. It provides users with a convenient and personalized cooking experience by leveraging AI technology.

name: SidekicAI
description: SidekicAI is a job application assistant designed to streamline your job application process. It acts as your personal assistant, helping generate cover letters faster and with more precision. The tool requires an input of your existing cover letter and a few skills and then proceeds to generate a customized cover letter for every job you are applying to. The sole requirement from your end is the job description of the role you are applying for. SidekicAI reimagines the cover letters based on the job descriptions, hence making every application unique and tailored. The tool continuously updates its AI to provide more accurate and relevant outputs. It prioritizes user privacy by storing all data locally, reassuring users of their data security. To ensure a hassle-free experience, SidekicAI has customer support readily available. Note that the platform is free to get started.

name: Metastory
description: Metastory is an AI-powered tool designed to assist product owners with gathering product requirements quickly and efficiently. The tool offers AI-based assistance that utilizes collective intelligence to help product owners overcome the challenge of gathering requirements in a cost-effective and timely manner. The UI-based documentation of the tool eliminates the gap between the user interface and required features, making communication between stakeholders seamless. Metastory also offers JIRA integration, enabling users to import JIRA issues and start their project from another perspective.Metastory's primary goal is to empower product owners and managers by making the requirements gathering process faster and more manageable. The tool provides users with recommendations and precise locations to pin them on the user interface. The design of Metastory is user-friendly, and the tool offers intuitive features and a clean interface. Overall, Metastory is a promising tool for product owners and managers who want to streamline their requirements gathering process with the latest AI-powered technology. By offering a faster and smarter way of gathering requirements, Metastory may be a valuable addition to any product development team.

name: Adori
description: The Blog to Video Maker is an AI-powered tool that allows users to convert their blog posts into engaging and captivating videos effortlessly. By simply pasting the blog URL, the tool generates AI-generated scenes with relevant images, extracts headlines, text, and key points from the blog, and summarizes the title and description for the video, ensuring SEO optimization. The tool also offers a selection of high-quality voices for professional voiceovers, enhancing the videos' impact. It provides eye-catching visuals that bring the content to life and differentiate it from static content. With its AI technology, the tool optimizes the videos for search engines, boosting search engine rankings and driving organic traffic to the user's website. Additionally, it seamlessly integrates with social media platforms, allowing users to share their videos directly on platforms like YouTube and Facebook, expanding their reach.Unlike other blog to video tools, the Adori Blog to Video Maker offers a transparent pricing plan with no surprises, eliminates watermarks, and provides realistic AI voiceovers. It caters to both long-form videos and short videos (over 1 minute), and it automates the publishing process to YouTube.Overall, the tool revolutionizes content creation for bloggers, enhancing engagement and reach, saving time and effort, and improving online visibility. It is highly recommended for content writers looking to elevate their content marketing strategy.

name: Snorkell
description: Snorkell.ai is an AI-powered tool geared towards automated generation of documentation or docstrings for various programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, and TypeScript. The tool is commonly used with version control systems like GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket. It aims to facilitate smooth coding practice by generating documentation on every pull request merge, keeping the docstring synchronized with the associated codebase. Unlike Python-exclusive tools like PyDoc that only produce syntactic docstrings, Snorkell.ai produces human-readable and understandable docstrings across multiple programming languages. It operates by accessing the latest commit files to create the docstring dynamically and does not retain your code on local storage, thus prioritizing code security. One noted feature of Snorkell.ai is the ability to review and suggest corrections to the auto-generated docstrings via the generated pull request, ensuring accuracy and reliability. The tool offers both free and paid tiers with varying degrees of repository support and other features, including on-premise support, proprietary AI models, and access to experimental features in the elite tier.

name: Ellen AI
description: ELLEN AI is a smart artificial intelligence companion equipped with voice functionality. This tool offers a comprehensive package with full access to the source code, including the project and chatbot template, and a step-by-step guide for creation and customization. ELLEN AI is designed for flexibility with customizable elements and the ability to be used with unique API keys. The aim of this tool is to facilitate the improvement of the source code provided according to specific user needs. Beyond coding access, it provides an accompanying video tutorial to make customisation and use easier for users. With the pay-once, own-forever model, purchasers are given the freedom to modify, rebrand, and even resell the product if they desire. Upon purchase, immediate access to the code is granted. Guides and tutorials are offered to assist in applying the same concept in building different AI-driven products, examples of which include AI girlfriends, chatbot assistants, and extensions with voice capabilities.

name: Legacy AI
description: LegacyAI is a ChatGPT (Generative Pre-training Transformer) client designed for older Mac OS systems and allows users to converse with OpenAI's ChatGPT from their desktop. It is a tool that can efficiently serve as an AI-powered personal assistant for anyone using older Macintosh computers. The application supports Mac OS 9 - 10.6.8 and allows users to choose AI models depending on their requirements and even set proxy servers if required. LegacyAI also provides users with options to save conversations for future reference, change AI models to adapt to their needs, and fully customize preferences. The tool is free to use, but API access is dependent on donations. Running costs are involved in hosting the server and using OpenAI's API, so if users are in a position to donate, they can do so through a link provided. It requires a Macintosh computer running Mac OS 9 - 10.6.8, preferably a G3 processor, at least 16mb RAM, and 1mb disk space. It should be noted that LegacyAI does not transmit information over HTTPS as Mac OS 9 was developed before HTTPS was a standard protocol on the internet. While LegacyAI is free to use, the transmissions made using it on an older Macintosh are not secure. It is essential to understand this and not use it for sensitive matters. The tool was built by Manticore Software, a software development agency in New Zealand, and its founder, Jordan Trbuhovic.
features: ✅ Designed and maintained by Manticore Software

name: Practina
description: Practina AI is a marketing automation platform that aims to enhance digital marketing efforts for businesses. The tool offers features that include scheduling and publishing content on social media platforms, generating high-quality AI-generated content, creating click-worthy advertisements with advanced targeting, managing and tracking leads, responding to online reviews, and analyzing real-time insights through analytics and reporting.With Practina AI, users can automate their social media calendar, allowing the software to decide when to schedule and publish content on their behalf. The tool also provides the capability to generate high-quality content by simply inputting a few details about the business, products, or services.In terms of advertising, Practina AI offers a range of click-worthy advertisements with advanced targeting options powered by AI. Users can manage and track leads through the Lead Centre feature, staying up-to-date with app notifications.Additionally, Practina AI enables businesses to respond to online reviews using ready-to-post templates, ensuring customer satisfaction. The tool also provides analytics and reporting functionalities, calculating and presenting real-time insights to help users understand the effectiveness of their marketing strategies.Practina AI aims to empower businesses with technology that simplifies digital marketing tasks, offering a pocket-friendly pricing structure compared to hiring a digital marketing agency. The tool also provides world-class support, including product training and expert advice.Overall, Practina AI offers a comprehensive marketing automation solution with complete automation capabilities, eliminating the need for manual input and allowing users to focus on other critical aspects of their business.

name: TurboScribe
description: TurboScribe converts audio and video files to accurate text in seconds. It is powered by Whisper, an advanced open transcription technology known for its accuracy. TurboScribe offers unlimited, high-accuracy audio and video transcription services. It supports over 98 languages and can transcribe audio and video files in various formats, including MP3, M4A, MP4, MOV, AAC, WAV, OGG, OPUS, MPEG, WMA, WMV, and YouTube video links. The tool allows users to export their transcripts in PDF, DOCX, TXT, and SRT subtitle formats. Additionally, TurboScribe includes speaker recognition, making it suitable for podcasts, interviews, and meetings where multiple speakers are involved. The tool also offers built-in translation features for transcribing audio in any language directly to English as well as translating transcripts to over 134 languages. TurboScribe offers a free tier that allows users to transcribe up to 3 files per day, with each file limited to 30 minutes. For unlimited transcriptions, users can subscribe to TurboScribe Unlimited, which is available for $10 per month when billed yearly or $20 per month when billed monthly. name: Kloud Chat
description: Kloud Chat is an AI assistant available on the App Store for iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch. It allows users to read reviews, compare customer ratings, and see screenshots before downloading the app. The tool aims to provide an AI assistant experience to its users, enhancing their mobile device usage. It is designed to assist users with various tasks or inquiries, leveraging artificial intelligence technology. Kloud Chat's primary function is to provide helpful and relevant information based on user queries. It can offer personalized recommendations, answer questions, and provide guidance on a wide range of topics. With Kloud Chat, users can access features that improve their overall mobile experience. This AI assistant app is designed to make interactions between users and their devices more efficient and effective. The app is specifically developed for Apple devices and can be easily downloaded from the App Store. It is optimized for iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch, ensuring compatibility and smooth performance on these devices. By offering an AI assistant on the App Store, Kloud Chat adds value to the user experience by providing a convenient and intelligent tool that can assist with various tasks and inquiries.
